AABB2D.description: Two-dimensional axis-aligned bounding box used for zone management and planar spatial queries.

methods.inflate: Expands the dimensions of the bounding box uniformly in all directions by the specified amount.
methods.intersects: Checks whether this bounding box intersects with another bounding box, a circle with a radius, or a line segment between two points.
methods.intersects2: Calculates ray intersection against the 2D bounding box from a ray origin and direction vector, returning the intersection point as a 2D vector.
methods.pointWithin: Returns true if the specified 3D vector position falls within the 2D bounding box boundaries.
methods.setNull: Resets the bounding box to an empty, uninitialized state.
methods.sizeX: Returns the horizontal width of the bounding box along the X axis.
methods.sizeY: Returns the vertical height of the bounding box along the Y axis.

properties.x: Minimum horizontal coordinate of the bounding box.
properties.x2: Maximum horizontal coordinate of the bounding box.
properties.y: Minimum vertical coordinate of the bounding box.
properties.y2: Maximum vertical coordinate of the bounding box.

AI.description: Master character artificial intelligence controller. Governs individual Goal-Oriented Action Planning (GOAP) precondition evaluation, sensory perception, order execution pipelines, squad mission targeting, combat arbitration, and movement coordination. Coordinates directly with `Character` for entity state, `SensoryData` for vision and awareness, `AITaskSytem` for job/order priority stacks, `Platoon` for squad blackboards, and `Blackboard` for collective tactical memory.

methods.scoreJobMedic: Calculates utility weight for dedicated squad medic job assignments.

methods.save: Saves the squad AI option flags into the provided GameData.

properties.autoDitchItems: Whether player characters automatically drop resources into storage containers.
properties.autoSit: Whether idle player characters automatically sit on available stools or benches.
properties.autoSleep: Whether injured player characters automatically rest in available beds.
properties.ejectEnemies: Whether player characters automatically throw unconscious enemies out of player buildings and towns.
properties.feedAnimals: Whether player characters automatically feed hungry squad animals.
properties.healAllies: Whether player characters automatically bandage injured squadmates and allies.
properties.helpAllies: Whether player characters automatically come to the aid of allies in combat.

methods.AIPackage: Initializes a new `AIPackage` instance. Sets default values for handles and nullifies pointers, preparing the object for configuration via its template data.
methods.activateAndSetup: Activates the AI package and prepares it for execution. This involves binding necessary platoon context and optionally triggering initial dialogs if an employer or target requires engagement.
methods.assessEnemy: Evaluates if a target should be forcibly treated as an enemy by this package. Overrides global diplomacy if the mission demands hostility (e.g. assassination contracts).
methods.assessNeutral: Evaluates if a target should be treated as neutral within the scope of this package. Allows packages to temporarily override standard faction diplomacy rules for mission targets.
methods.autoNotifyJobsPanel: Automatically pushes state updates or task name modifications to the squad's job panel in the user interface. Ensures player-facing goals remain synchronized with package state.
methods.endPackage: Finalizes the AI package's lifecycle. It triggers the ending dialogue based on success criteria and initiates the transition to a successor package if `leadsToPackage` is configured.
methods.getDesiredTravelSpeed: Determines the preferred movement speed constraint for the given character while executing this package. Modulates pacing, such as forcing walking speeds during patrols.
methods.getGUIData: Populates a target UI data panel with string representations and context details regarding this package's current task. Used to inform the player of AI goals.
methods.getLeader: Retrieves the designated leader driving this package's operations. This is frequently the platoon leader of the bound `squad`, but specialized packages might assign dynamic leaders.
methods.getMyTarget: Evaluates the intended target for a given character under this package's context. Often resolves handles like `missionTarget` to explicit instances if valid in the current loaded area.
methods.iAmActivePackage: Checks if this specific instance is currently the highest-priority executing package on the platoon's blackboard. Important for conditional logic and UI indicators.
methods.load: Restores the package's state from a save game data block. Rebinds references to characters and towns using saved handles, reconstructing the mission context.
methods.notifyBetrayal: Processes a betrayal event relevant to the package, such as an employer attacking the contracted platoon. Sets the `wasBetrayed` flag and typically invalidates mission terms immediately.
methods.notifyMyTargetPathfindImpossible: A callback invoked by the navigation mesh subsystem when an assigned agent cannot find a valid path to its target. Typically triggers package abortion or fallback behaviors.
methods.periodicUpdate: Tick method invoked during the blackboard update cycle to maintain package state. Handles time-gated logic, distance checks to towns, or dynamic requirement validation.
methods.save: Serializes the package's internal state into the provided save game block. Preserves vital handles like `missionTarget` and tracking variables across game sessions.
methods.showManagementPanelCallback: Callback triggered when a user explicitly interacts with the package's UI representation. Useful for opening specialized configuration dialogues if the package has advanced parameters.
methods.signalEnd: Invoked when the package is preempted, completed, or cancelled. Facilitates graceful tear-down of active tasks, like unsetting destination markers.
methods.signalStart: Invoked when the package becomes the active operational focus. Base implementation typically updates internal state to flag successful startup sequence.
methods.wantsRenewButton: Indicates whether this package type supports a manual "renew contract" interaction from the player UI, typical for mercenary hire packages.
methods.wasASuccess: Determines the completion status of the package. This directly influences whether the active or passive ending dialogue plays during `endPackage`.
methods.~AIPackage: Destroys the `AIPackage` instance. Cleans up any child packages, specifically ensuring `leadsToPackage` is safely terminated if applicable, and unbinds from the platoon blackboard.

properties.endingDialogActive: Dialogue script triggered on active completion.
properties.endingDialogPassive: Dialogue script triggered on passive termination.
properties.key: Signal key enum identifying package category.
properties.missionTown: Destination or base town target handle.
properties.unloadedMode: Behavior mode when platoon is streaming unloaded.

methods._setPositionAndTeleport: Teleports the movement agent to position p (Vector3 table) on floor.
methods._setPositionSimple: Sets the agent's position directly to p (Vector3 table).
methods.amInsideTownWalls: Returns an integer status indicating whether the agent is inside town walls.
methods.create: Initializes the movement base at starting position _pos (Vector3 table).
methods.extractRoadFollower: Detaches and returns the current RoadFollower* (as lightuserdata).
methods.faceDirection: Rotates the agent to face direction vector dir (Vector3 table).
methods.getCurrentMotion: Returns the current frame motion vector (Vector3 table).
methods.getCurrentSpeed: Returns the current scalar movement speed.
methods.getCurrentSpeedRelativeToMax01: Returns current speed normalized against maxSpeed in the [0.0, 1.0] range.
methods.getDestination: Returns the current target destination position (Vector3 table).
methods.getFacingDirection: Returns the agent's normalized forward facing direction (Vector3 table).
methods.getHandle: Returns the hand handle of the owning object.
methods.getMaxSpeed: Returns the maximum allowed movement speed.
methods.getPosition: Returns the agent's current world position (Vector3 table).
methods.getSpeedOrders: Returns the ordered MoveSpeed enum value.
methods.halt: Stops movement and clears the current path.
methods.isCurrentlyMoving: Returns true if the agent is currently moving.
methods.isDestinationReached: Returns true if the agent has reached its current destination.
methods.isProbablyStuck: Returns true if the agent appears stuck while trying to move.
methods.leaveSpeedGroup: Removes this agent from its shared SpeedGroup.
methods.lookatPosition: Rotates the agent to look toward world position pos (Vector3 table).
methods.manualMovement: Applies manual motion displacement desiredMotion (Vector3 table).
methods.onControllerHit: PhysX controller callback invoked when colliding with another controller (NxControllersHit* lightuserdata); returns NxControllerAction.
methods.onShapeHit: PhysX controller callback invoked when hitting a static or dynamic shape (NxControllerShapeHit* lightuserdata); returns NxControllerAction.
methods.pathFailed: Returns true if pathfinding failed to find a route.
methods.pathOk: Returns true if the current path is valid.
methods.restoreDesiredSpeed: Restores desiredSpeed to match the ordered movement speed (speedOrders).
methods.setCurrentRoadFollower: Assigns road follower r (RoadFollower* lightuserdata) for destination d (Vector3 table).
methods.setDesiredSpeed: Sets the desired movement speed, accepting either a MoveSpeed enum integer (0..4) or a float speed value.
methods.setDesiredSpeedOrders: Sets the ordered movement speed, accepting either a MoveSpeed enum integer (0..4) or a float speed value.
methods.setDestination: Overloaded destination setter: accepts a target Character, Building, RootObjectBase, or world-space Vector3 table as argument 2, an optional UpdatePriority integer as argument 3, and (when passing a Vector3 table) an optional boolean notVertical as argument 4.
methods.setMaxSpeed: Sets the maximum allowed movement speed (ms).
methods.setPatrolInput: Configures patrol movement from patrol (PatrolInfo* lightuserdata).
methods.setRoadDestination: Plans a road-following route to dest (Vector3 table) and returns whether a road path was found.
methods.setRoadPreference: Sets the road preference weight w used when pathfinding along roads.
methods.update: Advances base movement and pathing state over _TIME seconds.

properties.currentMotion: Motion displacement vector (Vector3 table) for the current frame.
properties.currentlyMoving: Whether the agent is actively moving.
properties.direction: Current normalized facing/movement direction vector (Vector3 table).
properties.officiallyStopped: Whether the movement controller has been explicitly halted.
properties.pathDestination: Current intermediate path destination position (Vector3 table).
properties.roadFollower: Long-distance road navigation helper (RoadFollower* as lightuserdata).
properties.roadWeight: Preference weight for staying on roads during pathfinding.
properties.speedGroup: Shared SpeedGroup instance synchronizing movement speed across a group, or nil if none.
properties.walkSpeed: Standard walking speed in world units per second.

ActivePlatoon.description: Active runtime squad controller managing spawned characters, shared group senses (GroupSense), character memory, squad leader selection, and disk serialization. Extends RootObjectContainer.

methods._checkForUniqueCharactersOnUnload: Updates world state for any unique characters when the platoon unloads.
methods._forceRefreshInventory: Forces an immediate restock/refresh of the squad's vendor inventories.
methods._recalculateIsIntact: Recalculates whether the squad is still intact (not wiped out or captured) and returns the result.
methods.addActiveObject: Adds active character c (RootObject) to this platoon and returns whether it succeeded.
methods.addCharacterAt: Inserts character c (RootObject) into the squad roster at index.
methods.calculateCurrentPos: Calculates and returns the average/representative world position (Vector3 table) of the squad.
methods.checkForCharactersBeingCarried: Returns true if any member of this squad is currently being carried by another platoon.
methods.clearAllTheUniqueNPCStates: Clears unique NPC world-state tracking for members of this platoon.
methods.destroyCharacters: Despawns and destroys all characters in this active platoon (justUnload preserves persistent data).
methods.emptySquadCheck: Checks if the squad has become empty and handles cleanup if so.
methods.getCharactersInArea: Appends squad characters within radius of pos (Vector3 table) into out (lektor<RootObject*>), optionally filtering to standingOnly.
methods.getGroupSense: Returns the platoon's shared GroupSense* as lightuserdata.
methods.getHasSpecialItemsList: Returns true if this squad has a special vendor items list.
methods.getHasVendorList: Returns true if this squad has a vendor item list.
methods.getIsTrader: Returns true if this squad is configured as a trader platoon.
methods.getMemory: Returns the platoon's CharacterMemory* as lightuserdata.
methods.getName: Returns the display name of this squad.
methods.getNearestActiveCharacter: Returns the active squad Character closest to position p (Vector3 table) on floor.
methods.getSquadLeader: Returns the current effective squad leader Character.
methods.getSquadLeader_theRealOne: Returns the actual designated squad leader Character, even if temporarily unavailable.
methods.getSquadSize: Returns the number of characters currently in this active squad.
methods.isAnyoneCaptured: Returns true if any member of the squad is currently captured or imprisoned.
methods.isIntact: Returns true if the squad is considered intact and operational.
methods.isLoaded: Returns true if this active platoon's characters are currently spawned and loaded.
methods.isWholeSquadDown: Returns true if all squad members (optionally excluding minusThis count) are unconscious, dead, or incapacitated.
methods.loadCharacters: Spawns the platoon's characters around position _a1 (Vector3 table), optionally notifying _a2 (FactoryCallbackInterface).
methods.loadFromDisk: Loads the platoon's character data from disk, optionally forcing reload (force) and passing extra (Serialisable* lightuserdata).
methods.loadInstance: Spawns a single character instance from state (GameSaveState) at pos (Vector3 table) and rot (Quaternion table), with skipSaveState, optional callback (FactoryCallbackInterface), and positionMoved offset (Vector3 table).
methods.periodicUpdate: Runs periodic squad AI, sensory, and zone checks.
methods.putTheSpecialCharactersInNewSquads_captu: Moves captured unique/special characters into separate squads before unloading.
methods.refreshInventory: Refreshes squad trader or vendor inventories (firstTime indicates initial spawn).
methods.removeObject: Removes character c (RootObject) from this active platoon and returns whether it succeeded.
methods.restoreSquad: Restores the squad's state after loading.
methods.saveToDisk: Saves platoon data to disk (with levelEditor flag and optional filename override force).
methods.serialiseCharacterData: Serializes the current state of all characters in the platoon into memory/save containers.
methods.serialiseEverythingToDisk: Serializes the entire platoon and its characters to disk (levelEditor indicatesFCS/editor export).
methods.setDataFilename: Sets the save file path (f) used to persist this platoon on disk.
methods.setName: Sets the display name of this squad.
methods.setSquadLeader: Assigns who (Character) as the squad leader.
methods.setupCheck: Checks whether the platoon is ready to finish initial setup and returns a YesNoMaybe status.
methods.setupLeaderDialogues: Initializes dialogue packages on the squad leader.
methods.setupTraderBuildings: Associates trader squad vendor lists with their owned town buildings.
methods.swapCharacters: Swaps the roster positions of the characters at indexA and indexB.
methods.teleport: Queues or executes a squad teleport to world position pos (Vector3 table).
methods.unloadCheck: Checks whether the platoon should be unloaded based on distance and returns true if unloading.

AnimalInventoryLayout.description: Subclass of InventoryLayout that manages and configures the inventory grid sections displayed for animal characters.

methods.setupSections: Configures the animal inventory section widgets within the specified InventoryGUI, map of inventory sections, and Inventory.

AnimationClass.description: Core skeletal animation controller and locomotion blending coordinator governing character poses, movement cycles, combat techniques, stumbles, and ragdoll transitions. Manages Ogre3D skeletal animation layers, motion smoothing filters, pain overlay blend masks, and physics ragdoll kinematics coupling. Interacts directly with `Character` for actor state, `CharMovement` for locomotion velocity and steering, `AppearanceBase` for skeletal mesh scaling and body morphs, and `CombatClass` for attack and parry sequence timing.

methods.AnimationClass: Constructs the `AnimationClass` skeletal controller, initializing animation requirement buffers, ragdoll kinematics couplers, and Ogre animation layer channels.
methods.activateVisuals: Enables visual skeleton rendering, particle emitters, and bone node transformations for the character.
methods.animationSelection: Master selection arbitration routine evaluating movement speed, turning direction, stance, and injuries to blend appropriate movement and idle clips.
methods.animationSelectionCombatMode: Evaluates combat stances, weapon readiness, and engagement ranges to select combat idle or attack animations.
methods.beingCarriedUpdate: Updates animation posture and limb blending when the character is being carried by another entity.
methods.breathing: Advances and applies subtle skeletal breathing morph animations to chest and shoulder bones during idles.
methods.calculateFeetHeight: Calculates terrain contact heights for left and right foot bones to adjust inverse kinematics footing.
methods.chooseAnims: Evaluates available animation clips matching current character stance, speed, and held equipment requirements.
methods.chooseRandomAnim: Selects a random animation variant from a matching group of candidate clips.
methods.chooseStumbleAnim: Selects the most appropriate stumble animation clip based on damaged body part, cut origination angle, and strike severity.
methods.currentlyStumbling: Returns true if the character is currently executing an involuntary hit-reaction stumble animation.
methods.deactivateVisuals: Disables visual mesh and bone rendering when a character is culled or out of camera range.
methods.debugGetAllAnimations: Populates an array with all loaded animation clips available for this character rig.
methods.endCombatAnimation: Concludes an attack or block animation cycle, transitioning bones back into combat idle posture.
methods.endSlaveAnim: Terminates a synchronized slave labor or interaction animation and releases bone attachments.
methods.endStumble: Concludes reactive stumble recovery and restores combat idle or locomotion stances.
methods.estimateAnimationTime: Estimates the total duration in seconds required to play the specified animation clip.
methods.getAnimationData: Looks up the `AnimationData` definition record for the specified animation clip name.
methods.getAnimationDataByOgreName: Retrieves the `AnimationData` record corresponding to an Ogre skeleton animation track name.
methods.getAnimationDatasList: Returns the list of all `AnimationData` records registered for this skeletal rig.
methods.getAppearanceData: Retrieves the `GameDataCopyStandalone` containing appearance sliders and character morph values.
methods.getAudioObject: Retrieves the audio playback emitter object bound to this character rig.
methods.getBoneScale: Returns the visual scaling vector applied to the specified bone node.
methods.getCharacter: Returns the owning `Character` entity driven by this animation controller.
methods.getCurrentlyStumbleAnim: Returns the stumble animation clip currently being executed, or nil if not stumbling.
methods.getEvents: Returns the active event notification callbacks registered for current animation tracks.
methods.getFloatingAnim: Returns the swimming or floating animation clip used when the character is in deep water.
methods.getFootHeight: Returns the vertical footing contact height offset for inverse kinematics adjustment.
methods.getHeight: Returns the effective character height in world units factoring scale sliders.
methods.getIdleAnimation: Returns the active ambient idle animation clip currently playing.
methods.getIsActivated: Returns true if visual mesh and skeleton rendering updates are currently active.
methods.getLookDirection: Returns the 3D unit vector indicating the character's current visual look direction.
methods.getMaximumSpeed: Returns the maximum movement speed permitted for the character's current locomotion blend.
methods.getPosition: Returns the 3D world position coordinates of the character skeleton.
methods.getRagdoll: Retrieves the underlying PhysX ragdoll physical controller instance.
methods.getStandingUpAnim: Returns the keyframed recovery animation clip used to stand up from a ragdoll knockdown pose.
methods.getWeatherStrength: Returns the current environmental weather intensity scalar affecting animations.
methods.getWeatherType: Returns the active environmental weather hazard type affecting character reactions.
methods.hasAction: Returns true if the character currently has an active action animation playing or queued.
methods.hasRagdollPart: Returns true if the specified body part bone is currently articulated by a physical ragdoll rigid body.
methods.isBeingCarried: Returns true if the character is currently being carried on the shoulder of another character.
methods.isCurrentlyIncapableOfWaypointMovemode: Returns true if injuries, carrying states, or stumbles prevent normal waypoint locomotion.
methods.isLinearAnimationDone: Returns true if the currently active linear non-looping animation track has completed.
methods.isLinearAnimationDone_byName: Returns true if the specified linear animation track has finished playing.
methods.isPhysical: Returns true if the character's skeleton is currently simulated by dynamic physics ragdoll bodies.
methods.isRagdoll: Checks if the character skeleton is currently governed by active PhysX physical simulation.
methods.isRagdollAnimated: Returns true if the character is in a hybrid animated-ragdoll mode (e.g. partial physical impact).
methods.isSlaveAnimating: Returns true if the character is currently bound to a synchronized slave labor animation loop.
methods.isSlaveAttachToBoneMode: Returns true if slave interaction attaches the character transform directly to a machine bone.
methods.isTotallyRagdoll: Returns true if the character is in full unconstrained physical ragdoll mode with no motor control.
methods.isTurning: Returns true if the character is currently playing a stationary turn animation.
methods.isTurningFar: Returns true if the character is turning at a high angular delta requiring large pivot steps.
methods.lookAt: Applies head and neck inverse kinematics bone rotation to look toward the specified world position.
methods.notifyRagdollNeedsAnUpdate: Flags the character ragdoll as requiring PhysX transform resynchronization next frame.
methods.notifyRelocatedAnimLoop: Notifies the animation controller that a root motion animation track has looped back to start.
methods.overlaidAnimationSelection: Evaluates overlay animation channels (such as pain grimaces, wounded limps, or carrying).
methods.playAction: Queues and plays an upper-body or whole-body action animation (e.g. eating, healing, crafting, lockpicking) over base locomotion.
methods.playSlaveAnim: Starts playback of a synchronized slave labor animation tied to an interactive furniture object.
methods.postRagdollCreationCallbackMT: Callback invoked on main thread after asynchronous PhysX ragdoll construction finishes.
methods.processActionAnims: Advances playback, blending weights, and event triggers for active action animations.
methods.processCombatIdleAnims: Blends breathing, fidgets, and weapon swaying for combat ready stances.
methods.processIdleAnims: Blends ambient idle fidgets and posture shifts when the character is standing still.
methods.processMoveAnims: Blends walk, jog, and run locomotion tracks based on current horizontal velocity.
methods.processTurnAnim: Applies angular rotation steps and foot pivots for stationary direction adjustments.
methods.ragdollAnimateTo: Kinematically blends ragdoll physics bones back into a keyframed recovery pose (e.g. standing up from ground).
methods.ragdollModeUT: Switches character into PhysX physical ragdoll mode, transferring bone linear and angular momentum to rigid body capsules upon incapacitation or death.
methods.ragdollTheWeapons: Decouples equipped weapons from hands and spawns physical dynamic rigid bodies falling to the ground.
methods.randomiseAnimationPosition: Randomizes initial timeline offset of idle animations to avoid visual synchronization across squads.
methods.rangedCombatModeUpdate: Updates aiming elevation, bow draw tension, and weapon reloading animations for ranged combat.
methods.resetBody: Resets all bone transformations back to the default bind pose.
methods.restartAction: Restarts playback of the current action animation from the beginning.
methods.rotateEntityAroundBone: Rotates an attached mesh entity relative to its parent bone attachment point.
methods.rotationUpdate: Updates skeletal heading orientation and smooths rotational interpolation toward target facing.
methods.runAnimation: Plays an animation clip by name on the specified skeletal track layer.
methods.runAnimation_manualTiming: Plays an animation track with manually driven timeline playback time.
methods.runCombatAnimation: Executes an attack or defense animation sequence on the combat animation layer.
methods.runSlaveAnim: Drives frame updates for a synchronized machine or furniture interaction animation.
methods.runStrafe: Drives lateral strafing locomotion blending based on movement heading relative to facing.
methods.scoreAnim: Calculates compatibility score of candidate animation against current movement speed, weapon held, and injury state.
methods.serialiseAppearance: Serializes active visual animation parameters, morphs, and attached props into save data.
methods.setAnimationMoveSpeed: Sets the target locomotion velocity used to select between walk, jog, and sprint tracks.
methods.setAppearanceData: Applies character appearance slider morph targets and skeleton scale factors to the rig.
methods.setBodyEntity: Assigns the primary visual Ogre mesh entity driven by this animation controller.
methods.setBootHeight: Adjusts vertical foot offset to compensate for shoe or footwear sole thickness.
methods.setCarryMode: Configures carrying posture animation overlays when carrying a body or heavy object.
methods.setCombatMode: Enables or disables combat readiness stance overlays and weapon handling.
methods.setCombatModeLegsIdle: Sets the idle posture animation for lower body legs during combat.
methods.setCombatModeUpperIdle: Sets the idle posture animation for upper body torso and arms during combat.
methods.setDesiredPainOverlayAnimOverride: Overrides the active pain animation overlay with a specific hit reaction clip.
methods.setDesiredPainOverlayAnims: Configures pain animation overlays matching injured limb status.
methods.setEquipmentInHand: Updates weapon grip attachment points and stance requirements for newly equipped items.
methods.setLegDamage: Applies limping and crippled locomotion penalties based on damaged left/right legs.
methods.setMaximumSpeed: Sets the maximum locomotion velocity clamp for the character.
methods.setPosition: Sets the world space translation coordinates of the skeleton scene node.
methods.setSlaveHandle: Sets the entity handle of the interactive furniture object governing slave labor.
methods.setStance: Sets the character combat stance profile (e.g. upright, martial arts, defensive block).
methods.setStanceAnimation: Explicitly sets the stance idle animation clip to play on the character.
methods.setStealthMode: Enables or disables sneaking posture, crouching animations, and silent footsteps.
methods.setStrafeSpeed: Sets the lateral strafe velocity component for directional locomotion blending.
methods.setWeatherType: Configures weather reaction animations (e.g. shielding eyes from dust storms, acid rain flinching).
methods.setupRagdoll: Builds Havok/PhysX multi-body ragdoll articulation matching the character skeleton geometry.
methods.slaveAttachToBoneMode: Enables or disables bone attachment mode during synchronized interaction animations.
methods.startAnimation: Fades in and begins playback of an animation clip on the specified layer channel.
methods.startCombatAnimation: Starts playback of an offensive martial arts or weapon attack technique on upper/lower animation layers.
methods.startStumble: Triggers a reactive hit stumble animation in response to a melee or ranged impact, interrupting current actions.
methods.stopAction: Fades out and stops the currently active upper-body action clip.
methods.stopAnimation: Fades out and stops playback of the specified animation clip.
methods.threadSafeRagdollUpdateUT: Performs thread-safe synchronization of PhysX ragdoll transform matrices with visual bone skeletons.
methods.update: Primary simulation tick arbitrating upper/lower body animation selection, blending active skeletal clips, evaluating stumbles, and advancing playback time.
methods.updateAnimationCharacterEditor: Updates animation preview pose and slider morph transformations within character creation.
methods.updateAnimationTransforms: Flushes calculated skeletal bone matrix transformations into Ogre scene nodes and PhysX collision hulls.
methods.updateThreaded: Thread-safe parallel animation update evaluating skeletal bone hierarchies and computing track weights across background worker threads.
methods.~AnimationClass: Virtual destructor releasing all active skeletal animation states, tearing down PhysX ragdoll bindings, and unregistering motion filters.
methods.getCombatAnimCount: Returns the number of combat attack and block animation clips registered for current equipment.
methods.getCurrentAnimation: Returns the `AnimationData` pointer for the currently playing primary animation track.
methods.getCurrentAnimationData: Retrieves active animation playback state and timing metadata for current track.
methods.getFloorContactOffset: Calculates vertical height offset between root bone position and terrain surface contact.
methods.getHighestAnimationRequirement: Returns the highest priority `AnimationRequirement` constraint currently enforced.
methods.getInterpAnimPercent: Returns interpolation blend percentage between current locomotion clip and transition target.
methods.getMasterSpeed: Returns the master animation playback speed scale multiplier.
methods.getMovement: Returns a pointer to the character locomotion kinematics and movement controller.
methods.getMovementAnimTime: Returns current playback timeline position in seconds for the active locomotion animation.
methods.getPlayBackSpeed: Calculates effective playback rate factoring character stats, encumbrance, and injuries.
methods.getRagdollState: Returns the current PhysX physical simulation state of the character ragdoll.
methods.getRootBonePosition: Returns the current 3D world space coordinates of the skeleton root pelvis bone.
methods.getRootRelocation: Returns the root motion delta translation vector accumulated during the current frame.
methods.getRunningStrafeAnim: Selects the appropriate directional strafing or running animation clip based on movement vector.
methods.getStanceAnim: Returns the active stance animation clip for current weapon grip and combat posture.
methods.getTurningAnim: Selects the appropriate stationary turning animation clip based on angular rotation velocity.
methods.hasAnim: Returns true if the skeleton rig has an animation clip matching the specified name.
methods.hasCombatAnimationFinished: Returns true if the active attack or block animation has passed its recovery keyframe.
methods.init: Initializes animation states, binding skeleton bones, material channels, and ragdoll joints.
methods.initialiseRagdollParameters: Sets up joint limits, angular damping, and collision masks for PhysX ragdoll capsules.
methods.initialiseRagdollState: Zeros velocity vectors and aligns PhysX ragdoll rigid bodies to current bone matrices.
methods.isActionAnimating: Returns true if an upper-body or interaction action animation is currently playing.
methods.isActionDone: Returns true if the currently queued action animation has completed playback.
methods.isActionDoneRepeating: Returns true if a repeating action animation cycle has finished its current loop.

properties._base: Inherited base animation coordinator managing Ogre skeleton, master playback speed, and layer channels.
properties.animationRequirements: Cached character stance, movement speed, weapon held, and injury state flags.
properties.appearance: Character cosmetic appearance, skeletal proportions, and body morph target controller.
properties.bootHeight: Footwear sole thickness compensation offset preventing ground mesh penetration.
properties.defaultIdleAnimation: Fallback idle fidget animation clip when no specific stance idle is active.

properties.feetHeight: Ground height vertical offset for foot-plant clamping and ground alignment.
properties.me: Back-pointer to owning character actor entity.

properties.ragdollAnimation: Skeletal bone kinematic ragdoll blending coupler.

methods.AnimationClassAnimal: Constructor for `AnimationClassAnimal`. Initializes the underlying animation system and specifically configures animal-specific state and settings.
methods.calculatePositionWithWaterHeight: Calculates the vertical positioning for the animal taking water depth into consideration. Adjusts the node positioning offset so the head remains above the water level, reading from the `Bip01 Head` bone and current water height.
methods.create: Initializes the `AnimationClassAnimal` instance using character movement and appearance data. Sets up the character's turn rate from race data and constructs the `AppearanceAnimal` component. It also determines the appropriate idle stance from the appearance settings or falls back to defaults.
methods.getIdleAnimation: Returns the string identifier or reference for the animal's idle animation. Used for default state rendering.
methods.isHuman: Virtual method override checking if the entity is human. This will always return false for an `AnimationClassAnimal`.
methods.isTurning: Checks if the animal is currently executing a turning movement. Consults internal flags related to orientation velocity.
methods.isTurningFar: Retrieves the `_isTurningFar` flag state, which indicates if the animal's target orientation is far from its current orientation. Evaluated during sharp rotational changes.
methods.rotationUpdate: Performs the per-frame rotation update logic. It calculates the necessary orientation changes based on the animal's turn speed and time elapsed. It additionally adjusts normal vectors if the character is in water and interacting with the ground. It sets the `_isTurningFar` flag if the required rotation exceeds a single step's delta.
methods.~AnimationClassAnimal: Destructor for `AnimationClassAnimal`. Cleans up resources allocated by the animal animation component.

properties._isTurningFar: Flag indicating sharp angle turning threshold exceeded.
properties.lastRot: Previous frame orientation for delta yaw calculation.

AnimationClassBase.description: Core skeletal animation subsystem base class for characters and creatures in Kenshi. Manages skeletal bone queries, world-space and local-space bone caching, animation track blending across layered channels (`AnimationLayer`), root motion relocation, and playback timing synchronization with the locomotion kinematic controller (`CharMovement`).

methods.AnimationClassBase: Primary constructor for `AnimationClassBase`. Initializes master playback timeline (`masterTime = 0.0f`), playback speed scale (`masterSpeed = 1.0f`), orientation quaternion, and layer container.
methods._getBone: Resolves an individual skeletal bone pointer (`Ogre::OldBone*`) by case-sensitive bone name string from the skeleton instance.
methods.clearAllAnimationUT: Clears all animation layers immediately without thread synchronization locks (unsafe / internal use).
methods.create: Binds locomotion kinematic interface (`CharMovement*`), allocates skeletal animation layers (LOWER, UPPER, OVERLAY, TAIL, EARS), and initializes bone transform cache.
methods.getAnimation: Resolves underlying Ogre `Animation*` definition from the skeleton instance.
methods.getAnimationCurrentWeight: Queries the current blend weight [0.0, 1.0] of the specified `AnimationData` track.
methods.getAnimationPlaying: Searches all animation layers for an active `SingleAnimation*` executing the specified combat technique.
methods.getAnimationPlaying_animName: Searches all animation layers for an active `SingleAnimation*` matching the given internal clip name.
methods.getAnimationPlaying_datName: Searches all animation layers for an active `SingleAnimation*` matching the FCS template identifier string.
methods.getAnimationProgress: Calculates normalized playback progress [0.0, 1.0] for the active combat technique animation.
methods.getAnimationState: Resolves underlying Ogre `AnimationState*` for the named clip from the mesh entity.
methods.getAnimation_Lockpick: Resolves the appropriate lockpicking animation track based on lock mechanism height and character posture (standing vs kneeling).
methods.getAnimation_Medic: Resolves the appropriate medical first-aid treatment animation track based on patient posture, height, and target limb.
methods.getBoneInitialLocalOrientation: Retrieves initial bind-pose local orientation quaternion of the named bone.
methods.getBoneInitialLocalPosition: Retrieves initial bind-pose local position of the named bone before animation deformation.
methods.getBoneInitialWorldOrientation: Retrieves cached bind-pose world orientation quaternion of the named bone from `boneInitialWorldOrientations`.
methods.getBoneInitialWorldPosition: Retrieves cached bind-pose world position of the named bone from `boneInitialWorldPositions`.
methods.getBoneLocalOrientation: Retrieves local orientation quaternion of the named bone relative to its parent bone.
methods.getBoneLocalPosition: Retrieves local position vector of the named bone relative to its parent bone in the skeletal hierarchy.
methods.getBoneWorldOrientation: Computes world-space orientation quaternion of the named bone by combining scene node orientation with bone hierarchy rotation.
methods.getBoneWorldPosition: Computes world-space 3D coordinates of the named bone, applying parent node translation, skeletal rotations, and optional scaling factor.
methods.getCharacter: Retrieves owning `Character` entity linked to this animation controller via `movement`.
methods.getHasBone: Queries whether the skeletal rig contains a bone with the specified name.
methods.getMasterTime: Retrieves the accumulated master animation clock time in seconds (`masterTime`).
methods.getMasterTimeSpeed: Queries the global animation playback speed multiplier.
methods.getOrientation: Returns current target character orientation quaternion (`desiredOrientation`).
methods.getRootBoneLocalPosition: Returns local position offset of the root motion bone relative to the character scene node origin.
methods.getRootBoneWorldPosition: Returns world-space position of the root motion bone (`rootBonePosition`).
methods.getSceneNodeOrientation: Retrieves world orientation quaternion of the character's primary scene node.
methods.getSceneNodePosition: Retrieves world position of the character's primary Ogre scene node (`node`).
methods.getTotalActionAnimationWeight: Sums the total active blend weight across all upper body and whole body action animation tracks.
methods.getVisible: Queries whether the mesh entity is currently visible.
methods.hasAnimation: Queries whether the mesh entity contains an animation clip matching the specified string identifier.
methods.initBoneInitialWorldPositions: Traverses the skeletal hierarchy in bind pose, caching initial world-space bone positions and orientations into lookup maps.
methods.isAnimationPlaying: Queries whether an animation matching the specified clip name is currently active and blending with non-zero weight.
methods.isVisibleEntity: Checks if the Ogre rendering entity (`body`) exists and is attached to a visible scene node.
methods.resetOrientation: Resets character scene node orientation and desired orientation quaternion to identity.
methods.setMasterTimeSpeed: Sets the global animation playback speed multiplier (`masterSpeed`), scaling playback rates uniformly across all active tracks and layers.
methods.setVerticalPosition: Applies a vertical elevation offset to the character's visual mesh and scene node (e.g. bed height, chair elevation, or water immersion depth).
methods.setVisible: Controls visibility of the underlying Ogre 3D mesh entity (`body`) and associated scene graph node.
methods.stillPlayingAnActionOrSomething: Tests whether an action animation (e.g. attack strike, lockpick, medical treatment, stumble) is actively playing and preventing transition to idle.
methods.stopAllAnimation: Stops all active animations across all layers. If `hardStop` is true, immediately zeroes blend weights; otherwise initiates smooth fade-out.
methods.~AnimationClassBase: Virtual destructor stopping active animations, clearing animation layers, freeing bone transform maps, and unlinking from character movement controller.

properties.boneInitialWorldOrientations: Cached base rest-pose world bone orientations.
properties.boneInitialWorldPositions: Cached base rest-pose world bone positions.
properties.masterSpeed: Global animation playback speed scale multiplier.
properties.masterTime: Master animation timeline clock in seconds.

methods.AnimationClassHuman: Initializes a new `AnimationClassHuman` instance. This class builds on `AnimationClass` to manage human-specific animation states.
methods.animationSelectionCombatMode: Updates the animation logic when the character is engaged in combat mode. Selects proper strikes and parries.
methods.breathing: Applies a procedural breathing animation layer based on stealth states, current activity, and timers.
methods.calculatePositionWithWaterHeight: Adjusts character position calculations based on the local water height. Used to seamlessly blend swimming animations.
methods.calculatehipspos: Updates the cached `hipspos` by computing the position of the character's pelvis bone. Important for IK and movement scaling.
methods.canUseArmAnim: Determines if an animation involving arms can be played based on whether limbs are missing or occupied.
methods.create: Creates and links the animation state with a specific character object. Initializes the necessary skeleton mapping.
methods.getFloatingAnim: Retrieves the name of the animation to use when the human character is floating in water.
methods.getLookDirection: Fetches the current gaze vector being used for the character's head tracking.
methods.getStandingUpAnim: Retrieves the name of the animation to use when recovering from a prone or knocked-down state.
methods.isHuman: Returns true as this class specifically handles human animations. Overrides the base class check.
methods.lookAt: Directs the human skeleton's head to look at a given coordinate. Used for procedural gaze tracking.
methods.overlaidAnimationSelection: Handles the complex selection and blending logic for additive overlays, such as pain or carry animations, over the base state.
methods.ragdollModeUT: Applies ragdoll physics state to the character. Often invoked when knocked out or killed.
methods.ragdollTheWeapons: Detaches or configures weapons to interact physically as ragdolls when dropped or during a full character ragdoll.
methods.setDesiredPainOverlayAnimOverride: Forces a specific pain animation overlay, overriding the procedural blending.
methods.setDesiredPainOverlayAnims: Sets multiple pain overlay animations to reflect injuries (e.g., limping, holding arm).
methods.setEquipmentInHand: Informs the animation state machine that weapons or items are held, modifying IK targets and idle poses.
methods.setStance: Updates the animation stance flags and queues necessary stance transitions.
methods.setStanceAnimation: Triggers an explicit stance animation, changing how the human stands (e.g., combat, relaxed).
methods.update: Main frame update loop for the human animation component. Steps logic and blends layers.
methods.~AnimationClassHuman: Destructor for the human animation class. Cleans up any resources tied to human-specific IK and animation.

properties.breathePeaks: Breathing cycle animation blend curve keyframes.
properties.breatheTimer: Procedural idle chest breathing phase timer.
properties.disabledLeftArm: Left arm crippled or severed flag.
properties.disabledRightArm: Right arm crippled or severed flag.
properties.hipspos: Cached pelvis/hips origin in skeletal space.
properties.usingLeftArm: Whether left arm is actively occupied.
properties.usingRightArm: Whether right arm is actively occupied by a primary action.

AnimationData.description: Animation clip record storing character animation data and mode requirements.

methods.AnimationData: Constructor for the `AnimationData` class. Initializes an instance by decoding animation descriptors and setup properties from a provided database `GameData` structure.
methods.checkModes: Determines if the animation's designated mode flags (such as combat mode and stealth mode) align with the requester's actual stance.
methods.checkWeaponArms: Evaluates whether the animation is valid based on the character's weapon-wielding arm status. Returns true if the animation matches the arm requirements (broken/usable) compared to the current character state.
methods.scoreCarryMode: Determines the suitability of the animation regarding the entity's carry state (carrying left, right, or being carried). Applies multipliers or penalties to the score if the requested animation fails to match carry configuration.
methods.scoreInjury: Computes an affinity score based on the leg injury level required by this animation. Compares the provided left or right leg health from requirements against the animation's defined min/max and ideal damage ranges.
methods.scoreSpeed: Generates a match score for how well the animation represents the character's target velocity. This utilizes a custom scoring curve normalized through a sigmoid-like logistic function that dampens deviations around the ideal speed.
methods.scoreWeaponType: Checks if the equipped weapon classification on the entity aligns with the `weaponTypeFlags` bitmask of the animation. Used extensively in filtering combat swings and stances based on weapon weight class and grip type.

properties._rawData: Raw GameData reference from game database.
properties.animName: Underlying OGRE skeleton animation clip name.
properties.category: High-level animation category (walk, run, combat, idle, stumble).
properties.idealMoveSpeed: Natural locomotion speed for 1.0 animation playback rate.
properties.idleChance: Relative chance weight among competing idle anims.
properties.legDamageLIdeal: Optimal left leg injury for limping animation match.
properties.legDamageLmin: Left leg minimum injury curve score.
properties.legDamageRIdeal: Optimal right leg injury for limping animation match.
properties.legDamageRmin: Right leg minimum injury curve score.
properties.relocates: True if animation root moves from origin.
properties.stumbleBodyParts: Anatomical parts that can trigger this stumble.
properties.stumbleOrigination: Directional impulse source for stumble reaction.
properties.usesLeftArm: Left arm bone animation channel active.
properties.usesRightArm: Right arm bone animation channel active.

methods.AnimationEvents: Constructs an instance of the `AnimationEvents` structure. Associates the events with a specific `Character` pointer to allow event callbacks to operate on the corresponding actor.
methods.addEvent: Inserts a new `AnimationEvent` into the sorted array of sequenced events. Reallocates the internal tracking array dynamically if its capacity is exceeded, inserting the event sequentially based on its trigger time.
methods.addList: Bulk insertion utility method that consumes an unordered map of game data references to their timestamps and sequencially inserts each into the underlying array.
methods.setInitialFrame: Initializes the starting frame value to correctly begin interval checking for events. Used when resetting an animation or initially binding an animation timeline.
methods.size: Retrieves the count of events currently queued within the sequence array.
methods.update: Progresses the animation event interval checker to the provided frame. It fires all animation event callbacks for any sequenced events that have been passed between the `lastFrame` and the current `frame`.
methods.~AnimationEvents: Destructs the `AnimationEvents` structure. Cleans up the internal `lektor` array and clears event sequence allocations.

properties.character: Bound character actor receiving event callbacks.
properties.events: Array of sequenced animation events and their trigger timestamps.
properties.lastFrame: Previous animation frame position for interval checking.
properties.nextEvent: Index of the upcoming event in the sorted event sequence.

AppearanceAnimal.description: Creature appearance specialist governing age-based scaling (pup to elder), color palettes, horns/shells, and non-humanoid anatomical variations.

methods.createBody: Creates the animal's Ogre scene entity and initializes its mesh geometry.
methods.updateCharaterTexture: Updates the animal's texture layers, skin maps, and material passes.
methods.~AppearanceAnimal: Destructs the `AppearanceAnimal` instance and releases allocated resources.

properties._base: Base appearance system, bone scales, and mesh attachments.
properties.ageScale: Age-based growth scale scaling animal body size from pup to elder.
properties.hasHornsOrShell: Feature toggle for auxiliary creature mesh geometry.

AppearanceBase.description: Base visual appearance and 3D mesh deformation controller for all characters and creatures in Kenshi. Manages skeletal bone morphing, slider-driven body proportions (`GameDataCopyStandalone*`), equipment and weapon slot attachments (`AttachedEntity`), embedded projectile harpoons, bleeding wound decals (`Wound*`), dynamic blood and wetness shaders, and UI portrait rendering generation.

methods.AppearanceBase: Primary constructor for `AppearanceBase`. Initializes attachment containers, wound lists, mutex locks (`woundsListMutex`), binds owning character (`Character* me`), animation controller (`AnimationClass* animation`), race data, and standalone appearance customization copy (`GameDataCopyStandalone*`).
methods._detachAllHarpoons: Internal execution routine detaching and deallocating all harpoons in `attachedHarpoons`.
methods.activate: Activates the appearance subsystem, attaching Ogre scene nodes to the scene graph and enabling visual rendering updates.
methods.addWound: Appends a visual bleeding wound decal to `woundsList` under `woundsListMutex` lock.
methods.affectsPortrait: Checks whether an attached item (e.g. helmet, hat) occludes the face and affects UI portrait generation.
methods.attachEffect: Instantiates and attaches a visual particle system or light effect to a skeletal bone with transform offsets.
methods.attachEntity: Binds an `AttachedObject` scene node to its corresponding skeletal bone attachment tag on the skeleton.
methods.attachHarpoon: Attaches an embedded projectile harpoon to a specified bone with custom spatial offset and orientation.
methods.attachItem: Attaches an equipment item to a specified body slot using an explicit mesh asset override.
methods.attachItem_Hair: Attaches a hairstyle or beard mesh to the character head slot, configuring hair materials and color tints.
methods.buildAttachments: Iterates attached objects map and constructs underlying Ogre entities and scene node hierarchies.
methods.buildBody: Callback invoked upon completion of asynchronous mesh loading, initializing submesh buffers, skinning weights, and morph targets.
methods.chooseBodyMesh: Determines the appropriate base `.mesh` asset filename based on race data, gender, and anatomical variations.
methods.createAttachedObject: Factory method instantiating an `AttachedEntity` descriptor corresponding to an equipment `Item*`.
methods.createBody: Creates and initializes the character's base body mesh entity.
methods.createEntity: Constructs an `Ogre::Entity` instance for the specified `AttachedEntity`, configuring materials and submesh textures.
methods.createEntityCallback: Resource callback triggered when an attached gear mesh finishes background disk streaming.
methods.createPhysicsAttachment: Binds a dynamic PhysX physical collision attachment to the specified gear item.
methods.deactivate: Deactivates the appearance subsystem, detaching scene nodes from scene graph and disabling animation transforms and rendering updates.
methods.detachAllHarpoonsT: Thread-safe interface requesting asynchronous detachment and purging of all embedded harpoons.
methods.detachHarpoon: Detaches and destroys a single embedded harpoon entity from character mesh.
methods.detachItem: Detaches visual mesh and physical scene node corresponding to the specified equipment item.
methods.failedToLoad: Queries whether asynchronous background loading of mesh or skeleton resources encountered a failure.
methods.forceUpdateAnimationTransforms: Unconditionally forces full re-synchronization of all attached gear, weapons, and particle effect nodes to current bone matrices.
methods.getAnimationSystem: Retrieves the linked skeletal animation controller managing tracks and blends.
methods.getAppearanceData: Retrieves the active appearance customization dataset containing slider values and morph weights.
methods.getAttachedEntity: Retrieves the `AttachedEntity*` descriptor occupying a specific equipment slot.
methods.getAttachmentPosition: Queries the computed world-space position and rotation quaternion of an attachment slot.
methods.getAttachmentsLoaded: Checks whether all pending asynchronous attachment mesh and material resources have finished loading.
methods.getBody: Retrieves the main visual mesh entity (`Ogre::Entity* body`) representing the character's base anatomical body.
methods.getBodyRadius: Queries the approximate bounding sphere radius encompassing the character's physical body mesh in meters.
methods.getBoneOrientation: Queries the global world orientation quaternion of a named skeletal bone.
methods.getBonePosition: Queries the global world position coordinates of a named skeletal bone.
methods.getCharacterHeight: Queries the absolute world height of the character in meters from feet to head.
methods.getCharacterHeightSpeedMultiplier: Computes locomotion speed multiplier derived from character leg height proportions.
methods.getLights: Populates list with pointers to all attached `Ogre::Light*` instances.
methods.getNormalisedCharacterHeight: Queries normalized character height scalar (0.0 to 1.0) configured via character editor appearance sliders.
methods.getRace: Queries the race definition `GameData*` governing base anatomical meshes, textures, and slider ranges.
methods.getRandomVertex: Selects a random vertex index on the mesh surface filtered by a spatial cardinal direction (e.g. FRONT, BACK, TOP) for decal/blood placement.
methods.getRandomVertexPosition: Queries the 3D position of a direction-filtered random surface vertex for particle or blood spatter generation.
methods.getSceneNode: Retrieves the root Ogre scene node to which the character mesh and attachments are bound.
methods.getSkeleton: Retrieves the active Ogre skeleton instance driving character animations and bone morphing.
methods.getSlotPosition: Calculates local translation and orientation offsets for an attachment slot relative to its host skeletal bone.
methods.getVertexPosition: Queries the local rest-pose 3D position of a specific vertex index in the body mesh.
methods.getVertexWorldPosition: Transforms a local mesh vertex coordinate into world space using the transformation matrix of its binding bone.
methods.getVisible: Queries whether character body mesh is currently visible in the scene graph.
methods.hasLights: Queries whether character possesses any active attached light emitters.
methods.hasSlot: Queries whether the character rig supports a named attachment slot.
methods.isBarefoot: Checks whether the character's footwear slot is empty and feet are barefoot.
methods.isFemale: Queries whether the character is configured with female anatomy and mesh structures.
methods.isFlayed: Queries whether the character is currently in a flayed skin state.
methods.isShaved: Queries whether character head is currently flagged as shaved.
methods.notifyDirty: Sets internal dirty flags indicating appearance parameters have modified and require re-evaluation on next frame.
methods.periodicUpdate: Periodic low-frequency update routine evaluating water immersion line fading, bleeding drip emission, and body wetness decay.
methods.reload: Forces a complete reload and reconstruction of the body mesh, materials, textures, and all item attachments.
methods.removeEffect: Detaches and deallocates an attached particle system or visual effect.
methods.removeWound: Removes a healed wound decal from `woundsList` under mutex synchronization.
methods.serialise: Serializes appearance slider values, skin color, gender, and hair configurations into `GameData* state` for save game persistence.
methods.setAppearanceData: Binds a new appearance customization dataset (`GameDataCopyStandalone*`), marking visual meshes and bone morph weights dirty.
methods.setAttachmentsVisible: Toggles rendering visibility for all attached equipment and weapon meshes.
methods.setFlayed: Enables or disables flayed flesh mode, swapping skin textures with raw bloody muscle tissue (used by Fogmen / Peeler machines).
methods.setGender: Sets character gender flag, rebuilding body mesh and swapping between male and female mesh/texture variations.
methods.setHairTexture: Applies custom texture maps and color tints to character hair or beard geometry.
methods.setVisible: Toggles master rendering visibility for the character body mesh entity and attached scene components.
methods.setupCharacterEntityTexture: Virtual hook generating composite skin texture for character body entity from multiple layered skin and decal maps.
methods.setupHairMaterial: Configures hair shader parameters, setting alpha blending thresholds, diffuse tints, and specular highlights.
methods.setupItemMaterial: Instantiates and configures custom shader materials on attached armor/weapon items, applying faction color tints and wear layers.
methods.shaveHead: Sets the shaved head state, hiding hair mesh geometry to prevent clipping when wearing enclosed helmets.
methods.switchLights: Toggles illumination for attached light sources (e.g. belt lanterns).
methods.update: Per-frame core appearance update step. Updates animation transforms, synchronizes attached harpoons and lights, and checks background loading state.
methods.updateAnimationTransforms: Synchronizes attachment scene nodes and physical gear meshes to current skeletal bone animation transformation matrices if dirty.
methods.updateAppearance: Recalculates bone scales, morph target blend weights, body proportions, and skin composite textures from appearance data.
methods.updateBloodyness: Updates dynamic blood spatter textures across body and attached armor based on accumulated combat damage.
methods.updateCharaterTexture: Rebuilds and composites the character's skin and body textures.
methods.updateMovementScale: Computes character stride kinematics scaling factor based on leg length and overall height, passing the scalar multiplier to `AnimationClass`.
methods.updateOverlap: Evaluates body mesh and armor overlaps, hiding occluded body submeshes to eliminate mesh clipping through armor.
methods.updatePortrait: Signals character portrait capture camera to re-render UI portrait icon following appearance or gear changes.
methods.updateWetness: Updates body surface wetness shaders and water level submersion planes, adjusting material specular gloss.
methods.~AppearanceBase: Virtual destructor for `AppearanceBase`. Destroys attached visual entities, removes particle effects, detaches embedded harpoons, clears wound arrays under mutex protection, and detaches body entity from scene node.

AppearanceHuman.description: Humanoid character appearance specialist managing facial features, hair/beard styling, gender dimorphism, chest/waist proportions, and skin normal overlays.

methods.createBody: Creates the human character's Ogre scene entity and initializes body mesh geometry.
methods.isFlayed: Returns true if the humanoid character has the flayed skin texture variant applied.
methods.periodicUpdate: Performs periodic visual updates for equipment attachments, wetness, blood, and clothing visibility.
methods.setAttachmentsVisible: Shows or hides all attached equipment and cosmetic meshes on this humanoid model.
methods.setFlayed: Sets whether the humanoid character displays the flayed skin visual texture.
methods.setGender: Sets the biological gender of the humanoid model (`true` for female, `false` for male), updating meshes and blendshapes.
methods.setHiddenPartsEnabled: Toggles body mesh segment hiding when covered by clothing or armour items.
methods.setPosture: Adjusts visual posture bones and spine offsets for the humanoid character.
methods.setupCharacterEntityTexture: Rebuilds composite skin and equipment texture layers for the humanoid entity.
methods.showFace: Sets whether the character's facial features and hair are visible or hidden by headgear.
methods.updateAppearance: Updates the character's complete visual appearance, applying proportion, texture, and attachment changes.
methods.updateCharaterTexture: Updates the composite character texture layers including skin tone, scars, body paint, and dirt.
methods.updateHiddenParts: Updates mesh sub-part visibility masks to hide body sections covered by equipped armor.
methods.updatePhysiqueMuscleMults: Updates muscle and bulk scaling factors from the character's physical stats.
methods.updateProportions: Recalculates bone scales and body mesh deformations from character appearance sliders and stats.
methods.updatePysiqueFromStats: Recalculates character muscle, bulk, and skinny physique values based on current stats and hunger.

AppearanceManager.description: Singleton manager responsible for character appearance configuration, facial morphs, race presets, and body customization.

methods.cleanValidateAppearanceData: Validates and sanitizes the given appearance GameData, removing invalid or out-of-range records.

methods.getHeadIsValid: Returns true if the specified headData is valid for the given race and appearance GameData.

methods.getNormalMap_Muscle: Returns the muscular normal map texture filename for the given race GameData and gender.
methods.getNormalMap_Plain: Returns the standard plain normal map texture filename for the given race GameData and gender.
methods.getNormalMap_Starving: Returns the starving or emaciated normal map texture filename for the given race GameData and gender.

Armour.description: Represents an equippable piece of armour, handling defensive stats, bodypart coverage, encumbrance multipliers, and weather protections. Inherits from `Gear`.

methods.Armour: Constructs an `Armour` instance and initializes its extensive stat modifiers. The method pulls stats from the provided `baseData` and calculates final resistance and stat multipliers by blending material types and armour classes.
methods.didIHitFlesh: Determines whether an incoming attack completely bypassed the armour to strike flesh directly, based on the `bodypartCoverage` RNG check.
methods.getArmourCraftingMaterialConsumptionRate: A static utility method determining how quickly materials are consumed when crafting a specific piece of armour based on its total coverage.
methods.getClassType: Runtime type identification method returning the base item type enum.
methods.getCraftTime: Gets the base crafting time required to construct this armour piece.
methods.getItemWeight: Returns the physical weight of the armour. The base weight is initialized in the constructor but can be dynamically returned by this method.
methods.getTooltipData1: Populates the primary block of the tooltip UI. This section usually includes the armour's name, class, quality grade, coverage lists, and base defense stats (cut/blunt/pierce).
methods.getTooltipData2: Populates the secondary block of the tooltip UI. This section adds information on stat penalties/bonuses (stealth, combat speed, etc.), weight, monetary value, and environmental protections.
methods.getValueSingle: Calculates the item's monetary value when traded or generated, factoring in crafting status and faction uniforms.
methods.getWeatherProtection_simple: Queries the armour for protection against a specific environmental effect.
methods.hasArmourCoverage: Checks if the armour provides coverage to any body parts.
methods.isArmour: Runtime type identification method returning the `this` pointer cast to `Armour`.
methods.~Armour: Destroys the `Armour` instance, releasing allocated memory for the `bodypartCoverage` map and the `weatherProtections` set.

properties.armourClassEnum: Weight classification of the armour (ArmourClass, such as cloth, light, medium, or heavy).
properties.assassinMult: Multiplier applied to the wearer's assassination skill.
properties.athleticsMult: Multiplier applied to the wearer's athletics skill and run speed.
properties.bluntResistance: Fraction of incoming blunt damage mitigated by this armour.

properties.combatSpeedMult: Multiplier applied to the wearer's combat attack and block speed.
properties.craftTime: Total crafting time required to manufacture this armour piece.
properties.cutResistance: Fraction of incoming cutting damage mitigated by this armour.
properties.cutToStun: Fraction of resisted cutting damage that is converted into blunt stun damage.
properties.damageMult: Multiplier applied to the wearer's outgoing combat damage.
properties.dexterityMult: Multiplier applied to the wearer's dexterity stat.
properties.dodgeMult: Multiplier applied to the wearer's dodging skill.
properties.fistInjuryMult: Multiplier applied to self-inflicted fist damage when striking armoured targets unarmed.
properties.materialType: Surface hit material category (ArmourType) used for impact sounds and effects.
properties.minCutResistance: Minimum guaranteed cutting resistance fraction regardless of quality.
properties.perceptionBonus: Flat bonus or penalty applied to the wearer's perception skill.
properties.pierceResistance: Harpoon and ranged projectile damage resistance value.
properties.rangedSkillMult: Multiplier applied to the wearer's crossbow and ranged accuracy skills.
properties.stealthMult: Multiplier applied to the wearer's stealth skill.
properties.stigma: Character social stigma or disguise classification (CharacterTypeEnum) conferred by wearing this item.
properties.unarmedBonus: Flat bonus or penalty applied to the wearer's martial arts skill.
properties.weatherProtectionAmount: Protection fraction (0.0 to 1.0) provided against the weather types listed in weatherProtections.
properties.weatherProtections: Set of WeatherAffecting environmental hazard types this armour protects against.

AttachedArrowManager.description: Manages visual arrow and projectile meshes stuck into a character or used as stealth target indicator markers.

methods.addArrow: Attaches a new visual arrow entity connecting the start position table to target position table with the specified color index.
methods.clearAll: Removes and detaches all currently active arrow entity meshes.
methods.updateEnd: Finalizes the per-frame update cycle for attached arrows, hiding any unused entities.
methods.updateStart: Begins the per-frame update cycle for attached arrow visual entities.

properties.index: Current active arrow entity index counter.

AttackSlotManager.description: Tactical combat slot arbiter managing simultaneous melee engagement reservations around a defender. Enforces engine attack slot limits (vanilla default of 1 simultaneous attacker, moddable up to 5 via `MAX_NUM_ATTACK_SLOTS`), queues surplus attackers into waiting and circling states, detects slot timeouts, and notifies queued opponents via `informOfFreeAttackSlot` when slots become vacant.

methods.AttackSlotManager: Constructs the `AttackSlotManager` arbiter, binding the owning character and combat class references, and initializing all 5 `SlotData` records to empty null handles.
methods.addToSlotH: Claims an open attack slot for the requesting attacker handle. If the attacker already holds a slot, returns true; otherwise assigns the first vacant slot.
methods.freeAllSlotsH: Clears all 5 attack slots, releasing all reserved attacker handles and zeroing timers.
methods.freeSlotH: Releases the attack slot held by the specified attacker handle, clearing handle data and resetting the occupancy timer.
methods.getMaxPossibleAttackSlots: Retrieves the engine-wide global upper bound for attack slots from `g_globalConstants.MAX_NUM_ATTACK_SLOTS`.
methods.getNumAttackSlots: Calculates the effective maximum number of simultaneous attackers allowed against this defender, taking into account global constants, race bonuses, and passive states.
methods.hasFreeAttackSlot: Checks whether there is at least one unassigned attack slot available under the active slot limit (`getNumAttackSlots`).
methods.periodicUpdate: Low-frequency update loop. Increments slot timers, detects dead or incapacitated attackers, frees abandoned slots, and notifies queued opponents via `informOfFreeAttackSlot`.
methods.update: Per-frame tick hook for attack slot adjustments.
methods.~AttackSlotManager: Destructs the `AttackSlotManager` instance, cleaning up all `SlotData` elements.

properties.attackSlotH: Fixed array of 5 engagement slot entries, each holding attacker handle `who` and occupancy timer `time`.
properties.combatClass: Parent combat coordinator controlling state machine transitions.
properties.me: Owner character whose immediate combat perimeter is governed by this slot manager.

methods.flush: Swaps background thread messages into the main thread buffer, returning true if any messages were transferred.

methods.initialise: Loads and initializes the specified MyGUI layout file with optional parent widget and error handling.
methods.snapToParent: Snaps and aligns the position and dimensions of a child widget to match its parent container.

properties.mMainWidget: The root MyGUI widget of the loaded layout hierarchy.

methods.GetKenshiVersion: Static or instance method that returns the current running Kenshi binary version.
methods.GetPlatform: Returns the platform enumeration value (GOG, STEAM, or UNKNOWN) for this binary version.
methods.GetPlatformStr: Returns the platform name string ('Steam', 'GOG', or 'Unknown') for this binary version.
methods.GetVersion: Returns the version number string (such as '1.0.65') of this binary version.
methods.ToString: Returns a formatted string containing both the version number and platform name.
methods.getBinaryName: Returns the expected executable filename ('Kenshi_x64.exe' or 'Kenshi_GOG_x64.exe') for this binary version.
methods.getKenshiVersion: Static or instance method that returns the current running Kenshi binary version.
methods.getPlatform: Returns the platform enumeration value (GOG, STEAM, or UNKNOWN) for this binary version.
methods.getPlatformStr: Returns the platform name string ('Steam', 'GOG', or 'Unknown') for this binary version.
methods.getVersion: Returns the version number string (such as '1.0.65') of this binary version.
methods.new: Constructs a new BinaryVersion instance from a platform integer and a version string.
methods.operator_eq: Compares two BinaryVersion instances for equality across version string and platform.
methods.operator_lt: Compares two BinaryVersion instances to determine ordering based on version and platform.
methods.toString: Returns a formatted string containing both the version number and platform name.
