properties.platform: The platform enumeration value (GOG, STEAM, or UNKNOWN).

Blackboard.description: Shared AI coordination state and package execution manager for squads, tracking queued AIPackages, priority tiers, and active contract jobs.

methods.Blackboard: Constructs a new Blackboard instance and ties it to a target platoon. It initializes all the unordered maps and standard tracking handles required for AI routines.
methods._activateCurrentPackage: Suspends or clears the currently executing package, resetting local tracking flags. Replaces it with the provided new `AIPackage` reference.
methods._addFromData: Decodes a serialized behavior tree payload into local instances and loads them onto the active execution stack.
methods._addPackage: Enqueues an AI task definition into the priority tier queues without immediately executing it. Allows complex queuing of behaviors over time.
methods._setContractJob: Assigns an overriding mercenary contract task at a specific priority. Halts lower priority goals.
methods.clearAllPackages: Iterates through `packagesMain` queues and terminates all pending or active routines. Used during platoon destruction or combat override.
methods.createNewPackage: Constructs a new `AIPackage` derivative based on `typeId` (such as `Package_OccupyTown` or `CannibalRetreatFromRaid`). Connects relevant callback functions.
methods.dialogEventsCheck: Validates and polls conditions matching current dialog hooks against incoming game events. Often transitions an NPC's behavior state depending on dialog outcome.
methods.endContractJob: Concludes the currently active mercenary contract package. Triggers dialog/payment handlers for successful termination.
methods.getPackage: Searches the queued priority map for a specific task package by its internal string identifier.
methods.getPackageList: Retrieves the underlying queue struct associated with a requested priority level from `packagesMain`.
methods.isMissionComplete: Checks if the main directive tied to the squad's primary `AIPackage` has fulfilled its goal conditions.
methods.isTargetMarkedForDeath: Tests if a target building belongs to a faction currently marked for destruction by the active occupation behavior.
methods.periodicPackageCheck: Evaluates queued packages based on a specified priority slice. Ensures packages are still valid for their given goal conditions and purges completed tasks.
methods.resetAllTheStaticData: Clears global/static constraints from the blackboard states. Restores variables associated with static behavior markers to baseline.
methods.setContractJob: Extracts standard contract behavior from `GameData` by looking up the "AI contract" entry in the parameters unordered map. If validated, pushes down into `_setContractJob`.
methods.update: Ticks the active behavior packages within the blackboard. Determines if new conditions have invalidated the current goal and handles scheduling logic.
methods.~Blackboard: Destructs the blackboard, freeing allocated memory for `AIPackage` references inside the `packagesMain` queues.

properties.cageMarkedForDeath: Cage handle of target marked for execution.
properties.replacementAIPackageSID: SID of package scheduled to replace current upon completion.

BoundsViolation.description: Exception struct thrown by Array2d operations when an attempted row or column index exceeds the container dimensions.

Bounty.description: Individual faction criminal bounty record. Tracks monetary reward, accumulated crime bitflags, claim status, and timestamp when the bounty was posted.

methods.addCrime: Adds the specified crime to the bounty record's committed crimes bitmask.
methods.hasCrime: Returns true if the bounty record includes the specified `CrimeEnum` violation (e.g. theft, assault, murder).

properties.amount: Monetary bounty reward amount in Cats.
properties.bountyAssignmentStartedTime: In-game timestamp when the bounty was first assigned.
properties.bountyHasBeenClaimedOnce: Flag indicating bounty payout has already been collected.

BountyManager.description: Law enforcement, criminal offense, and judicial bounty manager in Kenshi. Embedded within `Character::crimes`. Manages active faction bounties (`bounties`), witnessed criminal infractions (`committingCrime`, `crimeExpiry`), sovereign law-enforcement delegation (`_getBountyFaction`), temporary access authorizations (`_hasAccessPass`, `accessPassExpirationTime`), judicial incarceration sentencing (`prisonSentenceToServe`, `prisonSentenceBeganTime`), and police visual recognition thresholds (`getBountyRecognitionThreshold`).

methods.BountyManager: Primary constructor for `BountyManager`. Links the owning character entity (`Character* me`), initializes the faction bounty hash map (`bounties`), resets active crime tracking state, clears prison sentence variables, and sets default expiry timers.
methods._getBountyFaction: Resolves the governing law-enforcement faction associated with faction `f`, mapping subordinate or allied factions to their parent sovereign authority.
methods._getHighestBountyFaction: Iterates across all active bounties issued against this character, returning the faction that has posted the highest bounty reward.
methods.assignBountyForCrimes: Converts ongoing witnessed crimes into an official registered bounty under law-enforcement faction `enforcer`.
methods.bountyAlreadyBeenClaimedByPlayer: Queries whether the player faction has already claimed the bounty reward for this character from faction `whosLooking`, preventing duplicate rewards.
methods.clearBounty: Clears and forgives all criminal charges and bounty penalties issued by faction `enforcer` (e.g. after sentence completion, pacifier bribery, or expiration).
methods.crimeToStr: Static helper converting a `CrimeEnum` value into a localized user-facing string description for UI display.
methods.getActualBounty: Returns the exact actual numerical bounty value currently registered against this character by faction `whosLooking`.
methods.getBountyExpirationTime: Static calculation determining time in game hours until a low-level bounty naturally expires and drops off.
methods.getBountyExpiryStringForGUI: Formats a user-facing string detailing time remaining until active bounty expires, or 'Never' if permanent.
methods.getBountyForCrime: Static table lookup returning the baseline bounty monetary penalty (in Cats) assigned for a specific crime type.
methods.getBountyRecognitionThreshold: Queries the minimum bounty threshold required for guards and police to actively identify and attack or arrest this character on sight (typically 10,000 Cats).
methods.getGUIData: Generates localized UI datapanel label/value string pairs representing active criminal charges, highest bounty issuer, and reward sum.
methods.getGUIDataForAppend: Appends detailed breakdown of individual crimes committed against each faction to `outs` for extended UI inspect panels.
methods.getPercievedBounty: Calculates the perceived bounty value of this character from the perspective of an observing character (`whosLooking`), accounting for disguise effectiveness, faction allegiances, and recognition distance.
methods.getPrisonSentenceInHours: Static calculation deriving required prison incarceration duration in in-game hours from total bounty penalty value.
methods.getTotalBounty: Calculates the sum total of all active bounties across all factions currently wanted on this character.
methods.giveAccessPass: Grants a temporary authorized access pass from faction `who` valid for `minutes` in-game time.
methods.hasAccessPass: Evaluates whether this character holds an active, unexpired temporary authorized access pass granted by faction `forFac` (e.g. visiting nobility or holy nation clearances).
methods.isCommittingCrime: Queries whether character is currently engaged in an active, ongoing criminal act (`committingCrime != NO_CRIME`).
methods.load: Deserializes faction bounties, criminal charges, prison sentence timers, and temporary access passes from a `GameData* state` record during game loading.
methods.notifyCrimeWitnessed: Triggered when an NPC witnesses this character committing a crime. Sets expiry duration, alerts nearby guards, and registers criminal offense.
methods.notifyPlayerClaimBounty: Records that the player character faction has turned in this wanted outlaw to faction `whosLooking`, awarding reward Cats and flagging bounty as claimed.
methods.notifyPossibleCrimeWitnessed: Extends or refreshes potential crime suspicion timer when character is caught performing suspicious acts in guard line of sight.
methods.notifyStartPrisonSentence: Commences a formal prison sentence under law-enforcement faction `law`. Locks character into prison cage, calculates required sentence hours from bounty, and records sentence start timestamp.
methods.save: Serializes active bounties, committed crimes, remaining incarceration sentence durations, and access pass timestamps into `GameData* state` for save games.
methods.setCrime: Sets active ongoing crime state on character (e.g. lockpicking, stealing, trespassing, assault), recording the victim faction and victim entity handle.

Building.description: Master architectural and structural simulation entity representing buildings, outposts, town gates, defensive walls, manufacturing facilities, and interior furniture items. Manages construction material delivery, construction progress tracking, structural dismantling, town ownership, power grid connectivity, Havok navmesh cutouts, PhysX collision hulls, Ogre3D scene node hierarchies, positional audio emitters, interior visibility culling, and character job/usage interaction nodes. Interacts directly with `Town` for settlement ownership, `TownBuildingsManager` for municipal infrastructure, `BuildingInterior` for interior furniture layouts, `DoorStuff` for gateway/door security, `UsageNode` for worker and craft station bindings, and child specializations (`UseableStuff`, `StorageBuilding`, `ProductionBuilding`, `CraftingBuilding`, `FarmBuilding`, `WallBuilding`, `GatewayBuilding`).

methods.hasReplacement: Returns true if a replacement building exists for the specified building GameData.
methods.operator_assign: Copies the state of another BuildingSwaps instance into this instance and returns self.

properties.replaceWith: The GameDataFitnessSelector used to choose replacement buildings.
properties.toReplace: The set (OgreUnorderedSet<GameData>) of building GameData entries eligible to be replaced.

CPerfTimer.description: High-resolution performance counter and benchmarking timer wrapping Windows QueryPerformanceCounter.

methods.Elapsed: Returns the total elapsed time in seconds as a number.
methods.Elapsedms: Returns the total elapsed time in milliseconds as a number.
methods.Elapsedus: Returns the total elapsed time in microseconds as a number.
methods.IsRunning: Returns true if the performance counter is currently active and running.
methods.IsSupported: Static method returning true if the system hardware supports high-resolution performance counters.
methods.Resolution: Returns the timer resolution in seconds as a number.
methods.Resolutionms: Returns the timer resolution in milliseconds as a number.
methods.Resolutionus: Returns the timer resolution in microseconds as a number.
methods.Start: Starts or resumes the performance counter, optionally resetting elapsed time to 0 if bReset is true.
methods.Stop: Stops the performance counter and accumulates elapsed ticks.
methods.operator_add: Returns a new CPerfTimer representing the sum of this timer and another CPerfTimer or a duration in seconds.
methods.operator_add_assign: Adds another CPerfTimer or a duration in seconds to this timer in-place and returns self.
methods.operator_assign: Copies timing state from another CPerfTimer and returns self.
methods.operator_ge: Returns true if this timer elapsed duration is greater than or equal to another CPerfTimer or duration in seconds.
methods.operator_gt: Returns true if this timer elapsed duration is strictly greater than another CPerfTimer or duration in seconds.
methods.operator_le: Returns true if this timer elapsed duration is less than or equal to another CPerfTimer or duration in seconds.
methods.operator_lt: Returns true if this timer elapsed duration is strictly less than another CPerfTimer or duration in seconds.
methods.operator_sub: Returns a new CPerfTimer representing the difference between this timer and another CPerfTimer or a duration in seconds.
methods.operator_sub_assign: Subtracts another CPerfTimer or a duration in seconds from this timer in-place and returns self.

CPerfTimerT.description: Thread-safe high-resolution performance counter and timer protected by a synchronization mutex.

CameraClass.description: Controls the game viewport camera in Kenshi, managing camera position, yaw, pitch, zoom, target tracking, free-camera mode, and audio listener position.

methods.focusCameraOnObject: Centers and zooms the camera onto the specified RootObject with a Vector3 offset and optional nearZoom flag.
methods.followObject: Attaches the camera to continuously track and follow the object identified by the given hand handle.
methods.getCameraNode: Returns a raw pointer (lightuserdata) to the Ogre::SceneNode representing the camera eye position.
methods.getCameraPos: Returns the actual Vector3 world coordinates of the camera eye position.
methods.getCenter: Returns the Vector3 world coordinates of the camera's focus/pivot center.
methods.getCenterNode: Returns a raw pointer (lightuserdata) to the Ogre::SceneNode at the camera pivot center.
methods.getFacingDirection: Returns the normalized Vector3 forward facing direction vector of the camera.
methods.getFollowObject: Returns the hand handle of the object currently being followed by the camera.
methods.isFreeCameraMode: Returns true if free-flight (unlocked) camera mode is active.
methods.isInitialised: Returns true if the camera system has been initialized.
methods.isVisible: Returns true if the given Vector3 position (and optional sphere radius) is within the camera view frustum.
methods.load: Restores camera position, orientation, and zoom state from the provided GameData.
methods.manuallySetOrientationAndZoom: Manually overrides camera orientation with a Quaternion and sets the zoom distance.
methods.move: Translates the camera focus position by the given Vector3 displacement vector.
methods.reset: Resets camera position, orientation, altitude, and zoom to default values.
methods.restrictPosition: Clamps camera bounds to remain within range of the provided lektor<Character*> character collection.
methods.rotate: Rotates the camera orientation by the specified yaw and pitch delta angles.
methods.rotationUpdate: Updates camera rotation smoothing, inertia, and momentum.
methods.save: Serializes camera position, orientation, and zoom state into the provided GameData.
methods.setFreeCameraMode: Enables or disables free-flight (unlocked) camera mode.
methods.setZoomDist: Sets the target camera zoom distance.
methods.stopFollowing: Disengages camera tracking from any currently followed game object.
methods.teleport: Instantly relocates the camera focus point to the specified Vector3 world position.
methods.toGround: Clamps or smoothly lerps the camera height to the underlying terrain elevation.
methods.update: Updates camera orientation, position, and input controls each frame given a controlEnabled flag.
methods.updateAudio: Synchronizes the Wwise 3D audio listener position and orientation with the camera viewport.
methods.updateFreeCamera: Updates movement and control handling while in free-camera mode.
methods.updateOptionSettings: Reloads camera options, invert settings, and sensitivity preferences from user configuration.
methods.zoom: Adjusts camera zoom distance toward its target setting.

properties.altitude: Current altitude offset of the camera above the terrain.
properties.camera: Raw pointer (lightuserdata) to the underlying Ogre::Camera instance.
properties.center: Raw pointer (lightuserdata) to the Ogre::SceneNode at the camera focus center.
properties.centerBuilding: The Building instance located at the camera center, or nil if none.
properties.centerBuildingY: Vertical altitude offset associated with the center building.
properties.currentCollisionGroup: Collision mask flags applied to camera obstacle avoidance queries.
properties.currentFloor: Current building floor level the camera is focused on.
properties.currentMusic: ID or state index of the currently active background music track.
properties.freeCameraMode: Whether free-flight camera mode is enabled.
properties.inBuilding: The hand handle referencing the building the camera is currently inside.
properties.initialised: Whether the camera system has completed initialization.
properties.isRotating: Whether the camera is currently undergoing player-controlled rotation.
properties.node: Raw pointer (lightuserdata) to the camera's primary Ogre::SceneNode.
properties.objectCurrentlyFollowing: The hand handle of the object currently tracked by the camera.
properties.objectCurrentlyFollowingOffset: Positional Vector3 offset maintained relative to the followed object.
properties.pitch: Current camera pitch angle in degrees.
properties.rotationMarker: Raw pointer (lightuserdata) to the Ogre::Entity visual indicator shown during camera rotation.
properties.speedY: Vertical movement speed/velocity of the camera.
properties.targetPositionY: Target vertical Y coordinate the camera is interpolating toward.
properties.terrainLoaded: Whether terrain under the camera has finished loading.
properties.timeInGame: Elapsed in-game time accumulator tracked by the camera.
properties.yaw: Current camera yaw angle in degrees.

CampaignInstance.description: Active military expedition instance tracking marching forces, operational phases (Gathering, Assaulting, Retreating, Victory), destination waypoints, and casualties.

methods.CampaignInstance: Constructs a new `CampaignInstance` initialized with participating factions and home territory.
methods.changePhase: Transitions the expedition into a new strategic operational phase.
methods.getData: Retrieves the blueprint `CampaignData` record configuring this expedition.
methods.loadState: Restores campaign operational state, waypoint objectives, and troop census from save data.
methods.saveState: Serializes active campaign state, phases, and troop census into a savegame record.
methods.~CampaignInstance: Destructs the `CampaignInstance` and releases allocated military expedition resources.

properties.manPowerLastCount: Census of surviving forces at last evaluation.
properties.manPowerMin: Minimum troop strength threshold required to maintain assault.
properties.phaseChangeTime: Timestamp when active phase transition occurred.
properties.reachedDestination: Target settlement breach waypoint reached flag.
properties.timeWithNoEnemies: Elapsed duration with zero combat engagements.
properties.travelSpeedLoaded: Marching velocity when rendered in active reality.
properties.travelSpeedUnloaded: Marching velocity across background streaming terrain.

CampaignRequest.description: Represents a queued or pending campaign request managed by `FactionWarMgr` (wrapping `FactionWarMgr::CampaignRequest`).

methods.tryToChangeTarget: Attempts to find and assign an alternative valid target for this campaign request, returning true if successful.

properties.data: Read-only `lightuserdata` pointer to the underlying `CampaignData` object.
properties.enemy: Target enemy `Faction` for this campaign request.
properties.homeBase: Handle (`hand`) to the home town or base launching the campaign.
properties.numAttempts: Number of attempts made to launch or retarget this campaign request.
properties.target: Handle (`hand`) to the target town, base, or object of the campaign.
properties.timeToStart: Scheduled game time (`TimeOfDay`) when the campaign should begin.

CampaignTriggerData.description: Defines parameters for triggering a military or diplomatic campaign from dialogue, including the campaign template, delay window, and probability.

properties.chance: Probability weight or chance of triggering the campaign.
properties.maxTime: Maximum delay time before the triggered campaign starts.
properties.minTime: Minimum delay time before the triggered campaign starts.

CharBody.description: Motor controller and physical action execution layer in Kenshi. Embedded within `Character`. Bridges high-level AI decisions (`OrdersReceiver` and `Tasker`) to the physical game world by dispatching animations (`AnimationClass`), driving navmesh locomotion and crowd steering (`CharMovement`), triggering tactical combat actions (`CombatClassAI`), and managing atomic task lifecycles.

methods.CharBody: Primary constructor for `CharBody`. Initializes the virtual method table, resets target entity handle (`target`), clears stance flags (`gotItem`, `crouched`, `jogMode`, `amIdle`), zeroes delta frame timer (`frameTIME`), and nulls all active action and subsystem pointers.
methods._endAction: Internal virtual termination routine. Invokes `Tasker::endAction(this)` on active task, releases task memory via destructor, and clears `currentAction` pointer.
methods._move: Issues low-level locomotion request to destination vector `location` or interaction offset around target object `who`. Automatically adjusts approach offsets within weapon reach and switches movement mode based on sensory threat levels.
methods._patrol: Executes patrol route waypoint navigation within designated patrol area bounds and town perimeter. Computes patrol radii, updates steering target, and maintains squad spacing.
methods.create: Binds motion controller, AI decision subsystem, animation layer, owning character entity, and attribute stats to `CharBody`. Allocates and constructs the specialized `CombatClassAI` motor instance, storing it in `combatClass`.
methods.endAction: Public interface terminating the currently running action and resetting motor state. Forwards call directly to protected virtual `_endAction()`.
methods.getCharBody: Virtual polymorphic identity query returning the `CharBody*` self-pointer.
methods.getCharacter: Retrieves the back-pointer to the owning `Character` entity.
methods.getCombatClass: Retrieves the active `CombatClass` subsystem attached to this character body.
methods.getCurrentAction: Retrieves the atomic `Tasker` action currently executing within this body instance.
methods.getCurrentActionOrMessage: Retrieves the active action or pending message task currently bound to `currentAction`.
methods.getCurrentSubject: Retrieves the unique entity handle (`hand`) of the target subject associated with currently executing action.
methods.getFaction: Retrieves the sovereign political faction governing parent character.
methods.getHandle: Constructs and returns the unique entity handle (`hand`) representing parent character.
methods.getName: Retrieves the display name string of parent character entity.
methods.getPlatoon: Virtual query resolving the active platoon squad containing this character.
methods.getPosition: Virtual spatial query returning the current 3D world position coordinates (`Ogre::Vector3`) of owning character.
methods.getUpFromRagdoll: Transitions character out of ragdoll physics simulation back into motorized skeletal animation, initiating specified recovery get-up animation sequence.
methods.isCharacter: Virtual type inquiry confirming whether this body controller belongs to an active character entity.
methods.isCrouched: Queries whether character is currently maintaining stealth sneaking or crouched locomotion posture.
methods.isIdle: Queries whether the character's physical body is currently in an idle resting state without active motor execution.
methods.notifyBodyTaskComplete: Dispatches notification to `AITaskSystem` signaling that the physical motor component of the current task has concluded.
methods.notifyPathImpossible: Virtual navigation failure signal informing AI task hierarchy that pathfinding to target entity handle `h` has failed or navmesh connectivity is broken.
methods.notifyTaskComplete: Virtual notification dispatched when an action completes successfully. Signals `AITaskSystem` to advance high-level task queue progression.
methods.notifyTaskImpossible: Virtual failure notification dispatched when an active task cannot be completed due to environmental blockage, unreachable interaction slots, or missing items.
methods.periodicUpdate: Periodic low-frequency motor and combat update tick. Forwards execution directly into `CombatClass::periodicUpdate()` to refresh weapon ranges, attack slot reservations, and sensory combat awareness.
methods.setCurrentAction: Creates and initiates a new atomic action of the requested `TaskType` targeting `RootObject* target`. Requests a task instance from `TaskRepertoire`, assigns it urgent execution priority (`TP_URGENT`), enqueues it into `taskSystemAI`, and triggers execution.
methods.update: Virtual per-frame motor update tick. Validates platoon assignment, synchronizes active action subject on the platoon blackboard, caches `frameTIME`, evaluates ragdoll state versus motorized locomotion, executes active `Tasker::runAction`, and triggers task completion or failure transitions.
methods.~CharBody: Virtual destructor for `CharBody`. Gracefully terminates and destructs the active `Tasker` action, destroys the attached `CombatClass` subsystem, unlinks parent character references, and deallocates base Ogre memory.

properties.ai: AI decision, sensory perception, and package coordinator container.
properties.amIdle: Flag indicating whether character body is currently idle with no active tasks.
properties.animation: Skeletal animation playback, bone blending, and state machine.
properties.arbitraryCatchupDist: Separation distance threshold before accelerating movement to catch up.
properties.combatClass: Combat state machine managing weapon attacks, defense, and attack slot coordination.
properties.crouched: Sneaking and stealth crouch locomotion posture flag.
properties.currentAction: Pointer to atomic Tasker action currently executing.
properties.frameTIME: Frame delta-time cached for physical motor calculations.
properties.gotItem: Flag indicating successful acquisition or transfer of an inventory item.
properties.jogMode: Movement stance override selecting jog vs run velocity profile.
properties.movement: Navmesh path follower, crowd steering, and obstacle avoidance controller.
properties.stats: Character attributes, skill proficiencies, and performance stats.
properties.target: Unique entity handle of active interaction or combat target.

CharMovement.description: Character movement and pathfinding controller. Extends AbstractMovementBase with Havok character collision, animation tracking, ground tracing, formations, and combat positioning.

methods._setPositionAndTeleport: Teleports the character and its physics hull to p (Vector3 table) on building floor.
methods._setPositionDirectionAndTeleport: Teleports the character to position (Vector3 table) and sets its orientation (Quaternion table).
methods._setPositionSimple: Sets the character's position to p (Vector3 table) without full teleport side effects.
methods.combatMovementOffensive: Initiates offensive combat positioning toward target (hand) within [minDistance, maxDistance], with circling weight circle, powerThrough flag power, and speedLimit.
methods.destroy: Destroys the physics character controller, click hull, and formations.
methods.faceDirection: Rotates the character to face direction vector dir (Vector3 table).
methods.getCharacter: Returns the Character that owns this CharMovement instance.
methods.getCombatMoveSpeedMult: Returns the current combat movement speed multiplier.
methods.getCurrentFloor: Returns the building floor index the character is currently on.
methods.getHandle: Returns the hand handle of the owning character.
methods.getLastGroundTraceResultMT: Returns a copy of the most recent ground raycast hit (physHit) in a thread-safe manner.
methods.getMaximumPossibleMovement: Returns the maximum distance the character can move this frame.
methods.getRadius: Returns the character's footprint and collision avoidance radius.
methods.halt: Immediately stops movement and clears the active path.
methods.handleChanged: Updates internal references after the owning character's handle changes.
methods.hasClickHull: Returns true if the character currently has an active selection click hull.
methods.invalidatePath: Marks the current path as invalid so it will be recalculated.
methods.isCombatMovementBlockedByCharacters: Returns true if nearby characters are blocking combat movement.
methods.isDestinationReached: Returns true if the character has reached its current destination.
methods.isIdle: Returns true if the character is stationary with no active movement.
methods.isIndoors: Returns true if the character is currently inside a building.
methods.isIndoorsHideMeCheck: Returns true if the character is inside a building whose interior is hidden.
methods.isInsideBuildingLoadedInterior: Returns true if the character is inside a building with a loaded interior.
methods.isRunning: Returns true if the character is currently moving at running speed.
methods.isRunningAway: Returns true if the character is currently moving away from position from (Vector3 table).
methods.isStandingOnSomething: Returns the hand handle of the building or object the character is standing on.
methods.isTrackingAnimationMode: Returns true if position is currently driven by animation root motion.
methods.isWaypointMoveMode: Returns true if the character is following path waypoints.
methods.lookatPosition: Rotates the character to face world position pos (Vector3 table).
methods.manualMovement: Applies manual movement displacement v (Vector3 table).
methods.movedBy: Applies an immediate world displacement pos (Vector3 table) to the character.
methods.pathFailed: Returns true if the current pathfinding request failed.
methods.pathOk: Returns true if the character currently has a valid path.
methods.pausedUpdate: Runs movement updates needed while the game is paused.
methods.periodicUpdate: Runs lower-frequency periodic movement and pathing checks over time.
methods.playerMoveOrderWhileInCombatMode: Handles a direct player move order to pos (Vector3 table) while in combat mode and returns whether it was accepted.
methods.postAnimationUpdate: Applies post-animation root-motion and position adjustments.
methods.predictNextPosition: Predicts the character's next world position (Vector3 table), optionally using accurate projection.
methods.refreshClickHull: Rebuilds or updates the character's selection click hull.
methods.restore: Recreates and restores the physical movement controller.
methods.setDestination: Overloaded destination setter: accepts a target Character, Building, RootObjectBase, or world-space Vector3 table as argument 2, an optional UpdatePriority integer as argument 3, and (when passing a Vector3 table) an optional boolean notVertical as argument 4.
methods.setDirectMovement: Moves directly along vector d (Vector3 table) with speed limit.
methods.setLookatTarget: Sets the character handle (lookatCharacter) that this character should face during combat.
methods.setMovementMode: Sets the active MovementMode enum (MOVE_NORMAL, MOVE_COMBAT, or MOVE_DIRECTION).
methods.teleportCollisionHull: Teleports the character's physics collision hull to _pos (Vector3 table).
methods.toGround: Snaps the character vertically to the ground surface and returns whether ground was found.
methods.trackAnimationMovement: Enables or disables root-motion animation movement tracking (on).
methods.twoFrameUpdate: Runs movement and ground updates scheduled every two frames over _TIME.
methods.update: Advances character movement, pathfinding, and physics over _TIME seconds.
methods.updateGroundMaterial: Updates the surface material under the character's feet for footstep audio and effects.

properties._lastOffMeshCheck: Timestamp of the last off-navmesh recovery check.
properties.animation: Pointer to the character's AnimationClass (exposed as lightuserdata).
properties.animationOverride: Whether animation is overriding normal movement positioning.
properties.building: Handle (hand) of the building the character is currently inside or standing on.
properties.character: The Character that owns this CharMovement controller.
properties.combatMover: Embedded CombatMovementController for close-quarters combat maneuvering.
properties.combatMover2: Embedded FormationMover used for formation positioning.
properties.desiredMotion: Desired motion vector (Vector3 table) for the current frame.
properties.destinationLoaded: Whether the terrain/navmesh at the destination is currently loaded.
properties.dontEverRecreateMe: Flag preventing the physical movement controller from being recreated.
properties.enemyFormation: Formation (Formation* as lightuserdata) used by attackers surrounding this character.
properties.flockingTools: Embedded FlockingTools helper for local character repulsion.
properties.floorGroup: Physics collision group for the current building floor.
properties.footprintRadius: Character footprint radius used for pathing and spacing.
properties.formation: Squad formation (Formation* as lightuserdata) owned by this character when leading.
properties.initCheck: Whether this CharMovement controller has completed initialization.
properties.lastStepTime: Timestamp of the last footstep update.
properties.moveLimit: Maximum movement speed limit for direct movement.
properties.movementMode: Current MovementMode enum value (MOVE_NORMAL, MOVE_COMBAT, or MOVE_DIRECTION).
properties.movingToEdge: Whether the character is currently moving toward a navmesh edge.
properties.tracer: Continuous ground raycast tracer (ConstantTracerT* as lightuserdata).
properties.trackingAnimRelocationVector: Accumulated root-motion relocation offset (Vector3 table) from a tracking animation.

CharStats.description: Attribute, combat skill, racial bonus, damage curve, and experience points (XP) calculation engine for `Character` actors. Manages primary attributes (Strength, Dexterity, Toughness, Perception) and secondary proficiencies (Martial Arts, Melee Attack/Defence, Weapon proficiencies, Athletics, Stealth, Thievery, Crafting, Medicine, Crossbows, and Turrets). Governs movement dynamics (run speed, encumbrance penalties, swim speed, stealth speed), combat speed (attack/block timing, weapon weight penalties), damage scaling (cut, blunt, pierce, bleed), environmental weather hazard protection, and experience event dispatching. Coordinates directly with `Character` for entity state, `MedicalSystem` for health and wound penalties, `Inventory` for weight encumbrance, and `CombatClass` for attack selection and damage resolution.

methods.CharStats: Constructs a new `CharStats` instance, initializing primary attributes and proficiencies to default zero baseline, setting multiplier scalars to 1.0, configuring the unarmed hand weapon slot, and clearing racial bonus mappings.
methods._calculateBlockChance: Computes block success probability against an opponent's attack skill, factoring in relative weapon skills, defensive posture, and injury penalties.
methods._calculateEncumberanceMult: Computes encumbrance penalty ratio based on current inventory weight vs maximum carry capacity.
methods._calculateMaxSwimSpeed: Calculates ideal swimming speed based on base swimming skill and racial aquatic factors.
methods._calculateWeaponWeightSpeedMultiplier: Calculates speed modifier imposed when a weapon's weight exceeds twice the character's strength attribute.
methods._chooseAttacks: Internal selection filter populating a `FitnessSelector` with valid combat techniques meeting distance, weapon type, and anatomical requirements.
methods._convertBluntMultiplierToWeaponWeight: Static utility converting blunt damage multiplier into effective minimum weapon weight requirement.
methods._convertWeaponWeightToBluntMultiplier: Static utility converting raw weapon mass into required blunt strength scaling multiplier.
methods._getMeleeAttackBase: Returns unaugmented base melee attack skill value before any modifiers are applied.
methods._randomiseStats: Applies a random perturbation to all base attributes and skill values scaled by `amount`, providing NPC stat variance across generated squads and recruits.
methods._recalculateStats: Internal virtual helper recalculating derived movement velocities, encumbrance speed multipliers, and weapon weight speed penalties following equipment or health changes.
methods.animalRecruitReduceStats: Scales down raw combat attributes when recruiting a wild animal into a player faction, balancing progression curves against animal age growth multipliers.
methods.calculateAthleticsXPMult: Computes velocity-dependent XP multiplier for athletics progression.
methods.calculateAttackOrBlockSpeed: Derives attack or block animation speed scaling from weapon weight vs strength ratio and skill level.
methods.calculateDeadTime: Determines recovery cooldown delay (dead time) following an attack hit, block, missed swing, or interruption.
methods.calculateDodgeChance: Evaluates probability of successfully dodging an incoming attack versus opponent's attack skill, factoring in whether character is currently stumbling.
methods.calculateHungerMult: Evaluates stat debuff multiplier resulting from malnutrition and starvation.
methods.calculateMaxRunSpeed: Evaluates current top running speed based on base athletics skill, leg injuries, encumbrance weight, hunger state, and equipment speed multipliers.
methods.calculateMaxStealthSpeed: Determines maximum sneaking speed while crouched in stealth mode, scaled by stealth skill and armor weight.
methods.calculateStrengthXPMultFromWalking: Calculates strength XP earning rate while walking overloaded with heavy inventory weight.
methods.calculateStumbleBlockTimer: Calculates recovery duration and parry inability timer when staggered by a heavy blunt or cutting blow.
methods.calculateStumbleThresholdDamageAmount: Calculates minimum incoming single-hit damage threshold required to cause this character to stumble or stagger.
methods.calculateSwimSpeed: Evaluates active swimming speed in water, factoring in swimming skill, inventory burden, and limb injuries.
methods.calculateTechniqueInegrityCheckTimer: Evaluates animation integrity verification interval to ensure combat maneuvers correctly transition without getting stuck.
methods.calculateTheoreticalIdealMaxRunSpeed: Computes theoretical maximum running velocity assuming zero encumbrance, full health, and optimal athletic gear.
methods.calculateToughnessDamageResistanceMult: Evaluates incoming physical damage mitigation factor derived from toughness, reducing physical damage taken at higher toughness levels (up to -35% damage at level 100).
methods.calculateToughnessWoundDegenerationRate: Calculates the rate at which bleeding wounds stabilize or degenerate based on toughness; higher toughness drastically reduces hemorrhage rates and recovery coma times.
methods.calculateWeaponWeightXPMult: Computes strength XP bonus multiplier earned when swinging weapons heavier than current strength.
methods.chooseAttack: Evaluates available attack techniques based on target range, weapon reach, previous attack executed, and whether opponent is stationary, choosing an animation with highest fitness weight.
methods.chooseAttacks: Populates possibleAttacks (FitnessSelector<CombatTechniqueData*>) with valid combat techniques for the given range, weapon reach, weapon category, and skill.
methods.chooseBlock: Selects the optimal blocking or parrying animation technique given incoming attack cut direction, opponent's attack skill, cut origination, and opponent pointer.
methods.clearHoldLocation: Clears the hold-ground coordinate anchor, resetting anchor state and restoring normal tactical repositioning.
methods.convertBluntMultiplierToWeaponWeight: Converts a weapon blunt damage multiplier into its corresponding combat weight in kilograms.
methods.convertWeaponWeightToBluntMultiplier: Converts a weapon weight in kilograms into its corresponding blunt damage multiplier.
methods.currentWeaponHand: Determines whether equipped weapon is wielded primarily with left, right, or both hands.
methods.dexterityActual: Calculates effective actual dexterity attribute, incorporating gear dexterity multipliers, arm injury debuffs, hunger malnutrition penalties, and age multipliers.
methods.dexterityBase: Returns raw base dexterity attribute level before equipment coefficients or medical injury penalties are applied.
methods.formatWholeStatStringWithBonuses: Formats an integer stat into display string showing base value and modifier breakdown (e.g. '50 (+5)' or '40 (-10)').
methods.getAthletics: Returns the character's base athletics skill value (_athletics).
methods.getAthleticsTooltip: Populates tooltip breakdown entries explaining running speed components, encumbrance penalties, and leg health.
methods.getAttackBleedDamageMult: Returns bleeding rate multiplier applied to wounds inflicted by character's attacks.
methods.getAttackBluntPower: Computes effective blunt damage output scaled by weapon blunt damage rating, strength attribute, and equipment multipliers.
methods.getAttackChance: Returns probability coefficient of executing an offensive attack action during a combat slot opportunity.
methods.getAttackCuttingDamage: Computes effective cutting damage output based on weapon cutting stats, dexterity attribute, and equipment damage multipliers.
methods.getAttackPierceDamage: Computes armor-piercing damage bonus based on weapon penetration traits and strength.
methods.getAttackSpeed: Returns final calculated attack animation speed multiplier.
methods.getAttackSuccessChanceSkill: Evaluates base attack success probability derived from combat proficiencies.
methods.getBashAnimation: Selects an appropriate bash or blunt stagger combat technique based on current engagement distance and equipped weapon profile.
methods.getBlockSpeed: Returns final calculated block and parry animation speed multiplier.
methods.getCurrentWeaponLength: Returns physical reach and length of currently equipped weapon model in game units.
methods.getDexterity: Returns the character's effective dexterity stat (dexterityActual()), including injuries and modifiers.
methods.getDexterityRaw: Returns the character's base unmodified dexterity stat (dexterityBase()).
methods.getDodge: Computes effective dodge evasion skill, incorporating base dodging skill, armor penalties, encumbrance, and leg injuries.
methods.getDodgePenalty_encumbrance: Calculates dodge skill reduction caused by carried inventory weight.
methods.getDodgePenalty_gear: Calculates total dodge penalty imposed by equipped armor pieces.
methods.getDodgePenalty_injuries: Calculates dodge skill reduction caused by damaged legs, damaged stomach, and blood loss.
methods.getEncumbranceMult: Returns cached movement speed multiplier resulting from carried weight encumbrance.
methods.getEquippedWeaponSkill: Virtual accessor returning proficiency level in the currently equipped weapon category (e.g. Katanas, Sabres, Hackers, Heavy Weapons, Blunt, Polearms, or Unarmed).
methods.getGUIData: Populates `DatapanelGUI` HUD widgets with formatted character attributes, combat proficiencies, and trade skills.
methods.getGUIDataForMainInfo: Generates character overview datapanel content, displaying primary stats, health, and combat posture.
methods.getGUIStatsDisplayMode: Determines HUD stat presentation layout (`GUI_STATS_NORMAL`, `GUI_STATS_MARTIALARTIST`, or `GUI_STATS_RANGED`).
methods.getMaxHealAmount: Calculates maximum permissible healing restoration from medical gear or medical beds.
methods.getMaxRunSpeed: Returns cached maximum running velocity in game units per second.
methods.getMeleeAttack: Computes effective melee attack skill level, factoring in weapon skill, gear bonuses, indoor modifiers, injury debuffs, and defensive stance penalties.
methods.getMeleeAttackRef: Returns a direct reference to internal `__meleeAttack` member for mutation.
methods.getMeleeAttack_melee: Computes effective melee attack when wielding an armed weapon, incorporating weapon skill and equipment modifiers.
methods.getMeleeAttack_unarmed: Computes effective martial arts attack skill when fighting unarmed, applying indoor and gear bonuses.
methods.getMeleeDefence: Computes effective melee defence skill, optionally factoring in defensive mode posture bonus (+20).
methods.getMeleeDefence_melee: Computes effective armed melee defence against incoming strikes, incorporating weapon skill and gear penalties.
methods.getOverallSkillLevel_0_100: Computes aggregate normalized combat readiness score (0 to 100) representing overall combat effectiveness across attack, defence, strength, and toughness.
methods.getPainAnim: Retrieves appropriate pain animation state string corresponding to an anatomical body part hit.
methods.getPerception: Returns the character's perception stat value.
methods.getRangedAccuracyMult: Returns accuracy deviation multiplier for crossbows and turrets based on perception and skill.
methods.getRangedFriendlyFireAvoidanceChance: Calculates probability of avoiding shooting allies when firing through contested melees.
methods.getReloadSkill: Returns effective reload speed skill for ranged crossbow weapons.
methods.getSkillDifferenceRatio: Calculates relative skill advantage ratio between character's skill and opponent's skill.
methods.getStat: Returns current numerical value of an enumerated stat (`StatsEnumerated`), with option to query unmodified base value.
methods.getStatMultiplier: Returns active multiplier coefficient applied to a given stat.

Character.description: Primary entity actor representing all humanoid and creature characters across the game world. Coordinates AI execution, combat, movement, anatomical damage, inventories, equipment, physics ragdolls, perception, and dialogues. Interacts directly with `MedicalSystem` for anatomical limb damage and vital hitpoints, `CharStats` for attributes and skill calculations, `AI` for Goal-Oriented Action Planning and jobs, `CombatClass` for melee combat execution, `RangedCombatClass` for crossbow targeting, `Inventory` for equipment slots and items, `CharMovement` for locomotion pathfinding, `CharBody` for visual mesh and detached limbs, and `Platoon` for squad membership and command structures.

methods.isPrisonerFreeToGo: Returns true if a released prisoner has completed their sentence and is free to depart.
methods.isRagdoll: Returns true if the character is currently in a physical ragdoll state.
methods.isResident: Returns the `TownBase` settlement where this character resides, or nil if none.
methods.isSlave: Queries whether character is enslaved by any faction.
methods.isStandingOnBuilding: Returns the handle of the building or rooftop this character is standing upon.
methods.isStealthMode: Returns true if the character is currently in sneaking stance.
methods.isStealthModeOrCrawling: Returns true if the character is in sneaking posture or crawling due to leg injuries.
methods.isUnconcious: Queries whether character is incapacitated due to blunt shock, vital limb trauma, or recovery coma.
methods.isUnique: Returns true if this character is a unique named NPC.
methods.isWithThePlayer: Returns true if this character is currently accompanying or traveling with the player.
methods.lastSeenInHoursAgo: Returns the number of in-game hours elapsed since this character last observed the target actor.
methods.lineOfSightCheck: Performs a line-of-sight raycast check toward the specified target character.
methods.loadFromSerialise: Restores character state, stats, and inventory from the specified `GameSaveState`.
methods.loadFromSerialisePostCreationStage: Finalizes character state restoration from save data after actor creation.
methods.loadUnloadCheck: Evaluates proximity and visibility to transition this character between active and unloaded states.
methods.lookatPosition: Orients the character's head or full body to face toward the specified world position.
methods.movePermajob: Reorders a permanent job from one priority position to another in the queue.
methods.notifyEffect: Notifies visual and audio systems of an environmental or combat status effect trigger.
methods.notifyICanSeeYouSneaking: Notifies the character that they have visually detected a sneaking actor.
methods.notifyIndoors: Notifies the character of entering or exiting an indoor building space.
methods.notifyTheCampaignOfAnAttack: Signals the faction campaign manager that this character was attacked, potentially triggering military retaliation.
methods.offscreenUpdate: Executes simplified simulation logic while this character is offscreen.
methods.pathExists: Returns true if a valid navmesh path exists from this character to the target position.
methods.pausedUpdate: Updates character state and visual presentation while the game is paused.
methods.periodicUpdate: Performs lower-frequency periodic updates for health, hunger, and status effects.
methods.pickupObject: Picks up an unconscious or dead entity, lifting them onto the character's shoulder and attaching their ragdoll to carry bones.
methods.playerMoveOrderDefault: Dispatches a default player movement order to navigate toward the given world coordinates.
methods.postRagdollCallback: Internal callback executed after physical ragdoll simulation updates for the frame.
methods.postUpdate: Executes post-tick updates following physics, movement, and animation processing.
methods.preventRagdollMode: Suppresses or allows automatic transitions into physical ragdoll mode upon taking damage.
methods.processCharacterLoadTimeMessages: Dispatches deferred cross-thread messages queued during character initialization.
methods.ragdollMode: Switches the character into or out of physical ragdoll simulation.
methods.ragdollUpdatesUT: Performs un-threaded synchronization of ragdoll physics capsule transforms to visual bones.
methods.reCalculateNaturalWeapon: Recalculates damage and attack reach values for the character's innate natural weapons (e.g. fists, beaks, claws).
methods.reThinkCurrentAIAction: Forces an immediate re-evaluation of the character's active AI action and goal priorities.
methods.recalculateTotalEquipmentSkillBonus: Recalculates total stat and skill modifiers granted across all equipped gear pieces.
methods.relocationTeleport: Offsets the character's physical position by the specified relative displacement vector.
methods.rememberCharacter: Records a short-term or long-term perception tag into character memory for the specified character.
methods.removeJob: Removes tasks matching the given task type and target from the character's job queue.
methods.removePermajob: Removes the permanent job at the specified priority index from the queue.
methods.resetRagdollNavmeshSafePos: Resets the cached navigable ground anchor used for ragdoll recovery.
methods.runSlaveAnim: Executes a synchronized slave labor animation cycle on the character.
methods.say: Displays floating overhead speech text and triggers the corresponding dialogue audio.
methods.sayALine: Forces the character to speak the given dialogue line, optionally overriding repeat limits.
methods.say_WithARepeatLimiter: Displays overhead speech text only if the line has not been recently repeated within cooldown.
methods.select: Selects this character in the user interface.
methods.sellingUniformDetectionCheck: Returns true if attempting to sell the specified uniform or disguise is recognized and detected.
methods.sendDialogEvent: Triggers a dialogue event trigger toward the specified target character. Returns true if dialogue fired.
methods.sendDialogEventOverride: Triggers a dialogue event trigger toward the target character, optionally forcing playback regardless of cooldowns.
methods.sendMessage: Dispatches an internal character message event to this character with sender and subject references.
methods.separateIntoMyOwnSquad: Splits this character out of their current squad into a newly created independent squad.
methods.serialise: Serializes this character's state, inventory, and stats into a `GameSaveState`.
methods.setAge: Sets the character's normalized age progression value.
methods.setAppearanceData: Assigns a new appearance customization record and refreshes the character model.
methods.setBedMode: Places the character into resting bed mode, accelerating healing and recovery rates.
methods.setChainedMode: Toggles slave shackle lock state, restricting movement animation speed and applying heavy athletic penalties.
methods.setDestination: Sets the target 3D world destination coordinates for pathfinding navigation.
methods.setDestinationIndoors: Sets an indoor pathfinding navigation destination inside the specified building.
methods.setDisguiseMessage: Sets the active GUI feedback message indicating disguise recognition or suspicion state.
methods.setEffectBT: Toggles an active status effect on the character's background thread effect controller.
methods.setFaction: Assigns the character to a new faction and optionally joins the specified active platoon.
methods.setGroundType: Sets the `GroundType` surface classification beneath this character.
methods.setHandle: Sets the object identifier handle (`hand`) for this character.
methods.setInsideTownWalls: Sets the town wall boundary index or gate zone the character currently occupies.
methods.setName: Sets the display name of this character.
methods.setNameTagVisible: Sets whether this character's floating overhead name tag is visible.
methods.setPrisonMode: Configures prisoner confinement mode when placed inside a cage or pole.
methods.setProneState: Sets the active posture state and updates skeletal animation stance flags and movement speeds.
methods.setRace: Sets the character's race data template and refreshes racial statistics.
methods.setRagdollNavmeshSafePos: Sets the safe navigable ground position used when recovering from a ragdoll knockdown.
methods.setSlaveAIJob: Assigns autonomous slave labor AI routines (mining, hauling, operating machinery).
methods.setSquadMemberType: Sets this character's role or rank within their squad.
methods.setStandingOrder: Toggles a standing tactical order (e.g. passive mode, hold position, block).
methods.setStealthMode: Enables or disables sneaking posture and stealth detection.
methods.setTerrainHeightPosition: Positions the character at the given coordinates, clamping elevation to the ground surface.
methods.setVisible: Sets the visibility of this character's visual model.
methods.setupAI: Configures AI task system and behavioral package from FCS character package data and squad settings.
methods.setupAudio: Initializes Wwise audio listeners, game objects, and sound banks for this character.
methods.setupInventorySections: Initializes and configures the character's inventory grid sections and equipment slots.
methods.setupPlatoonAI: Binds the character to the specified squad, configuring formation and tactical AI parameters.
methods.sheatheWeapon: Holsters the character's currently drawn weapon back into its equipment slot.
methods.shouldIHelpThisGuy: Returns true if this character's faction, memory, or personality motivates them to aid the specified character.
methods.shouldIScrewThisGuyOver: Returns true if this character's personality or memory motivates them to betray or take advantage of the specified character.
methods.shouldUseRangedWeapons: Returns true if tactical conditions, ammunition, and weapon loadout favor using ranged combat over melee.
methods.slaveAttachToBoneMode: Toggles direct bone coupling between the character and an interactive machine.
methods.smugglingTradeCheck: Returns a `YesNoMaybe` value determining whether this character will trade or buy the specified contraband item.
methods.startEffect: Starts playing a persistent visual or particle effect on the character from a GameData template. Returns true on success.
methods.stealthUpdate: Advances per-frame stealth evaluation, checking visibility against observers and awarding sneaking XP.
methods.stolenGoodsDetectionCheck: Returns true if this character detects that the specified item is stolen.
methods.stopAllEffects: Terminates and removes all active particle and visual effects attached to this character.
methods.stopEffect: Stops the specified visual or particle effect attached to this character. Returns true on success.
methods.stumbleState: Returns true if the character is currently executing an involuntary hit-reaction stumble.
methods.switchLights: Turns on or off any equipped light sources (lanterns, torches).
methods.takeMoney: Deducts the specified amount of Cats from this character's money, returning true if sufficient funds were available.
methods.teleport: Instantly teleports the character by displacement vector and updates orientation quaternion.
methods.teleportFromAnimation: Applies root-motion displacement from an animation sequence to update character world coordinates.
methods.teleportVisuallyOnly: Teleports the visual character mesh without resetting physics simulation buffers.
methods.threadedUpdate: Executes background worker thread simulation tasks for this character.
methods.threadedUpdate4: Executes quad-frame background worker thread simulation tasks for this character.
methods.threadedUpdatePeriodic: Executes periodic background worker thread simulation tasks for this character.
methods.unequipItem: Removes an item from its equipment slot, returning it to inventory bags and stripping attached modifiers.
methods.uniqueStateUpdate: Updates world-state triggers and progression specific to unique characters.
methods.unselect: Deselects this character in the user interface.
methods.update: Primary simulation tick updating AI arbitration, motor movement, medical wound bleeding, hunger progression, dialogue timers, and equipment state.
methods.updateGUIStatsDetails: Updates detailed skill inspector breakdown in HUD datapanel, detailing base skill, equipment bonuses, encumbrance penalties, and injury debuffs.
methods.updateLastTask: Caches the current AI task to allow state restoration upon interruption.
methods.updateOnScreenCheck: Performs camera frustum visibility checks, toggling high-detail skeletal simulation and audio updates when character enters or leaves screen view.
methods.updatePortraitGUIState: Updates health status, state icons, and condition bars on the character's HUD portrait.
methods.updateStateBroadcast: Updates sensory alert and awareness broadcast state for nearby AI over the specified time interval.
methods.updateTimes: Updates internal simulation clocks and frame timing accumulators.
methods.updateUT: Executes main-thread simulation updates that cannot run on worker threads.
methods.validateInventorySections: Validates inventory integrity, ensuring equipped items conform to slot restrictions.
methods.wantsPathfinderActive: Returns true if the character's active task requires pathfinding navigation.
methods.wantsToEatNow: Returns true if this character's hunger level is low enough to seek and consume food.
methods.wantsToTriggerCampaigns: Returns true if the character is capable of triggering faction raids or war campaigns.
methods.wearingUniformOf: Returns true if this character is wearing clothing or armour belonging to the specified faction.
methods.weatherUpdate: Applies environmental weather exposure and protective gear modifiers over the specified time delta.
methods.willTalkToEnemies: Returns true if this character is willing to converse with hostile characters.
methods.~Character: Virtual destructor unregistering character from platoon, tearing down AI controllers, destroying PhysX actors, releasing audio emitters, and freeing memory.

properties.slaveOwner: Handle of faction or squad that owns this slave.

properties.stateBroadcast: Broadcast packet containing posture, law enforcement status, and faction alignment.
properties.stats: Skill levels, attributes, encumbrance multipliers, and experience gains.
properties.stealthMarkerArrows: Embedded projectile arrows and visual indicator markers.
properties.whoSeesMeSneaking: Observers currently tracking this character sneaking.

methods.canGoIndoors: Returns whether this animal is allowed to enter indoor building b.
methods.createAnimationClass: Initializes the animal animation controller (AnimationClass) for this character.
methods.createInventoryLayout: Creates and returns the AnimalInventoryLayout for this animal.
methods.drawWeapon: Equips or activates the animal's natural weapon from lastSlot and returns whether it succeeded.
methods.dropItem: Drops itembase (RootObject) from the animal's inventory or mouth into the world.
methods.dropItemInMouth: Drops any item currently held in the animal's mouth and returns whether an item was dropped.
methods.eatItemInMouth: Consumes the item currently held in the animal's mouth.
methods.foodUpdate: Updates hunger, feeding, and nutrition state for this animal.
methods.getAge: Returns the animal's current age multiplier.
methods.getAge0to1: Returns the animal's age clamped to the [0.0, 1.0] range.
methods.getAgeInverse: Returns the inverse of the animal's age multiplier.
methods.getCurrentWeapon: Returns the animal's currently active natural Weapon.
methods.getDefaultTaskRepertoireEnum: Returns the default AI task repertoire enum ID for this animal.
methods.getHPMultiplier: Returns the animal's age-scaled hit-point multiplier.
methods.getItemInMouth: Returns the Item currently held in the animal's mouth, or nil if none.
methods.getSmellHuntingThresholdBlood: Returns the blood smell threshold required to trigger hunting behavior.
methods.getSmellHuntingThresholdEggs: Returns the egg smell threshold required to trigger hunting behavior.
methods.getThePreferredWeapon: Returns the animal's preferred natural Weapon.
methods.init: Initializes internal animal character state and race parameters.
methods.isAnimal: Returns this character as a CharacterAnimal instance.
methods.periodicUpdate: Runs periodic updates for animal growth, smell, and state.
methods.pickupItemInMouth: Picks up item in the animal's mouth (such as a severed limb or foul meat) and returns whether it succeeded.
methods.setAge: Sets the animal's age multiplier (zeroToOne), updating growth scale and derived stats.
methods.setupAudio: Initializes audio emitters and sound parameters for this animal.
methods.setupInventorySections: Initializes animal inventory sections (such as pack or mouth slots) from state (GameSaveState) and returns whether setup succeeded.
methods.sheatheWeapon: Sheathes or deactivates the animal's natural weapon.

properties.audioTimeStamp: Timestamp of the last ambient animal audio event.
properties.itemInMouthTimeStamp: In-game TimeOfDay when the current item was picked up in the animal's mouth.

CharacterEditWindow.description: Plastic surgeon and character creation window. Provides procedural bone scaling sliders, muscle and bulk blend curves, posture options, race/gender selection, and mesh export/import. Coordinates an orbital preview camera (`CharacterEditCamera`), multi-character squad setups (`Character`), procedural skeletal morph blending, and disk persistence for `.bod2` body preset files.

methods.CharacterEditWindow: Primary constructor for `CharacterEditWindow`. Initializes BaseLayout XML interface, creates orbital inspection camera (`CharacterEditCamera`), sets up 3D viewport platform and lighting nodes, builds race/subrace tables, initializes multi-character array, and configures UI category buttons.
methods.changeAppearanceData: Swaps appearance data structures when transitioning between different races or genders, preserving proportional facial and body sliders where compatible.
methods.changeCategory: Switches the active slider category (e.g. Body, Face, Posture, Hair, Skin), updating category tab highlights and regenerating slider widgets in the scrollview.
methods.changeGender: Toggles or cycles character biological gender (Male/Female), reloading gender-specific body meshes, animations, and morph ranges.
methods.clearCharacterPoses: Clears and resets all active vertex poses and posture animation tracks on the preview character.
methods.confirmButton: Handles the 'Confirm' / 'Done' button click. Validates character names, prompts for plastic surgeon fee confirmation in midgame mode, or commits changes and closes the editor.
methods.confirmMessageCallback: Callback dispatched from the confirmation message box when the player confirms or cancels changes in plastic surgeon mode.
methods.exportCharacter: Opens the file export dialog to save current character body proportions, facial morphs, and attachments into a.bod2 file.
methods.exportMeshes: Developer and modding export utility generating finalized skinned mesh assets to disk from procedurally scaled bone transforms.
methods.getCharacterEntity: Retrieves the Ogre rendering entity (`Ogre::Entity*`) for the character at the specified index.
methods.getCurrentAttachmentName: Retrieves the asset mesh name of the attachment assigned to the designated attachment slot (e.g. hair, beard, horns).
methods.getCurrentHeadName: Retrieves the asset mesh name of the currently equipped head/face geometry.
methods.importCharacter: Opens the file import dialog to load an exported character body morph preset (.bod2 file) from disk.
methods.initCharacters: Initializes editable character array, populating default appearance records, cached poses, and initial positions for all squad members participating in new game setup.
methods.loadData: Loads race templates, sub-race definitions, mesh attachment lists, and morph slider definitions from game data.
methods.loadImportedCharacter: Callback executed when the user selects a preset file in the open/save file dialog. Parses the.bod2 file and applies appearance attributes to the active character.
methods.nameChanged: Text input change event handler updating the character's display name string from `txtName`.
methods.nextCharacter: Selects and displays the next squad member in multi-character game setups.
methods.nextRace: Cycles to the next available race category, refreshing sub-race options and reapplying race morph limits.
methods.nextSubRace: Cycles to the next available sub-race variant within the active race group.
methods.prevCharacter: Selects and displays the previous squad member in multi-character game setups (e.g. 'Nobodies' or custom squad starts).
methods.prevRace: Cycles to the previous available race category, updating race display labels and filtering sub-race selections.
methods.prevSubRace: Cycles to the previous available sub-race variant within the active race group.
methods.randomiseAll: Randomizes all morph sliders, body proportions, face shapes, skin tones, hair styles, and posture settings within the valid race limits.
methods.randomisePart: Randomizes only the sliders belonging to the currently active morph category (e.g. only randomize face features or only body sliders).
methods.refreshCharacterPoses: Re-evaluates and refreshes posture blend animations across all characters in the squad.
methods.refreshUI: Synchronizes all UI widget states, slider positions, labels, and text fields with the currently selected character's appearance data.
methods.resetAppearance: Resets all morph sliders, colors, attachments, and posture curves of the active character back to race default templates.
methods.setClothesVisible: Directly controls clothing sub-mesh visibility on the specified character's 3D rendering entity.
methods.setCurrentAttachmentName: Assigns an attachment asset to the designated attachment slot by index into available assets.
methods.setCurrentHeadName: Sets the active head/face mesh geometry for the character by index into the available head list.
methods.setUIEnabled: Enables or disables interactive UI controls during camera transitions, file import/export modal dialogues, or character mesh reloading.
methods.setupUI: Builds and attaches MyGUI widgets for name input, race cycling buttons, gender toggles, category tabs, and action buttons.
methods.showCharacter: Controls visibility of the 3D scene entity for the specified character on the inspection platform.
methods.toggleClothes: Button callback toggling underwear/clothing visibility on the preview character model.
methods.update: Per-frame update tick for the character creation screen. Updates orbital camera interpolation, applies pending live character model rebuilds, and animates character idle stance.
methods.updateAnimationIdle: Switches the active idle animation pose demonstrated by the character model in the preview viewport.
methods.updateAppearanceList: Callback handling discrete attachment selection list changes (e.g. hair styles, beards, horns, markings).
methods.updateAppearanceMultiSlider: Callback handling multi-slider compound adjustments (e.g. paired left/right facial features or linked bone pairs).
methods.updateAppearanceSlider: Callback handling single-value scalar bone scale morph slider adjustments, applying real-time skeletal transformations to the 3D preview model.
methods.updateAppearanceSliderPose: Callback handling posture and pose blend slider adjustments, blending Ogre skeletal poses and posture offsets in real time.
methods.updateAppearanceSliderVector: Callback handling 3D vector bone scaling adjustments (e.g. width, depth, height proportions).
methods.updateCharacter: Switches the active character in the 3D preview platform, updating the character index label (`txtCharIdx`) and refreshing all sliders and labels.
methods.updateCharacterPoses: Updates and blends all skeletal vertex poses across the character mesh based on current posture slider values.
methods.updateCurrentCategory: Instantiates and arranges the procedural slider widgets and attachment scrollbars for the currently selected morph category.
methods.updateLiveObject: Requests an immediate refresh of the character's live in-world visual representation from updated morph settings.
methods.updateRace: Applies race and sub-race changes to the active character, rebuilding skeletal meshes, swapping base textures, updating race lore description, and synchronizing stat preview panels.
methods.~CharacterEditWindow: Virtual destructor deallocating 3D preview platform, releasing orbital camera controller, cleaning up temporary mesh clones and appearance dictionaries, and unregistering MyGUI listeners.

CharacterHuman.description: Human or humanoid character instance (including Greenlanders, Scorchlanders, Shek, Hivers, and Skeletons). Extends Character with humanoid weapon drawing, sheath handling, shaved-head state, and equipment setup.

methods.createAnimationClass: Initializes the humanoid animation controller (AnimationClassHuman) for this character.
methods.drawWeapon: Draws item from inventory slot lastSection into the character's hands and returns whether it succeeded.
methods.dropItem: Drops itembase (RootObject) from this character's inventory into the world.
methods.dropWeaponInHands: Drops the weapon currently held in the character's hands onto the ground.
methods.dropWeaponInHandsFake: Detaches the weapon in hands visually without spawning a dropped world item.
methods.getCurrentWeapon: Returns the Weapon currently held in the character's hands, or nil if unarmed.
methods.getRangedWeapon: Returns the equipped Crossbow ranged weapon, or nil if none.
methods.getThePreferredWeapon: Returns the best available melee Weapon in the character's equipment.
methods.giveBirth: Initializes and spawns this human character with _appearance, world position _pos (Vector3 table), rotation _rot (Quaternion table), optional save state, temporary platoon tempplatoonptr, and _faction.
methods.isHeadShaven: Returns true if this character's head is currently shaven.
methods.isHuman: Returns this character as a CharacterHuman instance.
methods.leaveSheathEquipped: Keeps the weapon sheath model equipped in slot section at vertical slot offset ypos when the blade is drawn.
methods.loadFromSerialise: Restores this human character's saved state from state (GameSaveState).
methods.postRagdollCallback: Callback invoked after ragdoll physics state changes (on) for ragdoll part part.
methods.reCalculateNaturalWeapon: Recalculates the character's unarmed/martial-arts natural weapon stats.
methods.serialise: Serializes this human character's state into container and refList (optionally subtracting offsetPosToSubtract, a PosRotPair* lightuserdata) and returns the resulting GameSaveState.
methods.setupAudio: Initializes audio emitters and voice data for this human character.
methods.setupInventorySections: Initializes humanoid inventory sections from state (GameSaveState) and returns whether setup succeeded.
methods.shaveHead: Applies or removes the shaved-head appearance flag (on), used by slavery and imprisonment systems.
methods.sheatheWeapon: Sheathes the currently drawn weapon back into its sheath slot.
methods.unequipItem: Unequips item from inventory slot section.
methods.validateInventorySections: Validates that all required humanoid inventory sections exist and are properly configured.
methods.weatherUpdate: Updates weather exposure effects (such as acid rain, dust storms, or burning) over time.

properties.weaponInHands: Weapon currently held in the character's hands, or nil if unarmed.
properties.weaponInHandsSheathLocation: Inventory section name from which weaponInHands was drawn.
