CombatClass.description: Master tactical melee combat controller governing realtime weapon exchanges, directional swing trajectories, defensive blocking arcs, damage mitigations, and attack slot reservations. Coordinates directly with `AnimationClass` for skeletal motion, `CharStats` for combat formulas and weapon skills, `MedicalSystem` for anatomical trauma, and `CharMovement` for combat spacing.

methods.CombatClass: Constructs the `CombatClass` melee state machine controller, binding subsystems for locomotion, artificial intelligence, skeletal animation, attributes, and medical trauma, while registering discrete state handler classes into `stateMap`.
methods._blockHit: Processes a successful defensive block/parry, resetting failsafe timers and calculating block recovery dead time based on weapon deflection stats.
methods._getAttackTarget: Returns the persistent handle of the current attack target.
methods._getHit: Receives a successful physical strike, breaking stealth, applying post-hit dead time, calculating total impact force, and queueing stumble knockback.
methods._iHitYouAreYouHit: Core melee outcome arbitrator. Determines whether an incoming strike connects with flesh, is parried by weapon/armor, is dodged, or constitutes a criminal assault against law enforcement.
methods._isAttackingUpdate: Calculates internal attack progress value based on skeletal animation state, technique progress, or active stumble status.
methods._isInCombatMode: Returns whether the controller is actively engaged in combat mode.
methods.addAttackerH: Attempts to add a character to active direct attackers. If slots exceed limit (4 attackers), increments waiting counters and denies immediate slot.
methods.addEffect: Queues a combat particle visual effect to be attached to a specific character bone or spawned at a world position.
methods.areYouFightingAndInNeedOfHelp: Computes distress score for AI ally reinforcement queries, evaluating health deficits, overwhelm counts, and unconscious states.
methods.assessIncomingAttacks: Scans all registered attackers and populates output array with opponents currently executing strikes aimed at this character.
methods.attackImpactCheck: Evaluates weapon collision against the primary target and collateral cleave entities within the swing arc once animation enters the impact frame.
methods.attackState: Drives melee swing progression, monitors technique animation timeline, checks for emergency block interruptions, and executes impact detection at the strike window.
methods.blockState: Executes defensive weapon parry or dodge posture, maintaining block alignment until the incoming attack clears or block animation duration expires.
methods.blockWaitingState: Maintains defensive ready stance while waiting for incoming strike to enter the parry window.
methods.calculateCurrentTechniqueSection: Calculates multi-hit combo section index and intra-section normalized progress fraction from active skeletal animation clip.
methods.calculateTargetsInAttackZone: Sweeps a conical arc in front of the character based on weapon reach and technique cleave angle, populating `targetsInAttackZone`.
methods.canBlock: Evaluates whether character has functional arms, non-zero melee defense, and is not stunned or immobilized.
methods.changeState: Queues a state change and enforces a minimum execution time window before subsequent state transitions can occur.
methods.checkForBadHandles: Audits `attackersH` and `threatsH`, removing handles whose underlying character entities have died, despawned, or been deleted.
methods.checkForNeedBlock: Checks whether any hostile attacker within range is currently executing an attack past `thresholdIncomingAttack`, and verifies if our own attack is early enough to be aborted.
methods.destroy: Destroys and reclaims global static particle memory pools allocated for combat impact visual effects.
methods.getAttackAimAdjustmentThreshold: Calculates aim adjustment angle threshold based on defender's melee defense skill contrasted against attacker's melee attack and active enemy queue depth.
methods.getAttackers: Provides direct reference to the list of opponent handles actively attacking this entity.
methods.getBiggestThreat: Scans an array of hostile threats, scoring them by proximity, active attack state, and combat relative power to pick the most dangerous immediate opponent.
methods.getBlockStateEnum: Returns the canonical `BLOCK` state enum identifier.
methods.getCombatEffect: Queries game data container for visual particle effect blueprint matching the material collision type (blood for flesh, sparks for sword/metal).
methods.getCombatState: Retrieves the active primary melee state enum from `combatState`.
methods.getCurrentTechniqueSection: Returns the tracked animation sequence section index of current technique.
methods.getMeiMax: Computes maximum effective engagement outer radius based on base `MEI_MAX` and equipped weapon reach.
methods.getMeiMin: Returns minimum effective engagement inner radius (`MEI_MIN`).
methods.getNearestEnemyInAttackZone: Finds the closest hostile character situated within `targetsInAttackZone`.
methods.getNumOpponents: Returns the total count of active hostile attackers currently engaging this character.
methods.getNumWaitingAttackers: Returns the number of surplus enemies queued for an available attack slot, querying the currently active alternator buffer.
methods.getStateClass: Looks up the dedicated `CombatState` logic handler instance corresponding to the given state enum from `stateMap`.
methods.getTimeSinceLastCombatModeInHours: Calculates elapsed game simulation hours since the most recent combat mode activity.
methods.getTotalRelativeStrengthOfAttackers: Computes aggregate combat strength of all engaging opponents based on active attackers and waiting queue depth.
methods.go: Main per-frame combat execution entry point. Updates dead timers, attack progress, target orientation, and advances active state machine logic.
methods.gotMoreImportantThingsToDoThanFightingYo: Virtual heuristic query determining whether higher-priority AI packages (fleeing, healing wounded allies, extinguishing fires) supersede attacking the opponent.
methods.hasFocusedTarget: Returns the locked focus target handle if manual target focus mode is active.
methods.informOfFreeAttackSlot: Polymorphic callback invoked by opponent's `AttackSlotManager` when a melee engagement slot opens up, prompting queued attackers to step in.
methods.initCombatMode: Enters or reconfigures active combat mode against an opponent target, establishing engagement timestamps, locking target handles, and synchronizing stance animations.
methods.initialiseBlock: Selects and initiates a defensive blocking or dodging technique based on incoming attack cut direction, character weapon type, and dexterity/unarmed dodge stats.
methods.isAI: Queries whether this combat controller instance is governed by AI automation rather than direct player commands.
methods.isAttacking: Checks whether this combat controller is currently attacking the specified character, returning the normalized attack execution progress.
methods.isFightingAnAllyOfMine: Checks whether opponent character is currently targeting a member of our faction or squad.
methods.isInAttackZone: Tests whether the specified character is inside the current weapon attack cleave volume.
methods.isInAttackerListH: Checks whether the given character is present in `attackersH`.
methods.isStationary: Queries whether character is currently stationary in combat posture.
methods.lookatTarget: Adjusts root movement yaw orientation to maintain gaze and weapon alignment towards the target during combat exchanges.
methods.notifyBlockNeeded: Signals that an incoming strike requires a defensive response, setting `wantsToBlock = true` and `nextMove = BLOCK`.
methods.packPtrsToHandles: Serializes live pointers (`currentTarget`, `blockingTarget`) into persistent entity handles (`currentTargetHandle`, `blockingTargetH`) prior to save state writing or level streaming.
methods.periodicUpdate: Low-frequency tick updating attack slots, pruning invalid threat handles, synchronizing pointer-handle caches, and toggling ping-pong waiting counters.
methods.readyToFinishCombatMode: Queries whether combat mode is ready to terminate, verifying that the current state is `COMBAT_FINISHED` and any residual technique animation has completed past 99%.
methods.removeAttackerH: Removes character from active attackers list, freeing an attack slot for waiting opponents.
methods.setAttackTarget: Sets the primary attack target pointer and dispatches mutual attacking notifications to manage engagement state.
methods.setAttackTargetHandle: Sets `currentTargetHandle` from the given character pointer, handling handle equality checks.
methods.setCombatState: Sets the internal `combatState` enum, terminating active attack animations if switching back into decision phase, unless currently locked in stumble.
methods.setup: Initializes global static particle memory pools for combat effects (blood splatters, weapon sparks, dust clouds).
methods.shiftEffects: Shifts all active combat particle systems in world space when floating origin rebasing occurs.
methods.startupState: Evaluates initial transition out of idle into attack, block, or stagger depending on queued moves and incoming threats.
methods.stumbleState: Processes stagger animation countdown, decaying knockback velocity and testing whether character can recover into a block.
methods.unpackHandlesToPtrs: Restores live pointers (`currentTarget`, `blockingTarget`) from persistent entity handles (`currentTargetHandle`, `blockingTargetH`) following save loading or streaming sector unpacks.
methods.update: Dispatches execution to the current active state handler based on `combatState` (`CHOP_WEAPON`, `BLOCK`, `STUMBLE`, `DECISION`).
methods.updateEffects: Flushes queued effect requests in `effectsToAdd`, spawning scene nodes and updating particle lifespans in `effectsPool`.
methods.weaponReach: Calculates effective melee striking reach in engine world units ($0.5 \times \text{weapon length}$).
methods.whoAttacksYouOrMe: Evaluates attack priority between this character and an opponent at the given distance, returning the resulting swordStateEnum and updated distance.
methods.youDoKnowImAttackingYouRight: Registers incoming attack intention from an opponent handle, appending to `notifiedThreats` to track hostile awareness.
methods.~CombatClass: Destructs the `CombatClass` instance, resetting targeting notifications, removing active attacker registrations, and releasing dynamically allocated `CombatState` objects in `stateMap`.

properties.BLOCKING_MEI_DISTANCE_MAX: Maximum spatial separation beyond which incoming attacks cannot be blocked.
properties.BLOCKING_MEI_DISTANCE_MIN: Minimum spatial separation required to raise defensive weapon block.
properties.MEI_MAX: Maximum effective melee engagement distance (outer weapon reach boundary).
properties.MEI_MIN: Minimum effective melee engagement distance (inner collision boundary).
properties.MINIMUM_DISTANCE_TO_OTHERS: Personal space repulsion threshold preventing combatants from clipping into each other.
properties._isAttacking: Normalized attack execution progress or execution status (-100 = ragdoll, -1 = stumble, 0.0–1.0 = attack cycle).
properties._vftable: Virtual method dispatch table pointer resolving polymorphic combat methods (`isAI`, `attackState`, `blockState`, etc.).
properties.ai: High-level decision engine supplying tactical goals, package overrides, and target priorities.
properties.animation: Skeletal animation blender coordinating strike transitions, recovery poses, and blend layers.
properties.attackSlots: Internal attack slot manager instance arbitrating incoming hostile engagement slots.
properties.attackStartPos: World-space coordinates where current melee attack swing originated.
properties.attackersH: Array of persistent handles for all hostile characters currently attacking or targeting this entity.
properties.blockingTarget: Active opponent whose incoming attack is being guarded against.
properties.blockingTargetH: Persistent entity handle referencing defended opponent for safe serialization.
properties.calculatedTargetsInAttackZoneThisFrame: Frame-cached validity toggle preventing redundant cleave sweep queries.
properties.combatModeActive: Master toggle indicating active participation in tactical melee engagement mode.
properties.currentComboSection: Multi-hit combo stage index currently executing within active animation clip.
properties.currentTarget: Resolved live pointer to primary targeted opponent.
properties.currentTargetHandle: Persistent entity handle referencing primary targeted opponent.
properties.currentTechnique: Pointer to FCS combat technique template defining animation set, swing trajectory, and damage multipliers.
properties.currentTechniqueHasFinished: Flag indicating technique animation has reached terminus or impact window.
properties.deadTimer: Active countdown in seconds before character can initiate subsequent combat actions.
properties.frameTIME: Cached frame delta time in seconds passed down during simulation step.
properties.inDeadTime: Dead time state flag freezing state transitions following heavy impact or swing completion.
properties.isStumbleBlocking: Emergency guard toggle enabling character to attempt defensive blocks while recovering from stumble.
properties.lastCombatModeTimeStamp: High-precision game timestamp of most recent combat encounter, used for out-of-combat decay.
properties.lastComboSection: Previous combo stage index used to detect section boundary events.
properties.lastIncomingAttackComboSection: Tracked animation sequence index of incoming attack used to sync defensive parry timing.
properties.lastSoundIndex: Audio trigger marker index preventing duplicate weapon swing sound effects.
properties.me: Owning character entity possessing this combat controller.
properties.medical: Anatomical limb health, blood loss, and physical impairment telemetry.
properties.movement: Character locomotion controller driving root motion, directional facing, and spacing.
properties.myRadiusX: Bounding combat collision radius governing weapon reach and spacing checks.
properties.nextMove: Queued follow-up state enum scheduled for evaluation upon current state exit.
properties.notifiedThreats: Hostile entities already notified of incoming strikes to prevent duplicate block alerts.
properties.numEnemiesWaitingForMe1: Attack slot overflow counter (buffer 1) tracking enemies queued for an engagement slot.
properties.numEnemiesWaitingForMe2: Attack slot overflow counter (buffer 2) tracking enemies queued for an engagement slot.
properties.stateMap: Hash map associating discrete combat state enums (`CHOP_WEAPON`, `BLOCK`, `STUMBLE`) with state handler objects.
properties.stateTimer: Elapsed simulation time accumulator for current combat state phase.
properties.stats: Character attributes, skill levels (Melee Attack, Melee Defense, Dexterity, Strength), and weapon masteries.
properties.stumbleForce: Total physical impact magnitude ($blunt + cut + pierce + extraStun$) determining knockback severity.
properties.stumbleTimer: Remaining duration in seconds of current stagger / stumble animation sequence.
properties.targetsInAttackZone: Dynamic array of potential collateral cleave target handles within weapon swing arc.
properties.techniqueIntegrityCheckTimer: Failsafe timer aborting frozen or desynchronized animations.
properties.threats: Resolved pointers to active hostile characters within immediate tactical threat radius.
properties.threatsH: Persistent entity handles for active hostile threats.
properties.waitCountAlternator: Ping-pong buffer toggle alternating between overflow counters across update ticks.
properties.wantsToBlock: Defensive intent flag indicating character wishes to abort current posture into an active guard.
properties.whenCanStopStumble: Minimum elapsed stumble time required before character is permitted to cancel stagger into a block.

CombatClassAI.description: Autonomous tactical combat decision engine extending `CombatClass` with NPC AI behaviors. Implements tactical target selection, NavMesh line-of-sight raycasts, distance maintenance (`isInMeiDistance`), circling and strafing maneuvers (`circleState`), attack slot queue waiting (`waitState`), and priority arbitration (`whoAttacksYouOrMe`).

methods.CombatClassAI: Constructs the `CombatClassAI` controller, initializing base `CombatClass`, allocating the line-of-sight raycast tracer, and setting target tracking defaults.
methods.attackState: AI melee attack execution override. Verifies target validity, evaluates emergency parry requirements via `checkForNeedBlock`, and advances swing execution.
methods.blockState: AI defensive block execution override. Maintains weapon parry or unarmed dodge alignment towards attacking opponent until strike resolves.
methods.chooseAttackTarget: Tactical target selection algorithm. Scans active threats, respects `focusedTarget` if locked, weighs distance vs threat score, and applies target change cooldown to prevent thrashing.
methods.circleState: Executes `CIRCLE` state handler from `stateMap`, strafing tangentially around the opponent while waiting for attack opportunities.
methods.decisionState: Core AI tactical branch arbitrator. Evaluates current animation status, picks or validates attack target, checks engagement spacing (`isInMeiDistance`), attempts attack slot acquisition, or transitions to circling/waiting.
methods.gotMoreImportantThingsToDoThanFightingYo: Heuristic check against active AI package goals. Returns true if high-priority non-combat tasks (fleeing, healing dying comrades, urgent repairs) override engaging this opponent.
methods.hasFocusedTarget: Returns the locked `focusedTarget` handle if single-target focus mode is active.
methods.hesitateState: Brief tactical pause state between combat actions, allowing AI to re-evaluate threats.
methods.informOfFreeAttackSlot: Callback received when opponent's attack slot opens up. Prompts waiting AI to break out of `waitState` or `circleState` and launch an attack.
methods.initCombatMode: AI combat mode entry override. Sets `focusedTarget` and locks `reFocusableMode` if direct focus was requested.
methods.isAI: Returns true to indicate this combat controller is driven by autonomous NPC AI logic.
methods.isInMeiDistance: Tests whether spatial separation to current target lies strictly within effective melee engagement bounds ($MEI\_MIN \le \text{dist} \le MEI\_MAX$).
methods.periodicUpdate: Performs periodic maintenance tick. Calls base `CombatClass::periodicUpdate` and synchronizes target pathfinding requests through `CharMovement`.
methods.startupState: Initializes AI combat engagement, choosing an initial target and entering decision phase.
methods.targetPathBlocked: Returns whether line of sight to current combat target is obstructed.
methods.tracerUpdate: Casts a Havok NavMesh line-of-sight ray from character's collision capsule to current target, caching obstruction state into `targetTraceBlocked`.
methods.update: Drives AI combat evaluation tick. Updates line-of-sight raycasts to target, then dispatches to tactical decision, waiting, circling, or base attack/block handlers.
methods.waitState: Executes `WAIT` state handler from `stateMap`, maintaining defensive distance while queued for an available attack slot.
methods.whoAttacksYouOrMe: Arbitrates initiative between this AI and an opponent when both seek to strike simultaneously, comparing dexterity, weapon speed, and combat dice rolls.
methods.~CombatClassAI: Destructs the `CombatClassAI` instance, releasing allocated line-of-sight tracer objects.

properties.focusedTarget: Forced priority target handle assigned by high-level AI tactical goals.
properties.reFocusableMode: Toggle determining whether AI is permitted to dynamically switch targets based on immediate threat scoring.
properties.targetLastChangedTimer: Game timestamp of most recent target selection, preventing rapid target thrashing.
properties.targetTraceBlocked: Flag indicating direct line of sight to current target is obstructed by geometry or closed doors.
properties.tracer: Continuous line-of-sight raycast tracer querying NavMesh obstacle intersections between combatants.

methods.update: Pure virtual per-frame motor update function. Subclasses must implement this to process continuous combat logic and handle active player command overrides like hold, block, and passive stances.
methods.whoAttacksYouOrMe: Pure virtual initiative arbiter method. Determines whether the current player character or the targeted opposing character has the right of way to attack, factoring in player commands.
methods.~CombatClassPlayer: Pure virtual destructor for the `CombatClassPlayer` interface class. This ensures that any derived implementations properly clean up their allocated player-specific combat resources upon destruction.

CombatClass_AttackSlotManager_SlotData.description: Represents an individual melee attack slot reservation tracking an attacker handle and timing in combat.

properties.time: The timestamp or remaining duration of the attack slot reservation.
properties.who: The hand handle referencing the attacking Character occupying this slot.

CombatClass_EffectData.description: Stores visual and particle effect parameters attached to a character or bone during combat animations.

methods.operator_assign: Copies the values from another CombatClass_EffectData instance into this instance and returns self.
methods.operator_eq: Returns true if all fields of this effect data match those of another CombatClass_EffectData instance.

properties.boneName: Skeleton bone name string to which the effect is attached.
properties.character: The hand handle referencing the Character playing the effect.
properties.data: The GameData definition specifying the effect parameters.
properties.pos: Relative position offset table (Ogre::Vector3) of the effect.
properties.rot: Relative rotation orientation table (Ogre::Quaternion) of the effect.

CombatMovementController.description: Helper controller embedded in CharMovement that manages close-quarters combat positioning, circling, strafing, and local character repulsion.

methods.addACharacterObstruction: Registers character c as an obstruction in characterCollisions.
methods.areTherePeopleInMyWay: Returns true if other characters are obstructing combat movement.
methods.chasingModeCheck: Evaluates whether the character should enter chase mode toward whoTarget (Character) and returns the result.
methods.checkCharacterCollision: Returns true if moving from pos by movement (Vector3 tables) would collide with another character.
methods.checkWeDontCollideWithCharacters: Checks and adjusts movement from pos toward newpos (Vector3 tables) to avoid character overlap.
methods.collisionUpdate: Updates character collision timers over time seconds.
methods.combatMovementUpdate: Updates standing combat movement over frametime given currentPos, currentDirIn, isCurrentlyMoving, repulsionVector, facingDirOut, defensive flag, combatState (swordStateEnum), and raceSpeedMult.
methods.combatMovementUpdate_crippleMode: Updates crippled/crawling combat movement over frametime given currentPos, currentDirIn, isCurrentlyMoving, repulsionVector, facingDirOut, defensive flag, combatState (swordStateEnum), and raceSpeedMult.
methods.create: Initializes the combat movement controller with flock (FlockingTools), move (CharMovement), med (CharStats), and strafe capability flag.
methods.disable: Disables active combat movement control and resets combat target state.
methods.getGUIData: Populates debug or inspection UI entries in panel (DatapanelGUI) under category.
methods.getUrgentVelocities: Computes urgent avoidance/repulsion velocity (Vector3 table) at pos with facingDir (Vector3 tables).
methods.setForcedWP: Sets a forced combat waypoint v (Vector3 table) and enables hasForcedWP.
methods.setupCombatMovementVariables: Initializes combat movement thresholds and damping parameters for character me.

properties.ALLY_DIST: Preferred separation distance from allied characters during combat.
properties.ENEMY_DIST: Preferred separation distance from enemy characters during combat.

properties.TOTALREPULSION_DAMPING: Damping multiplier applied to total flocking repulsion in combat.

properties.chaseStateTimer: Timer tracking how long chaseMode has been active.
properties.circlingSpeed: Lateral circling speed around the combat target.
properties.combatMaxDistance: Maximum desired engagement distance from combatTarget.
properties.combatMinDistance: Minimum desired engagement distance from combatTarget.
properties.combatTarget: Handle (hand) of the primary combat target character.
properties.flockingControl: Pointer to the character's FlockingTools instance.
properties.forcedWP: World position (Vector3 table) of the forced combat waypoint.
properties.hasForcedWP: Whether a forced combat waypoint (forcedWP) is currently active.
properties.jogMode: Whether the character is jogging rather than strafing to reposition.
properties.lookAtCharacter: Handle (hand) of the character to face during combat.
properties.movement: Back-pointer to the owning CharMovement controller.
properties.powerThrough: Whether the character ignores obstructions to push through toward the target.
properties.radius: Collision and spacing radius used in combat movement.
properties.speedLimit: Maximum speed limit for the current combat movement maneuver.

CombatTechniqueData.description: Combat technique animation data, defining attack trajectory, speed, distance, and hit timings.

methods.CombatTechniqueData: Constructs a new combat technique instance by parsing raw configuration data. This initializes all the properties of the combat technique using the key-value mappings present in the provided `GameData` definition.
methods.hasSkillType: Checks whether the combat technique applies to a given weapon class. It achieves this by reading from the internally parsed skill applicability bitmask.
methods.impactPoint: Accesses detailed parameters for a given collision frame in the technique animation. This uses pointer arithmetic over the internal `impactPoints` collection buffer.
methods.numImpactPoints: Retrieves the total number of distinct impact timings defined within this technique. This count represents how many consecutive strikes the animation contains.

properties.acceptableEndTime01: Normalized animation frame after which follow-up actions can queue.
properties.animation: Name of the animation resource for this martial art/weapon technique.
properties.gainsGround: True if root motion steps forward toward target.
properties.hesitationPoint: Normalized animation point where attacker pauses to read defense.
properties.isBlock: True if this technique functions as a weapon block.
properties.isDodge: True if this technique functions as a martial arts evasion dodge.
properties.isProne: True if attack sweeps low to the ground.
properties.maxEncumbrance: Maximum gear encumbrance before technique is locked out.
properties.maxSkill: Skill rating where technique reaches maximum selection weight.
properties.maxTargetHits: Maximum targets cleavable by a single swing.
properties.minSkill: Minimum required skill rating to unlock this technique.
properties.skillTypes: Bitmask array of compatible weapon skill categories.
properties.stumbleDodge: True if executable while recovering from stagger.

ConstructionState.description: Tracks the construction and dismantling progress, required build materials, and active builder count for a Building (Building::ConstructionState).

methods.addMaterials: Adds one unit of the specified material GameData toward the building's construction requirements.
methods.getBuildingSpeedMultiplier: Static method (callable on ConstructionState or an instance) that returns the construction speed multiplier defined in the given building GameData.
methods.getBuildingTimeInHours: Static method (callable on ConstructionState or an instance) that returns the base construction time in hours for the given building GameData.
methods.getConstructionMaterialProgress: Returns the normalized progress limit (0.0 to 1.0) allowed by the materials currently delivered to the site.
methods.getHealthBarActual: Returns a formatted string representing the building's current health or construction state.
methods.getHealthBarProgress: Returns the normalized construction or health bar progress (0.0 to 1.0) for GUI display.
methods.getMaterial: Returns the BuildMaterial entry corresponding to the specified material GameData, or nil if not used.
methods.getNeededMats: Populates the provided Lektor<BuildMaterial> out-parameter with still-needed materials, or returns a 1-indexed array table of BuildMaterial objects if called with no argument.
methods.getTotalMats: Returns the total number of material units required to complete construction.
methods.getTotalMatsPresent: Returns the total number of material units delivered to the construction site so far.
methods.isOverThreshold: Returns true if construction progress has passed the pathfinding obstruction threshold.
methods.materialsEmpty: Returns true if no construction materials have been added to the building yet.
methods.needMats: Returns true if the construction site still requires additional materials to finish building.
methods.needsMat: Returns the remaining quantity of the specified material GameData needed for construction.
methods.setup: Initializes the material requirements and construction parameters from the given building GameData.

properties.buildTimeMult: Multiplier applied to construction progress speed.
properties.buildersThisFrame: Number of characters actively constructing the building during the current frame.
properties.constructionProgress: Current construction completion progress from 0.0 to 1.0.
properties.isComplete: True if construction of the building is finished.
properties.isDismantled: True if the building is currently being dismantled or has been dismantled.
properties.isPaused: True if construction on the building is paused.
properties.mats: Lektor<BuildMaterial> list of material requirements and their current delivery progress.
properties.pathThreshold: Construction progress threshold at which the building begins blocking pathfinding.
properties.totalMats: Total number of material units required to construct the building.

methods.isEmpty: Returns true if the consumption slot currently holds no items.
methods.isFull: Returns true if the consumption slot has reached its maximum item capacity.

ContainerItem.description: Wearable backpack and storage container item. Extends `Item` and `RaceLimiter` with nested `Inventory` management, weight reduction scaling, athletics speed modifiers, combat skill penalties, stealth penalties, and race equipment whitelist/blacklist verification.

methods.ContainerItem: Constructs a `ContainerItem` instance, initializing base item states, reading backpack combat and speed penalties from the FCS blueprint, instantiating the internal nested `Inventory`, and populating race exclusion lists.
methods._loadFromSerialise: Low-level deserialization routine restoring container properties and reconstructing the nested inventory from saved child records.
methods._serialise: Low-level serialization routine recording item records and serializing the nested inventory as a linked instanced record.
methods.canEquip: Verifies whether a specific character race is permitted to equip this container, checking against the `racesExclude` blacklist.
methods.createInventoryLayout: Instantiates a `BackpackInventoryLayout` GUI layout descriptor for rendering this container's grid in the player interface.
methods.doubleCheckHandle: Validates that the container's handle is registered with the global `HandleManager`, repairing and re-registering the handle mapping if corrupted.
methods.dropItem: Delegates item drop requests to the wearing character (`callbackOwner`).
methods.equipItem: Delegates equipment event notifications to the owning character (`callbackOwner`).
methods.getClassType: Returns the container item type enumeration code (`itemType::CONTAINER` = 0x2E).
methods.getInventory: Returns the internal nested `Inventory` instance managing this container's stored items.
methods.getMoney: Delegates currency balance inquiry to the wearing character (`callbackOwner`).
methods.getPosition: Returns the spatial coordinates of the container: queries the wearing character's position if worn, or returns internal ground coordinates if dropped.
methods.getTooltipData1: Constructs GUI tooltip strings displaying backpack grid size, weight reduction factor, athletics speed multiplier, combat speed penalty, stealth modifier, and excluded races.
methods.getTooltipData2: Constructs secondary GUI tooltip strings for mercantile evaluation, trade pricing, and stolen status.
methods.loadFromSerialise: Restores container item attributes and inner inventory contents from a savegame state record.
methods.serialise: Serializes the container item into a savegame record, serializing base item data and invoking recursive serialization on the internal inventory.
methods.setProperOwner: Updates the rightful owner handle on this container and propagates the ownership change recursively to all items stored inside the nested inventory.
methods.takeMoney: Delegates currency deduction to the wearing character (`callbackOwner`).
methods.unequipItem: Delegates unequip event notifications to the owning character (`callbackOwner`).
methods.~ContainerItem: Destructs the `ContainerItem`, closing any open GUI panels via `ForgottenGUI::closeInventory`, deleting the nested `Inventory`, clearing race sets, and invoking base item destructors.

properties._base: Inherited base item state, transform, visual meshes, and physics actors.
properties._limiter: Inherited race restriction manager controlling race equipment eligibility.
properties.athleticsMult: Athletics movement run-speed multiplier while container is worn (e.g. 0.8f for a 20% speed penalty).
properties.callbackOwner: Wearing character entity receiving equip, unequip, and currency transaction notifications.
properties.combatSkillBonus: Flat combat skill bonus/penalty applied to wearer while backpack is equipped.
properties.combatSpeedMult: Combat animation attack and block speed multiplier (e.g. 0.9f for a 10% penalty).
properties.inventory: Pointer to internal nested inventory grid holding stored items.
properties.racesExclude: Hash set of character race FCS records prohibited from equipping this container.
properties.stealthMult: Sneaking visibility and stealth effectiveness multiplier (e.g. 0.7f).
properties.weightMult: Encumbrance reduction multiplier applied to items stored inside this container (e.g. 0.5f for 50% mass reduction).

CraftingBuilding.description: `CraftingBuilding` extends `ProductionBuilding` to implement Kenshi's item creation system, powering weapon smithies, armour workbenches, crossbow fletchers, leather tanneries, robotics benches, and medical craft tables.

methods.CraftingBuilding: Constructs a new `CraftingBuilding` workstation in the game world, initializing recipe queues, skill ceilings, and item category filters from blueprint data.
methods._addCraft: Enqueues a new crafting recipe order at the tail of the production queue, instantiating the item blueprint and setting base fabrication time.
methods._removeCraft: Cancels and removes a recipe order at the specified queue index, refunding unprocessed raw materials.
methods.addFinishedCraftItem: Deposits a newly fabricated item into the workbench output section or drops it on the floor if output space is filled.
methods.calculateCriticalChance: Calculates the percentage probability (0.0% - 50.0%) that the fabricated item will critically succeed to the next quality grade, based on the smith's skill exceeding the tier's minimum requirement.
methods.canHaveSomeOfThese: Determines whether this workbench can accept the proposed item blueprint during hauling deposits, matching against ingredients for all queued recipes.
methods.createInventoryLayout: Constructs a specialized `CraftingInventoryLayout` GUI controller managing recipe selection buttons, queue lists, and input/output inventory sections.
methods.destroyProductionItem: Destroys the temporary physical item template used during the crafting cycle.
methods.getAvailableCrafts: Collects all crafting recipes unlocked by the player faction's researched technology tree that are compatible with this workbench type.
methods.getCraft: Retrieves a queued recipe order item descriptor by zero-based index from the order deque.
methods.getCriticalSuccessWeapon: Resolves the upgraded weapon model tier record awarded on a critical success roll, advancing from Refitted Blade to Catun, Mk, or Edge Type.
methods.getCurrentProductionQuantity: Returns the count of finished items resting in the output inventory grid.
methods.getGUIData: Renders telemetry data to the HUD Datapanel, displaying active crafting recipe name, completion percentage, and craftsman name.
methods.getGUIState: Renders current operational state string (e.g. "Crafting", "Queue Empty", "No Materials", "Output Full") to the HUD.
methods.getItemsWeWantRidOf: Populates a list of finished crafted equipment ready to be hauled away to storage bins.
methods.getPlayerCraftedWeaponLevel: Computes the baseline weapon grade level for an item fabricated by player characters.
methods.getProductionItemData: Resolves the item blueprint record for the recipe currently being crafted at the head of the queue.
methods.givePower: Supplies electrical wattage to motorized workbenches (e.g. robotic smithies or electric smelters).
methods.hasCraftingQueued: Evaluates whether the crafting queue currently contains active recipe orders awaiting fabrication.
methods.isAnyInputsInvalidType: Verifies that items resting in input inventory sections match ingredients demanded by the active recipe queue.
methods.isProductionFull: Evaluates whether the output section has sufficient room to accept the largest item in the current recipe queue.
methods.loadFromSerialise: Restores recipe queue orders, progress percentages, and repeat flags from serialized savegame records.
methods.newCraftingButton: MyGUI click event callback opening the recipe selection modal dialog.
methods.notifyCraftFailiure: Triggers an audible notification and UI status message indicating fabrication has stalled due to missing raw materials.
methods.operate: Advances active recipe crafting progress under character operation. Checks power, consumes ingredients, rolls quality, and awards crafting experience to the operator.
methods.playerManufacturerData: Retrieves the singleton FCS manufacturer template record representing player-crafted weapon branding and grade thresholds.
methods.predictCraftersBestWeapon: Predicts the highest weapon grade a craftsman can produce at this workbench given their current skill level and workbench tier ceiling.
methods.serialise: Serializes recipe queue orders, progress percentages, repeat flags, and active craftsman handles into savegame delta records.
methods.setProductionItem: Sets the active production item to match the current recipe order at the head of the queue.
methods.setupFromData: Parses the FCS `BUILDING_FUNCTIONALITY` record, loading craftable item type filters, skill ceilings, and recipe categories.
methods.tryOperate: Validates whether a character can begin operating this crafting bench, verifying queue presence, material availability, and output clearance.
methods.update: Simulation tick for the crafting workbench. Advances base machine state, checks operator presence, and refreshes the queue GUI.
methods.updateInventoryWindow: Synchronizes the crafting GUI window, updating recipe queue listboxes, progress bars, and material requirements.
methods.updateOutput: Accumulates recipe fabrication progress; upon reaching 100%, generates the finished item, executes quality rolls, applies critical model bonuses, and handles repeat queue looping.
methods.~CraftingBuilding: Destructs the `CraftingBuilding` instance, releasing active recipe queue items, deleting in-progress item instances, and clearing input references.

properties.biggestCraftableItem: Size reference item record used for inventory footprint validation.
properties.crafting: Queued crafting recipe orders scheduled by the player.
properties.failiureNotified: Flag suppressing duplicate UI notifications when missing raw materials.

Damages.description: The `Damages` struct is Kenshi's core value-type data structure representing multi-channel physical trauma payloads. It is constructed during combat attacks, passed across animation hit callbacks, mitigated by armour calculations, and applied to character anatomical health systems.

methods.multiply: Scales the primary physical damage channels (`cut`, `blunt`, `pierce`, and `extraStun`) in-place by the specified multiplier. Does not scale `bleedMult` or `armourPenetration`. Used for critical strike multipliers, strength scaling, and body part toughness degradation.
methods.total: Calculates the absolute aggregate raw hitpoint damage represented by this payload by summing `cut`, `blunt`, and `pierce`. Used for floating combat text numbers, weapon tooltip comparisons, and threat aggregation calculations.
methods.~Damages: Destructor for the damage payload. Deallocates resources if allocated via Ogre's memory pool policy.

properties.armourPenetration: Percentage factor (`0.0f` to `1.0f`) that bypasses the target's equipped armor defense layers during mitigation.
properties.bleedMult: Scalar multiplier applied to the target's bleeding rate calculation when laceration occurs. Default is `1.0f`.
properties.blunt: Non-lethal concussive trauma. Contributes to temporary KO thresholds, unconsciousness time, and limb shock.
properties.cut: Lethal laceration and slicing damage. Direct contributor to open flesh wounds and immediate bleeding rates.
properties.extraStun: Additional stun damage applied directly to character incapacitation meters without reducing structural hitpoints.
properties.pierce: High-velocity ballistic/harpoon penetration damage. Pierces armor plating with specialized damage mitigation curves.

methods.setTabEnabled: Enables or disables interaction with the category tab matching the given ID.
methods.setTabName: Updates the displayed label text of the tab with the specified ID.
methods.show: Displays or hides the data panel with smooth animation.
methods.showTabs: Shows or hides the category tab selection bar.
methods.show_NonSmooth: Instantly displays or hides the data panel without smooth transition animations.
methods.update: Updates and refreshes visible data lines, scroll positions, and dynamic values.

properties.DATALINESPACING: Vertical spacing distance in pixels between consecutive data lines.
properties.DATALINETHICKNESS: Standard pixel height of individual data lines in the panel.
properties.automaticRefresh: Whether automatic periodic refreshing is currently active.
properties.automaticTarget: Whether the panel automatically switches targets when selection changes.
properties.basicSpacing: Whether basic uniform line spacing is enforced.
properties.currentCategory: The integer ID of the currently displayed category tab.
properties.frequentUpdatesWanted: Whether frequent high-rate update polling is requested.
properties.h: Current height of the data panel in pixels.
properties.isWindow: Whether this panel operates as a standalone window rather than an embedded sub-panel.
properties.layer: The MyGUI UI rendering layer name on which this panel is placed.
properties.mouseOverEvent: Raw pointer (lightuserdata) to the mouse-over callback function delegate.
properties.mouseOverEventDatas: Raw pointer (lightuserdata) to user data passed to mouse-over callbacks.
properties.panelName: The unique string name identifier of this data panel.
properties.premadeParentWindow: Whether this data panel was attached to a pre-existing parent window.
properties.scrollView: The MyGUI::ScrollView widget providing scrolling for panel lines.
properties.scrollWin: The MyGUI::Window widget containing the scrollable view area.
properties.scrolling: Whether scrolling behavior is enabled on this data panel.
properties.tabWin: The MyGUI::Widget container hosting category tab buttons.
properties.tabs: List (lektor<MyGUI::Button*>) of category tab button widgets.
properties.w: Current width of the data panel in pixels.
properties.x: Current X screen pixel position of the data panel.
properties.y: Current Y screen pixel position of the data panel.

DelayedSpawnMsg.description: Queued message structure (TownBase::DelayedSpawnMsg) used during town generation to defer spawning items, creature nests, or building occupants.

properties.insideBuilding: Hand handle of the interior building where the entity will spawn, or a null hand if outdoors.
properties.item: Item instance queued to spawn, or nil.
properties.nestData: Template GameData record defining an animal nest or camp to spawn, or nil.
properties.parentTown: Hand handle of the TownBase managing this delayed spawn.
properties.pos: World-space position vector table where the entity will be placed.

DialogAction.description: Represents an action effect entry on a `DialogLineData` (wrapping `DialogLineData::DialogAction`), pairing a `DialogActionEnum` key with an integer parameter value.

properties.key: Dialogue action type (`DialogActionEnum` integer) to execute.
properties.value: Integer parameter value associated with the dialogue action.

DialogChoiceList.description: Holds a list of `DialogLineData` conversation choices that can be evaluated and selected during dialogue.

methods.add: Creates or retrieves a `DialogLineData` for `conversation` (`GameData`) with `parent` (`DialogLineData`) and appends it to `conversationChoices`.

properties.conversationChoices: List (`Lektor<DialogLineData>`) of child or root dialogue line choices.

DialogCondition.description: Represents a single condition entry on a `DialogLineData` (wrapping `DialogLineData::DialogCondition`), comparing a condition key on a specified speaker against a target value.

properties.compareBy: Comparison operator (`ComparisonEnum` integer) used to evaluate the condition.
properties.key: Dialogue condition type (`DialogConditionEnum` integer) to evaluate.
properties.value: Target integer value compared against the evaluated condition.
properties.who: Subject of the condition check (`TalkerEnum` integer).

DialogDataManager.description: Static manager responsible for creating, caching, saving, loading, and resetting global `DialogLineData` instances.

methods._createData: Static method (called without self) that creates and returns a new `DialogLineData` instance from the given `GameData` (`d`).
methods.getData: Static method (called without self) that retrieves or creates the `DialogLineData` corresponding to the given `GameData` (`d`).
methods.initialise: Static method that initializes the global dialogue data manager.
methods.load: Static method (called without self) that loads global dialogue line states from the given `GameData` (`d`).
methods.newGameReset: Static method that resets global dialogue line state for a new game.
methods.save: Static method (called without self) that saves global dialogue line states into the given `GameData` (`d`).

DialogLineData.description: Represents a single dialogue line or node in a conversation tree, including its text variants, speaker, conditions, actions, and child responses.

methods.checkConditions: Evaluates all conditions and tag checks for this line given `dialog` (`Dialogue`), `target` (`Character`), and `isWordswap` (`boolean`), returning true if valid.
methods.checkRepeatLimits: Returns true if this dialogue line satisfies its once-only and minimum repeat interval limits.
methods.checkTags: Checks character, race, faction, town, and item tag requirements between `me` (`Character`) and `target` (`Character`), returning true if satisfied.
methods.chooseAChild: Selects and returns a valid child `DialogLineData` for `who` (`Dialogue`) and `target` (`Character`), optionally for word swaps (`isForWordswaps`).
methods.getActions: Returns the `Lektor<DialogAction>` containing the actions executed when this line is spoken.
methods.getChildByStringID: Finds and returns a direct child `DialogLineData` matching the given string ID (`sid`), or nil if not found.
methods.getGameData: Returns the underlying `GameData` object defining this dialogue line.
methods.getMoneyCostForLine: Returns the money cost required by any `DA_TAKE_MONEY` action on this line.
methods.getName: Returns the name of the underlying `GameData` for this dialogue line.
methods.getParent: Returns the parent `DialogLineData` node in the conversation tree, or nil if this is a root node.
methods.getPlayerReplies: Populates the output `Lektor<DialogLineData>` (`out`) with valid player reply lines for `who` (`Dialogue`) and `target` (`Character`).
methods.getScore: Calculates and returns the selection priority score of this dialogue line for `target` (`Character`).
methods.getScorePlusChildrenIfEmpty: Returns the score of this dialogue line for `target` (`Character`), or includes child scores if this node is empty.
methods.getStringID: Returns the string ID of the underlying `GameData`.
methods.getText: Selects and returns a text string variant from this dialogue line, optionally stamping `lastTimeSaid` (`_stampTime`).
methods.hasChildren: Returns true if this dialogue line has any child dialogue lines.
methods.hasSpecificCharacterRequirement: Returns true if this dialogue line is restricted to specific character templates (`isCharacter` is non-empty).
methods.isAnnouncement: Returns true if this dialogue line is configured as an announcement.
methods.isEmptyNode: Returns true if this dialogue node contains no text lines (`lineCount == 0`).
methods.isForSpecificCharacter: Returns true if this dialogue line has a character requirement matching `who` (`GameData`).
methods.saidItBefore: Returns true if this dialogue line has already been spoken at least once.
methods.setParent: Sets the parent `DialogLineData` pointer (`p`) for this node.
methods.setupChildren: Initializes the child `DialogChoiceList` from the underlying `GameData`.
methods.stampLastTimeSaid: Updates `lastTimeSaid` to the current game time.
methods.willTalkToEnemies: Returns true if this dialogue line or its children permit talking to enemies.

properties.actions: List (`Lektor<DialogAction>`) of actions executed when this dialogue line is triggered.
properties.campaignTriggers: Weighted selector (`FitnessSelectorCampaignTriggerData`) of campaigns that can be triggered by this line.
properties.chancePermanent: Permanent percentage chance for this line to be available.
properties.chanceTemporary: Temporary percentage chance for this line to be selected.
properties.children: Child dialogue choices (`DialogChoiceList`) branching from this line.
properties.conditions: List (`Lektor<DialogCondition>`) of numeric and state conditions required for this line.
properties.crowdTrigger: Follow-up `DialogLineData` triggered in nearby crowd characters when this line is spoken.
properties.data: Underlying `GameData` asset for this dialogue line.
properties.dialogRepeatMinTimeInHours: Minimum cooldown time in game hours before this dialogue line can be repeated.
properties.factionRelationEffects: Map (`OgreUnorderedMap<GameData, integer>`) of faction `GameData` to relation adjustments applied by this line.
properties.forCertainType: Required `CharacterTypeEnum` integer for the speaker or target.
properties.givesItem: Read-only list (`LektorReadOnly<GameDataValuePair>`) of items and quantities given when this line is spoken.
properties.hasItem: List (`Lektor<GameData>`) of item `GameData` templates required in inventory.
properties.hasItemType: Required item function type (`ItemFunction` enum integer).
properties.hasPackage: List (`Lektor<GameData>`) of dialogue package `GameData` objects associated with this line (binds C++ `_hasPackage`).
properties.inTownOf: Lua array table of `Faction` objects whose towns satisfy the location requirement (converted to/from `std::set<Faction*>`).
properties.isCharacter: List (`Lektor<GameData>`) of character `GameData` templates required for the speaker or target.
properties.isInterjection: Whether this line is an interjection node.
properties.isLocked: Whether this dialogue line is locked by default.
properties.isMonologue: Whether this dialogue line is a monologue that does not require a target.
properties.isMyFaction: Lua array table of `Faction` objects required for the speaking character (converted to/from `std::set<Faction*>`).
properties.isMyRace: List (`Lektor<GameData>`) of race `GameData` templates allowed for the speaker.
properties.isMySubRace: List (`Lektor<GameData>`) of sub-race `GameData` templates allowed for the speaker.
properties.isTargetCarryingCharacter: List (`Lektor<GameData>`) of character `GameData` templates that the target must be carrying.
properties.isTargetFaction: Lua array table of `Faction` objects required for the target character (converted to/from `std::set<Faction*>`).
properties.isTargetRace: List (`Lektor<GameData>`) of race `GameData` templates allowed for the target.
properties.isTargetSubRace_specificallyTheTarget: List (`Lektor<GameData>`) of sub-race `GameData` templates specifically required for the target.
properties.lastTimeSaid: Timestamp (`TimeOfDay`) recording when this dialogue line was last spoken.
properties.lineCount: Number of text string variations stored in `texts`.
properties.locks: List (`Lektor<DialogLineData>`) of dialogue lines that become locked when this line is spoken.
properties.onceOnly: Whether this dialogue line can only be spoken once.
properties.oneAtATime: Whether only one character can speak this line at a time.
properties.parent: Parent `DialogLineData` node in the dialogue tree.
properties.personalityNeeded: Bitmask of personality flags required on the speaker.
properties.personalityNotWanted: Bitmask of personality flags disallowed on the speaker.
properties.playerInterruptionDialog: Dialogue line (`DialogLineData`) triggered if the player interrupts this line.
properties.score: Base priority score for selecting this dialogue line.
properties.speaker: Speaker role (`TalkerEnum` integer) assigned to deliver this line.
properties.targetFlagsNeeded: Bitmask of target state flags required for this line.
properties.targetFlagsNotWanted: Bitmask of target state flags disallowed for this line.
properties.texts: Lua array table of text string variations for this line (or nil if none; setting accepts a table of strings or a single string and updates `lineCount`).
properties.unique: Whether this dialogue line is unique to a single owner character.
properties.uniqueOwner: Handle (`hand`) to the unique owner character of this line.
properties.unlocks_dontLockMe: List (`Lektor<DialogLineData>`) of dialogue lines unlocked by this line without locking this line.
properties.unlocks_lockMe: List (`Lektor<DialogLineData>`) of dialogue lines unlocked by this line while locking this line.
properties.worldState: Pointer to the `WorldEventStateQueryList` conditions required for this line.

DialogState.description: Tracks trigger count, last trigger timestamp, and reset interval for a single dialogue event in `Dialogue::RepetitionCounter`.

properties.count: Number of times the dialogue event has been triggered.
properties.lastTimeStamp: Game time when the dialogue event was last triggered.
properties.resetTime: Time interval after which the repetition count resets.

Dialogue.description: Manages character dialogue state, active conversations, speech bubbles, word swaps, and dialogue event triggers for an individual character.

methods._checkCondition: Evaluates a single dialogue condition (`conditionName`, `compareBy`, `val`) against `target` and `actualConversationTarget`, returning true if satisfied.
methods._chooseDialog: Selects and returns the best valid `DialogLineData` from a `DialogChoiceList` for `target`, optionally for word swap resolution (`isWordswap`).
methods._doActions: Executes all `DialogAction` effects attached to the specified `DialogLineData`.
methods._endPlayerConversation: Ends an active player conversation, optionally marking it as finished (`finished`).
methods._updateTextPos: Updates the screen position of the character's speech bubble panel.
methods.addConversation: Adds a conversation `GameData` to this character's dialogue choices for the specified `EventTriggerEnum` (`t`).
methods.addDialoguePackage: Adds all conversations from a dialogue package `GameData` to this character.
methods.changeConversationTarget: Changes the current conversation target to the specified `Character`.
methods.clearAnnouncements: Clears active announcement dialogues from this character.
methods.clearConversationList: Clears all dialogue choices associated with the specified `EventTriggerEnum` (`t`).
methods.clearDialogues: Clears all loaded dialogue packages and conversation lists from this character.
methods.clearRespones: Clears the stored player response strings and reply IDs.
methods.clearResponesGUI: Clears the player response options from the dialogue GUI.
methods.clearSpeechBox: Clears and hides the character's overhead speech bubble.
methods.conversationHasEnded: Returns true if the current conversation has finished.
methods.conversationHasEndedPrettyMuch: Returns true if the current conversation has ended or is on its final line without remaining replies.
methods.create: Initializes this dialogue controller with pointers to its owning `Character`, `CharStats`, and `CharMovement`.
methods.dialogDelivered: Returns true if the dialogue for the specified `EventTriggerEnum` (`e`) has been delivered to the current target.
methods.dontLetTargetBeMe: Replaces the target character pointer with `actualTarget` if it points to the speaking character itself (note: the Lua binding passes a temporary local pointer and does not return the modified pointer).
methods.endDialogue: Ends the current dialogue conversation, optionally marking it as completely finished (`definitelyTheEnd`).
methods.findInterjectionCharacter: Finds and returns a nearby `Character` eligible to speak the interjection `line` (`DialogLineData`).
methods.getCharacter: Returns the `Character` that owns this dialogue controller.
methods.getConversationList: Returns the `DialogChoiceList` registered for the specified `EventTriggerEnum` (`t`), or nil if none exists.
methods.getConversationTarget: Returns the `hand` handle of the current conversation target character.
methods.getGUIData: Populates the specified `DatapanelGUI` category with debug or status information for this dialogue component.
methods.getHandle: Returns the `hand` handle of the owning character.
methods.getSpeaker: Resolves and returns the `Character` corresponding to the specified `TalkerEnum` (`who`) for `line`, optionally for word swaps (`isForWordswaps`).
methods.getWordSwap: Resolves and returns the replacement string for a word swap key (`key`) given a target `Character`, boolean flag, and `DialogLineData`.
methods.hasDialogueEvent: Returns true if this character has any dialogue choices registered for the specified `EventTriggerEnum` (`e`).
methods.hasDialogue_Accurate: Performs a full condition check and returns true if this character has valid player-interactive dialogue available.
methods.hasDialogue_Fast: Performs a fast check and returns true if this character has player-interactive dialogue available.
methods.hasThisChanceLine: Checks or rolls the probability (`chance`) for a chance-based `DialogLineData` and returns true if it passes for this character.
methods.isAtTownOf: Returns true if the character is currently in a town belonging to any `Faction` in the provided Lua array table.
methods.isCurrentConversationRunning: Returns true if `line` (`DialogLineData`) is the currently running conversation.
methods.isKOExempt: Returns true if the specified `EventTriggerEnum` (`what`) can be triggered even while knocked out.
methods.isLastLine: Returns true if `dialogLine` (`DialogLineData`) has no valid follow-up lines.
methods.isLocked: Returns true if the specified `DialogLineData` is currently locked for this character.
methods.listPlayerReplies: Populates the list of available player reply options for the current dialogue line.
methods.load: Loads this character's dialogue state from the given `GameData`.
methods.makeAnnouncement: Triggers an announcement dialogue from the given `GameData` and returns true if successful.
methods.needsDialogAssessmentUpdate: Returns true if this character requires a dynamic dialogue assessment update.
methods.notifyUnderAttack: Notifies the dialogue system that the character is under attack by `attacker` (`Character`).
methods.replyClicked: Handles the player selecting a dialogue reply by integer index or reply string ID.
methods.resolveOverlappedSpeechBubbles: Static method (callable on an instance or without self) that adjusts active speech bubble positions to prevent screen overlap.
methods.runCustomDialog: Starts a custom dialogue from the given `GameData` and returns true if successful.
methods.save: Saves this character's dialogue state into the given `GameData`.
methods.say: Displays spoken text for a dialogue line; accepts either `(text, line)` with a custom string and `DialogLineData`, or `(dialogLine)` with a `DialogLineData`.
methods.sayLine: Speaks the specified `DialogLineData` and returns true if the line was spoken.
methods.scoreCustomDialog: Evaluates and returns the priority score for a custom dialogue `GameData`.
methods.sendEvent: Triggers a dialogue event (`what`, `EventTriggerEnum`) targeting `who` (`Character`) and returns true if a dialogue started.
methods.sendEventOverride: Triggers a dialogue event (`what`, `EventTriggerEnum`) targeting `who` (`Character`), optionally forcing repetition (`forceRepeat`), and returns true if a dialogue started.
methods.setConversationReplyGUI: Updates the dialogue window GUI with the current NPC reply text.
methods.setInDialog: Sets whether this character is currently engaged in an active dialogue (`on`).
methods.setLineLocked: Sets the locked state (`on`) of the specified `DialogLineData` for this character.
methods.setResponesGUI: Updates the dialogue GUI with the current player response options.
methods.setSpeaker: Assigns `c` (`Character`) to the specified speaker slot (`who`, `TalkerEnum`).
methods.setupWordSwaps: Initializes the word swap lookup state for this dialogue controller.
methods.startConversation: Starts a conversation with `target` (`Character`) using `_talk` (`DialogLineData`) and event type `ev` (`EventTriggerEnum`), optionally forcing it (`force`), and returns true if started.
methods.startPlayerConversation: Starts an interactive conversation with the player character (`target`) using `_talk` (`DialogLineData`) and returns true if started.
methods.stopEvent: Stops an active dialogue conversation matching the specified `EventTriggerEnum` (`what`).
methods.targetInTalkingRange: Returns true if `target` (`Character`) is within talking range scaled by `mult`.
methods.triggerNextLine: Advances the conversation by triggering the next child dialogue line after `previousLine`.
methods.update: Updates dialogue timers, speech bubbles, and active conversation state for the given frame time (`frameTime`).
methods.willTalkToEnemies: Returns true if any of this character's dialogue lines allow talking to hostile characters.

properties._hasChanceLines: Map (`StdMap<DialogLineData, boolean>`) caching rolled outcomes for temporary chance dialogue lines on this character.
properties._hasEnded: Whether the current conversation has ended.
properties._needsDynamicAssessments: Whether this character's dialogue state requires dynamic re-assessment.
properties.conversationMaster: Handle (`hand`) to the character controlling the current multi-character conversation.
properties.conversationTarget: Handle (`hand`) to the target character of the current conversation.
properties.conversationsMain: Map (`StdMap<integer, DialogChoiceList>`) from `EventTriggerEnum` values to their corresponding `DialogChoiceList`.
properties.currentConversation: Root `DialogLineData` of the currently active conversation.
properties.currentConversationType: Current conversation event trigger type (`EventTriggerEnum` integer).
properties.currentLine: Currently active `DialogLineData` node in the conversation.
properties.eventDeliveredStates: Map (`StdMap<integer, hand>`) tracking which target `hand` each `EventTriggerEnum` has been delivered to.
properties.eventRepeatTimers: Map (`StdMap<integer, number>`) tracking cooldown timers for each `EventTriggerEnum`.
properties.interjector1: Handle (`hand`) to the first interjector character in the current conversation.
properties.interjector2: Handle (`hand`) to the second interjector character in the current conversation.
properties.interjector3: Handle (`hand`) to the third interjector character in the current conversation.
properties.locked: Map (`StdMap<DialogLineData, boolean>`) tracking which dialogue lines are locked for this character.
properties.me: The `Character` that owns this dialogue component.
properties.movement: The `CharMovement` component of the owning character.
properties.npcReplyText: Current NPC speech text displayed in the player dialogue window.
properties.pacakgesIHave: Lua array table of `GameData` dialogue packages added to this character (converted to/from `std::set<GameData*>`).
properties.playerInterruptionDialog: Dialogue line (`DialogLineData`) triggered when the player interrupts this character.
properties.repCounter: Embedded `RepetitionCounter` tracking event trigger counts and timestamps for this character.
properties.replyIds: Lua array table of string IDs corresponding to the current player reply choices.
properties.responses: Lua array table of display strings for the current player reply choices.
properties.sayMsg: Current or queued speech message string for this character.
properties.shouting: Whether the current speech line is being shouted.
properties.speechBubblePanel: Active overhead `DialogueSpeechBubble` GUI panel for this character.
properties.speechTextTimer: Remaining display timer in seconds for the current speech text.
properties.speechTextTimer_forced: Forced speech timer duration override in seconds.
properties.stats: The `CharStats` component of the owning character.
properties.staysOnScreen: Whether the character's speech bubble is clamped to stay within screen bounds.
properties.threadMessages: Lua array table of queued `Dialogue::DT_MSG` integer message codes for dialogue GUI thread synchronization.
properties.waitingForReplyFrom: Handle (`hand`) to the character that this dialogue is currently waiting on for a reply.

DialogueSpeechBubble.description: Floating speech bubble widget positioned in screen or world space displaying spoken dialogue lines above characters.

methods.getAlpha: Returns the current alpha transparency value of the bubble.
methods.getRect: Returns a table describing the screen bounding rectangle {left, top, width, height} of the speech bubble.
methods.reset: Resets the bubble state, clearing text and resetting display timers.
methods.setAlpha: Sets the opacity/transparency alpha value (0.0 to 1.0) of the speech bubble.
methods.setPosition: Sets the screen coordinate (x, y) or 3D world position (Ogre::Vector3) of the speech bubble.
methods.setText: Sets the speech bubble message text.

properties.baseSize: Table containing the default {width, height} dimensions of the speech bubble.
properties.marginH: Vertical margin padding in pixels around the text.
properties.marginW: Horizontal margin padding in pixels around the text.
properties.shout: Whether the speech bubble represents shouted dialogue with enlarged presentation.
properties.stayOnScreen: Whether the bubble is constrained to remain within the screen viewport boundaries.
properties.textBox: The MyGUI::EditBox widget displaying the speech text.

DialogueWindow.description: Subclass of GUIWindow that manages the dialogue and conversation interface, rendering speaker portraits, speech text, and player response choices.

methods.activateResponse: Selects and triggers the player dialogue response option at the specified 0-based index.
methods.changePortrait: Updates the portrait display for the specified Character (either player or NPC based on the player flag).
methods.clearResponses: Clears all active player dialogue response choices from the window.
methods.getTop: Returns the vertical pixel coordinate (top edge) of the dialogue window.
methods.getVisible: Returns true if the dialogue window is currently visible.
methods.hide: Hides and closes the dialogue window for the specified Dialogue instance.
methods.isVisible: Returns true if the dialogue window is visible on screen.
methods.setNPCText: Sets the speech dialogue text string spoken by the NPC.
methods.setResponses: Populates the dialogue response choices with an array of text strings.
methods.setVisible: Sets the visibility of the dialogue window.
methods.show: Opens the dialogue window for the specified Dialogue instance.
methods.update: Updates speech text animations, scroll states, and layout each frame.
methods.updatePanelsPosition: Recalculates and repositions the NPC and player speech panels.

properties.conversationNPCNameText: TextBox widget displaying the speaking NPC's name.
properties.conversationNPCPanel: Panel widget containing the NPC's portrait, name, and speech bubble.
properties.conversationNPCPanelHeightDiffSpeechPane: Height offset difference between the NPC panel and speech container.
properties.conversationNPCPortrait: ImageBox widget displaying the speaking NPC's portrait.
properties.conversationNPCSpeech: Widget displaying the NPC's spoken dialogue text.
properties.conversationNPCSpeechPanelMinHeight: Minimum pixel height allowed for the NPC speech panel.
properties.conversationPC: Pointer to the player Character currently speaking in the dialogue window.
properties.conversationPCMoneyText: TextBox widget showing the player faction's current Cats money during dialogue.
properties.conversationPCNameText: TextBox widget displaying the player character's name.
properties.conversationPCPanel: Panel widget containing player dialogue responses and character info.
properties.conversationPCPanelHeightDiffSpeechPanel: Height offset difference between the player panel and response container.
properties.conversationPCPortrait: ImageBox widget displaying the player character's portrait.
properties.conversationPCSpeechPanel: Panel widget containing the list of selectable player response buttons.
properties.conversationPCSpeechPanelMinHeight: Minimum pixel height allowed for the player speech panel.
properties.conversationPanelsMargin: Margin spacing in pixels between conversation panels.
properties.converstaionPCPanelBottom: Vertical bottom coordinate for positioning the player conversation panel.
properties.dialogue: Pointer to the active Dialogue state instance driving this conversation.
properties.replyTexts: List of MyGUI widgets representing individual clickable player reply choices.

DoorStuff.description: Building subclass representing a functional door or gate attached to a parent structure or gateway, managing open/close animations, lock state, gate codes, and melee damage.

methods._forceDoorClosedUT: Immediately forces the door into the closed state on the update thread and returns true on success.
methods._forceDoorOpenUT: Immediately forces the door into the open state on the update thread and returns true on success.
methods._getPhysActorUT: Returns the raw NxActor* physics actor pointer as lightuserdata.
methods._loadFromSerialise: Loads the door's state from the given GameData under the specified door identifier prefix.
methods._serialise: Saves the door's state into the given GameData under the specified door identifier prefix.
methods.closeDoor: Begins closing the door and returns true if the state transition succeeded.
methods.doorParentBuilding: Returns the parent Building that owns this door.
methods.getActorClosedPosition: Returns the closed-state world position of the door's physics actor as a Vector3 table {x, y, z}.
methods.getDefaultTask: Returns the default TaskType enum action performed when interacting with this door.
methods.getDoorLock: Returns the DoorLock* pointer as lightuserdata, or nil if the door has no lock.
methods.getDoorOpenAmount: Returns the current open progress of the door as a number between 0.0 (closed) and 1.0 (open).
methods.getDoorPosInside: Returns the world interaction position just inside the door as a Vector3 table {x, y, z}.
methods.getDoorPosInside_extraFarIn: Returns a world position table {x, y, z} inside the door offset along its inward axis by mult.
methods.getDoorPosOutside: Returns the world interaction position just outside the door as a Vector3 table {x, y, z}.
methods.getDoorPosOutside_extraFarOut: Returns a world position table {x, y, z} outside the door offset along its outward axis by mult.
methods.getDoorPosition: Returns the world position of the door as a Vector3 table {x, y, z}.
methods.getDoorState: Returns the door's current DoorState enum value.
methods.getFaction: Returns the Faction that owns this door or its parent building.
methods.getGUIData: Populates the specified DatapanelGUI category with door status, lock info, and control buttons.
methods.getGateCode: Returns the numeric gate navigation code assigned to this door.
methods.getMouseCursor: Returns the CursorType enum value displayed when hovering the mouse over this door.
methods.getName: Returns the display name of the door.
methods.getReachRange: Returns the maximum distance from which a character can interact with this door.
methods.hasDoorLock: Returns true if this door has a lock attached.
methods.hitByMeleeAttack: Processes a melee attack against the door from Character who using CombatTechniqueData attack and Damages, returning the resulting HitMaterialType enum value.
methods.isBroken: Returns true if the door has been battered down or broken.
methods.isDisabled: Returns true if the door is broken or otherwise disabled.
methods.isGate: Returns the GatewayBuilding instance if this door is a town gate, or nil otherwise.
methods.isLocked: Returns true if the door is currently locked.
methods.isOpen: Returns true if the door is currently open.
methods.isPublic: Returns true if the door or its parent building is open to the public.
methods.lockButton: GUI callback triggered when the player clicks the lock/unlock button on a DataPanelLine.
methods.needsUpdate: Returns true if the door currently requires per-frame updates (such as while opening or closing).
methods.onBuildingLoaded: Callback invoked when the door's 3D entities and physical representation finish loading.
methods.openButton: GUI callback triggered when the player clicks the open/close button on a DataPanelLine.
methods.openDoor: Begins opening the door and returns true if the state transition succeeded.
methods.setBroken: Sets whether the door is currently broken.
methods.setDoorOpenAmount: Sets the door's open progress (0.0 closed to 1.0 open), optionally bypassing safety checks when forceUnsafe is true.
methods.setDoorState: Sets the door's current DoorState enum value (closed, open, opening, or closing).
methods.setGateCode: Sets the numeric gate navigation code for this door.
methods.setHandle: Assigns the unique entity hand handle for this door.
methods.setupPhysicalUT: Initializes the door's physics actors on the update thread and returns true on success.
methods.update: Advances the door's open/close movement and state for the current frame.
methods.updateGateCodeState: Updates the navmesh gate code state to reflect the door's current open, closed, or locked status.

properties._isBroken: Internal flag indicating whether the door is currently broken.
properties.actorClosedPosition: Closed-state world position of the door's physics actor as a Vector3 table {x, y, z}.
properties.axisF: Forward movement or facing axis of the door as a Vector3 table {x, y, z}.

EdgeCache.description: Navigation mesh edge cache data structure storing localized spatial bounds and edge boundaries for pathfinding.

EdgeCache_Edge.description: Represents a directed 3D line segment defined by two Havok vector endpoints within a character navigation mesh edge cache.

properties.b: The ending 3D vertex position (hkVector4f) of the navigation mesh edge segment.

EdgePathNode.description: Path node on a navigation mesh edge segment storing traversal boundary vectors and clearances.

methods.operator_eq: Compares two EdgePathNode instances for structural equality.

EntData.description: Represents vegetation and foliage mesh spawn configuration and runtime entity template data in the foliage rendering system.

methods.createEntity1: Creates and returns the primary Ogre Entity instance (as lightuserdata) for this foliage definition.
methods.createEntity2: Creates and returns the secondary Ogre Entity instance (as lightuserdata) for this foliage definition.

methods.selectBiomeEntity: Selects and returns the appropriate biome-specific foliage entity for the given world position.

properties.accurateTrace: Boolean flag enabling high-precision raycasting against terrain for placing foliage instances.
properties.biomeSeparation: Boolean flag determining whether foliage instances are separated along biome borders.
properties.carveRadius: Exclusion radius around buildings or roads where foliage generation is carved out.
properties.chance: Spawn probability multiplier for this foliage entity.
properties.childClusterRadius: Maximum radius for secondary clusters spawned around parent foliage instances.
properties.clusterMax: Maximum number of foliage instances per spawn cluster.
properties.clusterMin: Minimum number of foliage instances per spawn cluster.
properties.clusterRadiusMax: Maximum outer radius for foliage cluster distribution.
properties.clusterRadiusMin: Minimum inner radius for foliage cluster distribution.

properties.entity2Loaded: Boolean flag indicating whether entity2 mesh data has finished loading.
properties.floating: Boolean flag allowing foliage entities to spawn above the ground without touching terrain.
properties.grassSpot: Grass clearance radius surrounding the foliage instance base.
properties.limitToGrassAreas: Boolean flag restricting foliage spawning exclusively to grass texture terrain areas.

properties.maxSlope: Maximum terrain slope angle allowing foliage placement.
properties.maxV: Maximum scale variation multiplier applied to spawned instances.
properties.minAltitude: Minimum world altitude elevation at which this foliage entity can spawn.
properties.minSlope: Minimum terrain slope angle allowing foliage placement.
properties.minV: Minimum scale variation multiplier applied to spawned instances.

properties.referenceCount: Reference counter tracking active users or instances of this foliage data.

properties.seedOffset: Random seed offset used in procedural placement generation.
properties.slopeAlign: Boolean flag indicating whether the foliage entity orients perpendicular to terrain slope normal.
