Faction.description: Political superstructure governing diplomatic reputation scores, sovereign territorial biomes, military squad rosters, law enforcement alliances, economic trade cultures, and war campaigns. Interacts directly with `FactionManager` for global faction registration, `Platoon` for military and civilian squad simulation, `Character` for individual entity allegiance, `FactionRelations` for pairwise diplomatic standings, `FactionWarMgr` for military assaults, `TradeCulture` for contraband and tariffs, and `FactionLeader` for political leadership hierarchies.

methods.Faction: Primary constructor initializing faction political identity, allocating active and unloaded platoon containers, and initializing trade culture, racial fitness selectors, and diplomatic relations.
methods._activateUnloadedPlatoons: Scans unloaded platoons and activates any squad whose coordinates intersect an active, streamed zone chunk.
methods._addActivePlatoonToList: Appends an active platoon to the live active squads vector.
methods._newPlatoon: Internal protected factory method allocating a new `Platoon` instance and initializing its internal squad state.
methods._spawnASquad: Internal helper spawning a squad from a named FCS spawn list with a designated size multiplier.
methods._switchToUnloadedPlatoon: Internal helper transferring an active platoon pointer from activePlatoons to unloadedPlatoons.
methods.activatePlatoon: Activates an unloaded platoon, instantiating 3D character entities, physical ragdolls, and weapons into the active world reality.
methods.addActiveObject: Enrolls an active entity (character or animal) into the specified active platoon.
methods.addPlatoon: Enrolls a newly instantiated platoon into the faction's managed collections.
methods.changePlatoonIndex: Reorders a platoon within the squad hierarchy index (used when player rearranges squads in the squad management UI).
methods.chooseARace: Selects a character race from the faction's weighted racial distribution table when generating new squad recruits.
methods.choosePlatoon: Selects a suitable active platoon for an assigned character or roaming recruit.
methods.clearAndDestroy: Purges all squads, resets relations, and clears building swaps, resetting the faction to a blank uninstantiated state.
methods.countNumSquads: Counts number of instantiated squads matching a specific template assigned to a town.
methods.countPopulation: Calculates total living population count across all squads stationed in or assigned to a specific town.
methods.createNewEmptyActivePlatoon: Creates a new empty active platoon directly in the live world reality.
methods.createNewEmptyUnloadedPlatoon: Creates a new empty unloaded platoon tracked in the background simulation without instantiating physical characters.
methods.createPlatoonAuto: Automatically resolves whether to spawn a platoon as active or unloaded based on proximity to player camera and active zone chunks.
methods.createPlatoonUnloaded: Creates and registers an unloaded platoon from serialized savegame state data.
methods.createPlatoonsAuto: Batch spawns a collection of squad templates across the faction's sovereign territory.
methods.createReplacementPlatoonForPlayerWhenSav: Emergency recovery method constructing a fallback squad for the player if savegame corruption destroyed active squads.
methods.deactivatePlatoon: Deactivates an active platoon whose chunk is unloading, serializing character states and converting to abstract unloaded simulation.
methods.destroyObject: Destroys an entity object and unregisters it from all squads.
methods.destroyPlatoon: Queues a platoon for immediate or deferred destruction, queuing its members for cleanup.
methods.getActivePlatoons: Returns pointer to vector of all currently active (streamed into 3D world) platoons.
methods.getAllActiveSquads: Returns pointer to immutable list of all active squad references.
methods.getAllSquadsThatOwn: Collects all squads claiming ownership or residency rights inside the specified building.
methods.getBuildingReplacement: Returns replacement building blueprint for architectural style overrides when taking over towns.
methods.getCharactersInArea: Finds all faction member characters within a spatial spherical radius around given world coordinates.
methods.getData: Retrieves the underlying FCS `GameData` template record defining this faction's attributes.
methods.getDefaultDivision: Retrieves default military division FCS record configuring equipment uniforms and weaponry.
methods.getFactionColorScheme: Retrieves the faction's uniform primary and secondary color palette definition for dyed armor.
methods.getFactionSize: Computes aggregate total population of the entire faction across all active and unloaded platoons.
methods.getFundamentalNPCType: Retrieves the baseline character archetype classification (e.g. HUMAN, MILITARY, LAW_ENFORCEMENT, ANIMAL) for spawned members.
methods.getGUIData: Populates UI inspector panel with diplomatic status, population statistics, and active military campaigns.
methods.getLawEnforcementFaction: Retrieves pointer to allied faction responsible for enforcing law, policing crimes, and holding prisoners in this faction's settlements.
methods.getName: Retrieves the localized display name of the faction.
methods.getNewPlatoonID: Generates a unique persistent platoon ID string using the faction's internal sequence counter.
methods.getNumPlatoons: Retrieves the count of platoons matching a squad template, optionally filtering for temporary squads and home town origin.
methods.getProsperityMultiplier: Retrieves the economic prosperity multiplier modifying town vendor wealth and squad equipment quality.
methods.getRandomLockLevel: Calculates lockpick difficulty level for chests and doors owned by this faction based on technological tier.
methods.getRoadPreference: Retrieves the road-following pathfinding preference weight for squads of this faction (higher values favor roads over cross-country terrain).
methods.getSelectedObjects: Collects player-selected or type-filtered root objects belonging to this faction.
methods.getSquadThatOwns: Finds the primary resident squad that owns or is garrisoned in a specified building.
methods.getUnloadedPlatoons: Returns pointer to vector of all unloaded (background simulated) platoons.
methods.isAntiSlavery: Queries whether the faction holds an ideological anti-slavery stance (causes hostility toward slave traders and frees slaves).
methods.isNotARealFaction: Queries whether this faction is a pseudo-faction placeholder used for wild fauna, wandering drifters, or neutral unaligned entities.
methods.isThePlayer: Queries whether this faction instance represents the user's player faction (the Nameless).
methods.loadState: Restores faction diplomatic relations, active squad rosters, and leadership states from savegame data.
methods.periodicUpdateMT: Main thread periodic update committing results of threaded unloaded squad processing into main simulation state.
methods.periodicUpdateThreaded: Threaded background simulation update tick processing time-sliced movement and tasks for unloaded squads.
methods.processKillList: Processes the deferred kill list, executing teardown and freeing memory for deceased units and deleted squads.
methods.removeObject: Removes an entity object from its containing platoon and faction rosters.
methods.removePlatoon: Removes a platoon from active and unloaded rosters without deleting the object.
methods.resetPlatoonID: Resets the internal platoon ID sequence counter back to zero.
methods.resetSquadPositions: Resets spatial positions of all squads belonging to this faction around target coordinates (e.g. Reset Squad Position savegame option).
methods.restorePlatoon: Restores a deregistered or serialized platoon back into the faction's active or unloaded rosters.
methods.saveState: Serializes faction reputation scores, alive squads, leadership status, and discovered territory into savegame records.
methods.setName: Sets the faction name string and updates UI header references.
methods.setup: Stage 1 setup: parses FCS faction record, configures racial distribution tables, law enforcement alliances, rank titles, and building swap rules.
methods.setup2: Stage 2 setup: initializes trade culture, contraband policies, and links diplomatic relations with other recognized factions.
methods.setup3: Stage 3 setup: binds AI strategic packages, spawns initial diplomatic pacifiers, and resolves home territory biomes.
methods.spawnSquadMissionsUpdate: Periodic evaluation updating roaming patrol squads, caravans, and war raid campaign spawns.
methods.update: Main simulation frame update tick: advances faction game time, evaluates active squad AI, processes kill lists, and updates war campaigns.
methods.updateActivePlatoons: Updates active squad logic, verifying member coherence, pathfinding progress, and combat states.
methods.updateUnloadedPlatoons: Updates unloaded squad virtual navigation, territorial patrols, and hunger/healing rates.
methods.~Faction: Virtual destructor releasing all active squads, unloading background platoons, destroying diplomatic relations tables, and unregistering from the global FactionManager.

properties.factionLeader: Leader character entity, territory biomes, and worst enemy.
properties.factionOwnerships: Faction asset ledger, shared cats, and slave registry.
properties.fundamentalNPCType: Default archetype for spawned faction members.
properties.isALawEnforcementFaction: Police authority flag granting crime arrest rights.
properties.name: Faction identifier name.
properties.periodicUpdateCounter_active: Round-robin tick counter for active squads.
properties.periodicUpdateCounter_unloaded: Round-robin tick counter for unloaded squads.
properties.platoonPeriodicUpdateIndex: Current squad index in time-sliced update loop.
properties.raceSelector: Weighted racial distribution table for recruitment.

methods.itemSelected: Callback invoked when a faction GameData item is selected in the list.

FactionManager.description: Global manager for all `Faction` instances in the game world, handling faction lookup, creation, persistence, and platoon updates.

methods._showDebugPlatoonMarkers: Enables or disables (`on`) debug map markers for platoons.
methods.activateUnloadedPlatoons: Activates queued unloaded platoons across all factions.

methods.getNumTempPlatoons: Returns the total number of temporary platoons across all factions.

FactionRelations.description: Diplomatic matrix manager maintaining pairwise reputation values (-100.0 to +100.0), ally thresholds, permanent enemy states, and hostility calculations.

methods._isAlly: Evaluates whether the specified faction is formally registered as an ally in the relations map.
methods._isEnemy: Evaluates whether the specified faction is currently marked as hostile or at war.
methods.affectRelations: Modifies diplomatic relations with the target faction based on an in-game event such as assault, kill, or medical aid, scaled by a multiplier.
methods.affectReputation: Adjusts global standing or perceived reputation with the specified faction by the given delta.
methods.affectTrust: Modifies positive or negative trust tracking toward the specified faction scaled by a multiplier.
methods.checkStateCondition: Evaluates a dialogue condition against another faction using a specified comparison operator and threshold value.
methods.declareWar: Sets diplomatic relations with the target faction to open war and marks them as hostile enemies.
methods.getFactionRelation: Returns the current numerical diplomatic relation score (-100 to +100) toward the specified faction.
methods.getFactionRelationMultiplier: Returns a relation-based interaction multiplier (0.0 to 1.0) scaled by diplomatic standing.
methods.getFactionRelationMultiplierInverse: Returns the inverse diplomatic relation multiplier (1.0 - multiplier).
methods.getGUIData: Populates a datapanel with diplomatic standing, relation score, and alliance status for UI display.
methods.getRelationData: Retrieves the internal `RelationData` record for the specified faction, or nullptr if none exists.
methods.getRelationsData: Populates a map of all tracked factions and their corresponding diplomatic relation scores.
methods.isAlly: Returns true if the relation score with the specified faction meets or exceeds the alliance threshold (+50).
methods.isCoexisting: Returns true if the two factions are coexisting peacefully without active conflict.
methods.isEnemy: Returns true if the relation score with the specified faction is at or below the hostility threshold (-30), or in active war.
methods.isEnemyByDefault: Returns true if this faction is configured in FCS to be hostile toward all other factions by default.
methods.load: Restores saved faction diplomatic records, alliances, and relation scores from savegame data.
methods.reset: Clears all custom faction relations, reputation scores, and state variables, resetting relations to defaults.
methods.save: Writes faction diplomatic records, alliances, and relation scores to savegame data.
methods.setEnemy: Marks the specified faction as an active enemy and sets relation score into hostile range.
methods.setNoLongerEnemies: Clears active war status and restores diplomatic relations above the hostile threshold.
methods.setRelation: Sets the numerical diplomatic relation score (-100 to +100) toward the specified faction.
methods.setupPhase1: Performs first-phase initialization of diplomatic relations for the owning faction.
methods.setupPhase2: Performs second-phase initialization resolving reciprocal relations after all factions are registered.
methods.update: Executes periodic diplomatic updates, decaying temporary relation modifiers and updating ongoing hostilities.
methods.~FactionRelations: Destructs the `FactionRelations` instance and releases allocated resources.

properties._factionRelations: Map of target Faction pointers to their corresponding RelationData records.

properties.defaultFactionRelation: Default baseline relation score toward factions without an explicit entry.
properties.defaultRelation: Baseline standing score with unlisted factions.
properties.globalReputationForBadassery: Global reputation score reflecting combat prowess and notoriety.
properties.globalReputationTrust: Global diplomatic trust score for this faction.
properties.me: Pointer to the Faction that owns this FactionRelations instance.
properties.owner: Faction entity owning this diplomatic relations table.
properties.playerRank: Player rank or standing index within this faction.
properties.relations: Pairwise diplomatic standing scores from -100.0 to +100.0.

FarmBuilding.description: `FarmBuilding` powers wheatstraw fields, greenfruit patches, cotton crops, hemp farms, cactus gardens, and riceweed paddies across Kenshi's diverse biomes.

methods.FarmBuilding: Constructs a new `FarmBuilding` crop field or hydroponic tray, evaluating local soil fertility, setting up foliage shaders, and initializing plant batches.
methods._updateInputs: Deducts water from the farm's input reservoir proportional to active crop consumption rates.
methods.createClickHull: Builds the invisible interaction bounding volume used for mouse picking and order targeting.
methods.createEntity: Creates the primary OGRE scene node and mesh entity representing field fencing or hydroponic basin structures.
methods.createPhysical: Creates physical collision geometry and instantiates procedural 3D plant specimens across the field grid.
methods.createPlants: Instantiates batched plant meshes across the field's grid rows.
methods.destroyAPlant: Destroys a single plant specimen instance due to pest grazing, animal feeding, or drought damage.
methods.destroyPhysical: Removes all plant mesh instances and deletes interaction collision hulls when the field is dismantled or unloaded.
methods.dontNeedWorkRightNow: Evaluates whether farmer characters can operate this field right now. Returns `true` (no work needed) while crops are still growing and water is satisfied.
methods.eat: Called when wild animals or starving bandits graze upon the crop field, damaging crops and consuming nutrition.
methods.getCropMult: Retrieves the environmental growth rate multiplier for the specified crop species in this zone.
methods.getDirectionMarker: Computes navigation orientation markers guiding farmers toward available crop rows.
methods.getFertilityMultiplier: Evaluates the scaled fertility coefficient for a crop blueprint under local environmental conditions.
methods.getGUIData: Renders telemetry readouts to the HUD Datapanel, displaying crop maturity percentage, environmental fertility, and water levels.
methods.getGUIEfficiency: Renders active growth speed percentage to the HUD panel.
methods.getGUIFertility: Renders environmental soil fertility ratings to the Datapanel.
methods.getGUIState: Renders current operational botanical state (e.g. "Growing", "Ready for Harvest", "Drought", "Dead Crops", "Output Full") to the HUD.
methods.getGUIWorkers: Renders active farmer count and capacity to the HUD.
methods.getYieldChancePerCrop: Computes environmental yield probability for a crop species given biome climate, soil moisture, and ground fertility.
methods.howMuchPowerDoYouWantForSortingFunction: Determines electrical power priority sorting weight for hydroponic artificial sun lamps.
methods.isAnyInputsEmpty: Queries whether the field's water reservoir is completely dry, signaling logistics haulers to fetch water wells.
methods.isCropsEdible: Queries whether the crop species cultivated in this field is edible by animals or starving characters in raw form.
methods.isProductionFull: Evaluates whether the harvested crop output container is filled to capacity.
methods.loadFromSerialise: Restores crop maturity progress, plant death ratios, and drought timers from serialized savegame records.
methods.needsUpdate: Queries whether this agricultural field requires per-frame simulation updates.
methods.operate: Executes manual agricultural labor. When crops are mature, harvests produce into the output section. When crops are dead, clears withered stalks to prepare for replanting.
methods.resetFarm: Resets field maturity, death ratios, and clearing progress to zero, preparing the soil for the next planting cycle.
methods.serialise: Serializes crop maturity progress, plant death ratios, drought timers, and harvested counts into savegame delta records.
methods.setVisible: Toggles visibility of foliage submeshes and ground click hulls.
methods.setupMaterial: Clones dynamic foliage shader materials to allow unique color tints and wilted drought appearances.
methods.setupMiningResourceLevel: Samples local terrain fertility and subterranean water tables at the field's world coordinates.
methods.timeSkip: Accelerates crop simulation across large elapsed time intervals (e.g. during fast travel or loading unloaded zones).
methods.update: Simulates botanical growth, deducting water from the reservoir, tracking drought timers, scaling 3D plant models, and evaluating crop death.
methods.updateMaterial: Updates foliage shader parameters, tinting plants brown when suffering drought and scaling mesh vertices as plants mature.
methods.updatePlantInstance: Synchronizes 3D transform and scale for an individual plant mesh instance based on maturity.
methods.upgrade: Upgrades field scale or converts traditional outdoor field to an enclosed hydroponic facility.
methods.~FarmBuilding: Destructs the `FarmBuilding` instance, unregistering plant meshes from the batch coordinator and releasing interaction collision hulls.

properties.batch: Global farm batch rendering coordinator managing batched plant geometry.
properties.clearRate: Rate at which dead or harvested crops are cleared from the field.
properties.cleared: Harvested ground clearing progress toward resetting the field for replanting.
properties.clickHull: Interaction collision bounding box for player cursor selection.

properties.cropMultipliers: Environmental crop growth rate modifiers mapped by crop species.
properties.deathThreshold: Drought timer threshold at which unwatered crops begin dying.

FarmBuilding_Plant.description: Represents an individual growing crop plant in a farm building, tracking its age, position, and visual parts.

methods.operator_assign: Copies all field values from another FarmBuilding_Plant into this instance and returns self.
methods.operator_eq: Returns true if both plant instances refer to the same object in memory.

properties.parts: The lektor list of sub-plant component parts making up this plant.
properties.position: The 3D world position (Ogre::Vector3) of the plant within the farm.

FarmBuilding_PlantSource.description: Defines configuration parameters and mesh assets for a crop plant growth stage within a farm batch.

properties.count: Target count or quantity of plant instances to spawn for this source.
properties.data: The GameData item definition representing the plant source or crop item.

FarmBuilding_SubPlant.description: Sub-plant placement descriptor within a farm building, defining individual plant transform offsets and mesh stage data.

properties.data: PlantSource data definition containing mesh and growth attributes for this sub-plant.

FlagCondition.description: Represents a bitmask flag requirement on a `DialogLineData` (wrapping `DialogLineData::FlagCondition`).

FloatingProgressBar.description: Floating screen-space progress bar widget displayed above characters or interactive objects.

methods.setCaption: Sets the text caption displayed above or on the progress bar.
methods.setProgress: Updates the progress fill ratio from a numeric value.
methods.update: Updates the screen position, visibility, and layout of the floating progress bar.

properties.bar: The FloatingProgressBar::ProgressBarWidget component rendering the filled bar.
properties.caption: Current text caption string displayed on the floating progress bar.

FlockingTools.description: Provides group steering, character collision avoidance, and repulsion vector calculations for platoon movement.

methods.calculateCurrentRepulsionVector: Calculates the aggregate avoidance repulsion vector considering maximum distance, desired direction, characters to skip, and friend/enemy filters.
methods.clampRepulsionVectorTo90Degrees: Static function modifying a repulsion vector in-place and returning the result clamped to within 90 degrees of a desired direction vector.
methods.create: Initializes flocking controller state for the given Character and CombatMovementController.
methods.getDistanceToClosestCharacter: Returns the distance to the closest character, with options to check enemies, allies, and ignore a specific hand handle.
methods.getOutOfTheWay: Requests this character to yield right-of-way and move aside for the character identified by caller hand handle.
methods.getRepulsionMagnitude: Static function calculating the repulsion force magnitude from a repulsion point given maximum influence distance and current distance.
methods.getRepulsionVector: Static function calculating the repulsion direction vector away from a repulsion point given maximum influence distance and current distance.
methods.getSensoryData: Returns the SensoryData perception component of the character using these flocking tools.
methods.setCurrentPosition: Updates the current reference world position vector for flocking calculations.

properties.combatMover: Pointer to the CombatMovementController associated with these flocking tools.
properties.currentPosition: World position vector table of the character using flocking calculations.
properties.getOutOfTheWayOfCharacter: Hand handle of the character this unit is currently yielding right-of-way to.
properties.me: Pointer to the Character instance that owns these flocking tools.

FogEditor.description: In-game level editor tool for creating, configuring, and previewing environmental fog volumes.

methods.close: Closes the fog editor GUI window.

methods.update: Updates the fog editor state, gizmos, and preview rendering.

methods.updateFogValues: Updates fog volume dimensions and visual properties from datapanel input lines.

FoliageSystem.description: Procedural instanced foliage, grass, and tree generator integrating Forests::PagedGeometry and GrassLoader with biome coverage maps, slope filters, and navmesh carvers.

methods.addGrassLayerToCoverageMap: Bakes grass distribution density from biome data into the specified color channel of the terrain coverage image.
methods.clearStaticData: Releases static cached foliage entity definitions and batched tree placement queues across all zones.
methods.finalMakeEnt: Instantiates and registers a final 3D foliage entity with orientation, scale, and transform into PagedGeometry tree loaders.
methods.getCollisionHash: Returns the calculated spatial collision hash value for the active foliage partition.
methods.getNavmeshCarvers: Populates a list of spherical/cylindrical navmesh carving volumes (`Vector4`: x, y, z, radius) for large trees and rocks.
methods.loadEnts: Parses foliage and biome foliage entries from FCS `GameData` into procedural foliage entity definitions.
methods.random: Generates a pseudorandom floating-point value within the range [min, max] for procedural foliage placement and jitter.
methods.randomInt: Generates a pseudorandom integer between min and max for procedural foliage clustering and mesh variant selection.
methods.setupFoliage: Configures 3D tree and foliage batch loaders for the given biome layer and paged geometry manager.
methods.setupGrass: Configures procedural grass density, wind animation, and layer maps for the given biome in the paged geometry system.
methods.setupWind: Sets up wind swaying parameters and shader uniforms across foliage entities.
methods.spawn: Attempts to spawn a foliage entity at the specified terrain position, evaluating slope, altitude, and clustering rules.
methods.update: Runs the frame update for the foliage system, managing LOD transitions, wind animations, and sound emitter updates.
methods.~FoliageSystem: Destructs the `FoliageSystem` instance and releases allocated resources.

properties.coverageMap: Pointer to the RealWorldEditableImage grass and foliage coverage map for the zone.
properties.dataLookup: Foliage template lookup indexed by FCS record.
properties.firstTimeLoad: Whether the zone foliage is being generated for the first time.
properties.foliageEntries: Registered foliage mesh and instancing templates.
properties.generateOverlay: Whether terrain grass overlay textures should be generated.
properties.grassLoader: Forests::GrassLoader managing dynamic turf and wind animation.
properties.isLoaded: Foliage geometry buffer compilation status flag.
properties.loadComplete: Whether all foliage entities and paged geometry layers have finished loading.
properties.map: Parent zone map managing terrain cells.
properties.navmeshCarvers: Foliage trunk bounding volumes carving pathfinder holes.
properties.pagedGeometry: Forests::PagedGeometry manager handling batching and billboards.
properties.reloaded: Whether the foliage system was reloaded from modified data.
properties.zoneMap: Pointer to the ZoneMap that owns this FoliageSystem.

Footprint.description: Building placement collision and clearance footprint used to validate orientation, terrain, and building fit.

methods.collisionTestBuildings: Tests collision against nearby buildings and interiors on the specified floor number.
methods.collisionTestCharacters: Tests collision against characters near the footprint position.
methods.fakeOppositeValidate: Performs opposite-side clearance validation with the given gap distance.
methods.getGroundHeight: Returns the terrain ground height at the specified Vector3 position.
methods.getMarker: Returns the marker height offset for the footprint.
methods.getSpace: Returns the required clearance space distance around the footprint.
methods.getValid: Returns true if the footprint current placement is valid.
methods.getWorldCorner: Returns the world-space position (Vector3) of the specified corner index.
methods.isGroundValid: Returns true if the underlying terrain ground slope and elevation are valid for placement.
methods.isIndoorsOK: Evaluates whether indoor placement inside target building and town is valid.
methods.operator_assign: Copies footprint attributes from another Footprint instance and returns self.
methods.setValid: Sets the boolean validity flag for this footprint placement.
methods.updateBox: Recomputes the oriented physics bounding box from current position, rotation, and scale.
methods.validFloorTest: Tests whether the footprint is situated on a valid floor surface.
methods.validate: Runs full collision and placement tests to determine and return placement validity.

properties.ent: Raw pointer (lightuserdata) to the Ogre::Entity preview mesh associated with this footprint.
properties.groundType: The BuildingPlacementGroundType constraint governing valid placement surfaces.
properties.lower: Lower vertical clearance limit below ground level.
properties.parent: The PreviewBuilding instance that owns this footprint.
properties.pos: World position (Vector3) of the footprint center.
properties.scale: Scale multiplier applied to the footprint dimensions.
properties.space: Clearance spacing required around the footprint perimeter.
properties.valid: Whether the footprint currently satisfies all placement validation rules.
properties.wantsAboveGround: Whether the footprint must be placed entirely above ground level.

FootprintNode.description: Represents a collision footprint bounding volume used during preview building placement.

methods.getNodeId: Returns the string identifier of this footprint node.
methods.operator_assign: Copies the state from another FootprintNode into this instance and returns self.
methods.setEnabled: Enables or disables this footprint collision node.
methods.updateBox: Recalculates and updates the world-space bounding box for this footprint node.

properties.enabled: Whether this footprint node is currently active for collision and placement testing.
properties.nodeId: The string identifier associated with this footprint node.

ForgottenGUI.description: Master GUI manager coordinating the MyGUI rendering framework, viewport scaling, mouse cursor states, main HUD bars, floating window lifecycles, and context menus. Interacts directly with `MainBarGUI` for bottom HUD control bars and portraits, `InventoryGUI` for character, container, and shop barter layouts, `DatapanelGUI` for character and building telemetry readouts, `ToolTip` for hovering item inspections, `CharacterEditWindow` for character creation morphs, and `ScreenLabelInterface` for 3D floating damage and dialogue labels.

methods.ForgottenGUI: Primary constructor for `ForgottenGUI`, zero-initializing core HUD state, window collections, and cursor parameters.
methods._showTradeWindow: Internal helper opening a two-sided trade, barter, or loot interface between two entity objects.
methods.addDatapanelToUpdateList: Registers a datapanel to receive per-frame telemetry and GUI update ticks.
methods.addScreenLabel: Registers a floating screen label to be updated and tracked above entities in world space.
methods.addWindowToUpdateList: Registers an active GUI window to receive per-frame update ticks.
methods.changeFontSize: Updates and reloads GUI font sizes across all widget skins based on user settings.

methods.createDropBoxAbs: Creates a drop-down combo box widget with absolute pixel coordinates.

GameData.description: Universal object-relational data model record for the Kenshi engine and Forgotten Construction Set (FCS). Encapsulates typed primitive dictionaries (bool, int, float, string, file, vector, quaternion), ordered references with integer triplet values, world placement instances, dirty tracking for mod stack layering, and binary/text disk persistence. Interacts directly with `GameDataContainer` for master mod record ownership, `GameDataManager` for active file mod stacking, and `RootObjectFactory` for converting data templates into live game objects.

GameDataContainer.description: Core game database container maintaining multi-index hash lookup maps across all Kenshi template and instance records (`GameData`). Provides $O(1)$ indexed retrieval by unique integer ID (`gamedataID`), global string ID (`gamedataSID`), category and name (`gamedataCatName`), and category and string ID (`gamedataCatSID`). Serves as base class for `GameDataManager`.

Initializes multi-index hash lookup tables (`gamedataCatName`, `gamedataID`, `gamedataCatSID`, `gamedataSID`), allocates master set container (`mainList`), resets integer ID counter (`currentID = 0`), and initializes baseline flags.

GameWorld.description: Master game world simulation coordinator. Manages global game databases (gamedata, leveldata, savedata), physics, audio, root object factories, active mod lists, frame speeds, simulation pause states, system messages, and entity destruction queues. Interacts directly with `GameDataManager` for FCS template assets and world state storage, `RootObjectFactory` for entity instantiation, `FactionManager` for diplomatic alignments and warfare, `NavMesh` for terrain pathfinding geometry, `ZoneManager` for spatial world chunk paging, and `PlayerInterface` for human player commands.

GamedataSelectionList.description: Manages a searchable and filterable list of GameData items in the level editor interface.

methods.changeFilter: Filters the displayed list items based on the text contents of the provided MyGUI::EditBox.
methods.deselectItem: Clears the current item selection in the list.
methods.formatItem: Returns the formatted display label string for the given GameData item.
methods.getSelectedItem: Returns the currently selected GameData item, or nil if none is selected.
methods.itemSelected: Callback invoked when the specified GameData item is selected.
methods.listItemSelected: MyGUI event callback invoked when a list box entry is clicked or selected.
methods.selectItem: Selects the specified GameData item in the list and returns true if found.

properties.items: The list (lektor<GameData*>) of items currently available in the selection list.
properties.lastItem: The index of the previously selected list item.
properties.levelEditor: The LevelEditor instance owning or associated with this selection list.
properties.list: The MyGUI::ListBox widget displaying the items.
properties.win: The root MyGUI::Widget container for the selection list window.

GameplayOptions.description: Holds per-save and new-game difficulty and gameplay multipliers (such as hunger rate, damage, nest spawns, and research/production speeds).

methods.getStarvationTimeInHours: Returns the effective starvation time in hours after applying the hungerTime multiplier.
methods.load: Loads these gameplay options from the provided GameData.
methods.reset: Resets all gameplay option multipliers and flags to their default values.
methods.save: Saves these gameplay options into the provided GameData.

properties.animalsEat: Whether wild and hostile animals eat unconscious or dead characters.
properties.banditsLootPlayer: Whether bandits loot food and items from unconscious player characters.
properties.buildingSpeed: Multiplier applied to building construction speed.
properties.deathFrequency: Multiplier controlling the chance of wounds causing death or bleeding out.
properties.difficultHealing: Whether characters cannot heal without medical supplies or beds.
properties.easyProspecting: Whether prospecting immediately reveals resource distributions.
properties.globalDamageMultiplier: Global multiplier applied to combat damage.
properties.hungerTime: Multiplier applied to the time it takes for characters to become hungry.
properties.numNestsMult: Multiplier for the number of animal and bandit nests spawned in the world.
properties.productionSpeed: Multiplier applied to crafting and machine production speed.
properties.researchSpeed: Multiplier applied to technology research speed.

GatewayBuilding.description: Fortified defensive town gate managing passable door states, lock security levels, and dynamic Havok pathfinding corridor carving.

methods.GatewayBuilding: Constructs a new `GatewayBuilding` instance from game data and spatial transform parameters.
methods.isForSale: Queries whether condition `isForSale` is met for this `GatewayBuilding` instance.
methods.isGate: Queries whether condition `isGate` is met for this `GatewayBuilding` instance.
methods.postCreationPathfinderSetupStuff: Registers gate collision geometry and navigation polygon portals with the pathfinder following building instantiation.
methods.reAnnounceGateToPathfinder: Re-notifies the navigation mesh and pathfinder of current gate status (open, closed, or locked) to update route traversability.
methods.separatesAreas: Returns true if this gateway building acts as a boundary barrier separating distinct navigation or town zone areas.
methods.setup: Sets `up` for this `GatewayBuilding` instance.
methods.~GatewayBuilding: Destructs the `GatewayBuilding` instance and releases allocated resources.

properties.doors: Portals and gate leaves managed by gateway.
properties.physical: Wall collision geometry and passable threshold volumes.

Gear.description: Base class for equippable items and gear in the game. Extends `Item` by adding crafting attribution, level/quality scaling, and faction uniform data.

methods.Gear: Constructs a new `Gear` instance and initializes its state. Sets up the item's uniform faction, crafting details, and calculates the float level based on the integer level provided.
methods._loadFromSerialise: Deserializes a saved `GameData` state into this `Gear` instance. Restores base item properties, re-links the faction uniform pointer, and retrieves the crafter's name.
methods._serialise: Serializes the `Gear` instance state into a `GameData` structure for saving. Records uniform faction status and the crafter's name if applicable.
methods.getLevel: Retrieves the gear's absolute integer quality level.
methods.getLevel01: Retrieves the gear's quality level as a float multiplier.
methods.isAFactionUniform: Checks if the gear serves as a uniform for a specific faction.
methods.isGear: Runtime type identification method for the `Gear` class.
methods.isPlayerCrafted: Determines if the gear was crafted by a player character. This is checked by verifying if the `crafter` string is non-empty.
methods.setInventoryWeAreIn: Updates the internal inventory handler struct (`hand`) that tracks where this gear is located. Overrides the base `Item` implementation.
methods.~Gear: Destructor for the `Gear` class. Cleans up internal structures such as the `crafter` string and base `Item` components.

properties.crafter: Name of the character who crafted this gear item, if any.
properties.isUniform: Pointer to the Faction whose uniform this gear represents, or nil if not a uniform.
properties.level: Normalized quality level of the gear item.
properties.level_0_100: Integer quality grade of the gear item on a 0 to 100 scale.
properties.value: Cached base monetary value of the gear item in cats.

GeneratorBuilding.description: Power generator supplying electrical energy to settlement power grids by consuming fuel or harnessing environmental wind.

methods.GeneratorBuilding: Constructs a new `GeneratorBuilding` instance from game data and spatial transform parameters.
methods.~GeneratorBuilding: Destructs the `GeneratorBuilding` instance and releases allocated resources.

GenericFixedInventoryLayout.description: Fixed-size grid inventory layout panel used for backpacks, chests, and generic item storage.

methods.setSize: Configures the grid width and height in slot count (slotsW, slotsH).

GenericInventoryLayout.description: GUI layout controller that arranges inventory grid slots and controls for containers and usable storage objects.

methods.setSize: Configures the inventory grid dimensions (slot width and height) and enables arrange/type buttons.

properties.arrangeButton: Widget button used to trigger auto-arranging items within the inventory grid.

GlobalConstants.description: Holds global gameplay tuning constants and multipliers loaded from the FCS global constants GameData. Accessible via the global con variable.

methods.setup: Initializes all global constant fields from the provided global constants GameData (or nil to use defaults).

GunClass.description: Base ranged weapon subsystem in Kenshi managing both handheld crossbows (`GunClassPersonal`) and mounted building turrets (`GunClassTurret`). Encapsulates projectile ballistics raycasting (`physHit`), aiming kinematics, reload cycle progression, elevation/wall bonus computations, bowstring rendering states, and visual projectile tracer streams (`ConstantTracerT`).

methods.GunClass: Primary constructor for `GunClass`. Parses core weapon configuration parameters from `GameData* gundat`, initializing range bounds, reload timing limits, projectile speed scalars, and allocating tracer interfaces.
methods.aimAt: Steers the weapon elevation and azimuth towards a specified target coordinate, restricted by `aimSpeed` and physical gimbal/joint rotational limits.
methods.calculateAccuracyDeviationAngle: Calculates random angular trajectory spread cone deviation in radians based on normalized operator accuracy skill.
methods.calculateHeightBonus: Calculates elevation advantage damage and range bonus scalar based on vertical height difference between barrel position and target position.
methods.calculateReloadTime: Calculates actual reload time duration by interpolating between `reloadTimeMax` and `reloadTimeMin` based on operator skill parameter `stat01`.
methods.calculateWallBonusMult: Calculates combat effectiveness and cover bonus multiplier granted when firing from fortified defensive walls or towers.
methods.createPhysical: Creates visual 3D entities and scene node hierarchies under `parentNode`, assigning custom materials and initializing bowstring meshes (`drawnStringMesh`, `slackStringMesh`).
methods.destroyPhysical: Destroys and unlinks physical Ogre scene nodes, detaching and destroying movable mesh components, bowstrings, and tracer attachments.
methods.didThisTraceHitOurMountedBuilding: Determines whether a raycast trajectory hit intersected the defensive wall or building structure that this turret is mounted atop.
methods.getARandomDamage: Rolls a randomized base kinetic/pierce damage value within the weapon's configured minimum and maximum damage range bounds.
methods.getAimDir: Computes normalized line-of-sight unit direction vector pointing from barrel muzzle towards a target coordinate.
methods.getBarrelPos: Calculates the global world-space coordinates of the weapon's barrel muzzle exit point.
methods.getBarrelPosForTrace: Calculates barrel muzzle origin extrapolated along firing line by distance `dist` to avoid self-intersection with weapon housing during ballistic raycasts.
methods.getGUIData: Populates UI datapanel lines with weapon statistics including range, accuracy, damage range, and ammo status.
methods.getPowerEfficiencyMult: Queries electrical power efficiency multiplier affecting turret tracking speed and reload cycles (1.0f on personal weapons).
methods.getRelativeBarrelPos: Retrieves the local relative offset vector of the barrel tip with respect to the weapon root scene node (`gunBarrelOffsetPos`).
methods.getReloadStateForGUI: Calculates current reload progress percentage for UI display, optionally dividing by full reload duration.
methods.isActive: Queries whether the weapon is active and enabled for aiming, reloading, and projectile firing.
methods.isAnimationReadyToShoot: Queries whether character animation playback has reached the designated firing release trigger frame.
methods.isPersonalCrossbow: Downcasts this weapon pointer to `GunClassPersonal*` if this instance is a handheld personal crossbow.
methods.isReloading: Evaluates whether the weapon is currently actively executing a reload cycle.
methods.isTurret: Downcasts this weapon pointer to `GunClassTurret*` if this instance is an emplaced mounted turret.
methods.loadEntityCallback: Background resource loader callback invoked when mesh/material resources finish asynchronous streaming.
methods.loadFromSerialise: Deserializes weapon state from `GameData* state` during game load, restoring ammo count and reload timing timers.
methods.onEntitiesLoaded: Virtual hook invoked once all visual mesh components finish loading, refreshing part visibilities and bowstring nodes.
methods.reactivationCheck: Evaluates operating condition and user binding, verifying whether the weapon should transition between active and dormant operational states.
methods.reloadAmmo: Advances ammo reload sequence by `frameTime` seconds scaled by operator skill, replenishing current shot magazine count once `reloadState >= 1.0f`.
methods.serialise: Serializes weapon state (remaining shots, reload progress, operator handle) into `GameData* state` for save game files.
methods.setAnimationReadyToShoot: Notifies the weapon controller that character animation playback has reached or left the release frame trigger.
methods.setCharacter: Binds the operating character entity handle to this weapon rig, updating skill parameters and user references.
methods.setSkillForGUI: Transfers operator skill level and operator handle to the weapon UI display layer.
methods.setStateForGUI: Updates the normalized reload progress progressbar in the UI datapanel.
methods.setVisible: Toggles visibility of weapon scene nodes, bowstring meshes, and attached loaded ammunition models.
methods.shoot: Executes firing cycle: decrements ammo magazine count, computes accuracy spread deviations, launches visual/physical projectile, spawns tracers, and triggers gunshot audio.
methods.trace: Performs primary line-of-sight PhysX raycast along direction `dir`, detecting terrain, buildings, and optionally character collision capsules.
methods.trace2: Performs secondary specialized line-of-sight raycast incorporating penetrating obstacle filtering and cheating tracer overrides.
methods.update: Per-frame kinematic update step. Updates aim pitch and yaw tracking towards target, synchronizes world transform coords, advances reload progression timers, and updates bowstring slackness.
methods.updatePartVisibilities: Synchronizes visibility of drawn vs slack bowstrings and loaded ammo bolts depending on current reload progression and magazine fullness.
methods.~GunClass: Virtual destructor for `GunClass`. Tears down physical scene node attachments, detaches loaded ammo mesh entities, releases tracer objects (`ConstantTracerT`), and frees live ammo string names.

properties.accuracyDeviationBase: Base angular trajectory cone spread in radians.
properties.accuracySkillRequired: Skill threshold required to achieve nominal accuracy.
properties.aimSpeed: Tracking angular steering rate towards targets.
properties.ammoObjects: Loaded visual ammunition mesh entity collection.
properties.cheatingTracer: Secondary / AI visual tracer ray controller.
properties.gunBarrelOffsetPos: Local relative offset vector from root node to muzzle tip.
properties.harpoonMaterial: Custom harpoon cable / projectile line material.
properties.liveAmmoMesh: Mesh resource name used for active flying projectile.
properties.loadingEntitesLeft: Counter of asynchronous streaming mesh entities remaining.
properties.maxRange: Maximum effective firing range in meters.
properties.numShotsCurrent: Currently loaded remaining shots in magazine.
properties.reloadAnimation: Animation asset definition governing reloading posture.
properties.reloadTimeMax: Maximum reload duration at zero operator skill.
properties.reloadTimeMin: Minimum possible reload duration at max operator skill.
properties.shotSpeed: Projectile flight velocity scalar in m/s.
properties.userSkill01: Normalized operator proficiency skill scalar (0.0 to 1.0).

GunClassPersonal.description: A specialized implementation of `GunClass` representing ranged weapons wielded personally by characters (e.g., crossbows). It manages character-specific weapon mechanics, animation states, and entity material bindings.

methods.GunClassPersonal: Constructs a new `GunClassPersonal` instance, initializing its stats based on the provided `GameData` and item level (quality).
methods.calculateWallBonusMult: Calculates the range/damage bonus when shooting from a wall. For personal weapons, this might query the character's current position.
methods.clearEntitesPtr: Clears the internal pointers relating to visual entities.
methods.didThisTraceHitOurMountedBuilding: Checks if a physics trace collided with the building the character is mounted on (to prevent self-hitting geometry).
methods.getAimCloseness: Evaluates how close the weapon's current aim is to the target. Used for animation tracking and hit probability.
methods.getAimDir: Calculates the normalized direction vector from the weapon's barrel position to the specified target position.
methods.getAudioObject: Retrieves the audio object ID used for playing weapon sounds (reloading, firing) from the wielder's position.
methods.getDamageMax: Retrieves the pre-calculated maximum damage this weapon can inflict.
methods.getDamageMin: Retrieves the pre-calculated minimum damage this weapon can inflict.
methods.getParentNode: Retrieves the visual scene node this weapon is attached to (likely a bone on the character's skeleton).
methods.getPowerEfficiencyMult: Retrieves the power efficiency multiplier. Usually defaults to 1.0 for personal weapons as power is not consumed.
methods.isAnimationReadyToShoot: Checks if the character's firing animation has reached the point where a projectile can be spawned.
methods.isPersonalCrossbow: Runtime type identification method returning the `this` pointer cast to `GunClassPersonal`. Used to distinguish personal weapons from turrets.
methods.onEntitiesLoaded: Callback invoked when the visual entities for the weapon have finished loading. Applies materials and configured visual settings.
methods.scoreTarget: Calculates a priority score for targeting a specific character. It evaluates visibility, relative floor levels, and positional advantage.
methods.setCharacter: Binds this weapon instance to a character's hand, associating the weapon with its wielder.
methods.~GunClassPersonal: Destroys the `GunClassPersonal` instance and cleans up allocated memory.

properties.animReadyToShoot: State flag indicating if the character's animation is ready to fire.

GunClassTurret.description: `GunClassTurret` represents a mounted turret weapon in the game world. It inherits from `GunClass` and links directly to a `TurretBuilding` entity, handling the physical representation, aiming, and target scoring specific to stationary defenses.

methods.GunClassTurret: Constructs a new `GunClassTurret` instance, initializing it with the specified game data and linking it to a parent `TurretBuilding`.
methods.aimAt: Points the turret's physical weapon meshes toward a specific 3D coordinate. Updates `lastTarget`.
methods.calculateWallBonusMult: Determines the positional damage/range bonus for this turret based on the wall or structure it is mounted on.
methods.clearEntitesPtr: Clears internal pointers to the turret's physical Ogre entities, usually called during cleanup.
methods.createPhysical: Initializes the 3D meshes, materials, and Ogre entities for this turret, attaching them to the provided scene node.
methods.destroyPhysical: Destroys the Ogre entities and visual meshes associated with this turret, removing them from the scene.
methods.didThisTraceHitOurMountedBuilding: Checks if a projectile or raycast collision hit the specific building structure that this turret is mounted on, typically to avoid turrets shooting their own bases.
methods.getAimCloseness: Returns a measurement of how closely the turret's current physical alignment matches its designated target direction.
methods.getAudioObject: Retrieves the Wwise audio object ID associated with this turret for 3D sound spatialization.
methods.getDamageMax: Retrieves the maximum possible damage output per shot for this turret.
methods.getDamageMin: Retrieves the minimum possible damage output per shot for this turret.
methods.getGUIData: Populates a target GUI datapanel with information about this turret's stats and current status.
methods.getParentNode: Retrieves the Ogre scene node that acts as the parent transform for this turret.
methods.getPowerEfficiencyMult: Calculates a multiplier for the turret's effectiveness based on the building's current power levels. If underpowered, the turret performs worse.
methods.isOutOfPower: Checks if the turret has insufficient power to operate.
methods.isTurret: Runtime type identification method returning the `this` pointer cast to a `GunClassTurret`.
methods.onEntitiesLoaded: Callback triggered immediately after the turret's physical 3D entities have finished loading asynchronously.
methods.scoreTarget: Evaluates a potential target character, returning a score that determines target priority. Targets standing directly in front of the turret are scored highly.
methods.~GunClassTurret: Destroys the turret weapon instance and frees associated resources.

properties.turretBuilding: Pointer to the associated turret building structure.

HandleManager.description: Universal object handle resolver decoupling weak entity references from raw heap pointers, coordinating memory lifetime, serialisation tombstones, and unloaded entity paging.

methods.addExistingObjectHandleToZone: Associates an existing object handle with its containing zone map for spatial tracking and paging.
methods.clearRedirectForHandle: Clears any pointer forwarding or redirection entry registered for the specified object handle.
methods.destroy: Tears down the handle manager, releasing all registered handle mappings, redirects, and deferred delete lists.
methods.getAnything: Resolves an object handle to any live entity (`RootObjectBase*`).
methods.getAnythingButBase: Resolves an object handle to an active entity pointer, excluding base classes.
methods.getBuilding: Resolves an object handle to its corresponding `Building` pointer, or nullptr if destroyed or unloaded.
methods.getBuilding_UseableStuff: Resolves an object handle specifically to an interactive or usable building structure.
methods.getCharacter: Resolves an object handle to its corresponding `Character` pointer, or nullptr if unloaded or dead.
methods.getFromDeathParade: Looks up a character handle in the death parade queue awaiting destruction.
methods.getItem: Resolves an object handle to its corresponding `Item` pointer.
methods.getPlatoon: Resolves an object handle to its corresponding `Platoon` pointer.
methods.getRedirect: Follows handle redirect chains to find the current active replacement handle.
methods.getShopTrader: Resolves an object handle to the merchant or shopkeeper character associated with it.
methods.getTown: Resolves an object handle to its corresponding `Town` entity pointer.
methods.getTownBase: Resolves an object handle to its underlying `TownBase` settlement instance.
methods.isPlayerFaction: Returns true if the entity referenced by the handle belongs to the player faction.
methods.removeRedirect: Removes a redirect mapping that forwarded references from an obsolete handle ID to a replacement object.
methods.reset: Clears all active handles, redirects, and registered zone lookups, resetting the manager to an empty state.
methods.restore: Rebuilds object handle mappings and redirect tables from saved game state during loading.
methods.serialise: Serializes registered handles and tombstone redirect mappings to savegame state.
methods.setUnloaded: Marks the entity identified by the handle as unloaded and paged out to disk.
methods.~HandleManager: Destructs the `HandleManager` instance and releases allocated resources.

properties._vftable: Virtual method table pointer for Serialisable.
properties.handles: Fast lookup map resolving integer handle IDs to pointers.
properties.nextHandleID: Incrementing atomic sequence counter for new handles.

HavokCharacter.description: Autonomous navigation agent and kinematic path follower bridging character locomotion kinematics (`CharMovement`) to Havok AI navigation meshes (`hkaiNavMesh`). Executes string-pulling portal funneling across NavMesh edge corridors (`EdgePathNode`), local obstacle avoidance steering, dynamic obstacle cylinder-sweep collision detection (`EdgeCache`), and water immersion speed damping.

methods.HavokCharacter: Primary constructor for `HavokCharacter`. Initializes spatial position, agent footprint radius, acceleration constants, sensory subsystem links (`SensoryData`), resets path state to idle, clears face indices, and configures collision bounds.
methods._getFace: Retrieves the SIMD 4-vector position and the active NavMesh face key currently inhabited by the character.
methods._getFaceKey: Directly queries the current NavMesh polygon face key.
methods.atGoal: Evaluates whether the agent has reached the final destination goal point within acceptable spatial tolerance threshold.
methods.calculateAvoidanceVector: Calculates local avoidance steering repulsive vector away from nearby dynamic obstacles and characters, returning penetration depth.
methods.calculateFuturePosition: Calculates projected future agent position and steering orientation along the active path corridor over a specified distance horizon.
methods.calculatePathVector: Computes directional steering vector towards the next path portal, calculating slow-down target points for cornering and vertex funneling.
methods.clearPath: Clears and invalidates active path structures, resetting path state to `NONE` and clearing pending waypoints.
methods.delete: Custom SIMD-aligned heap deallocator for `HavokCharacter`. Releases memory previously allocated with 16-byte alignment via `_aligned_free`.
methods.edgeCollision: Checks for immediate penetration between the agent's collision cylinder and nearby NavMesh border edges.
methods.getClosestPoint: Queries the closest valid NavMesh boundary or portal point within a specified maximum radius, optionally taking dynamic building doorways and obstacles into account.
methods.getCollidedCharacter: Queries the entity handle of another character currently colliding with or impeding this agent.
methods.getDirectionMoved: Queries the actual travel direction vector traversed during the most recent kinematic simulation integration step.
methods.getPathState: Queries detailed status of active path computation and execution (NONE, COMPLETE, INCOMPLETE, FAILED, WAITING, UPDATING, BROKEN).
methods.getPosition: Retrieves the current world-space position vector of the Havok navigation agent.
methods.getState: Queries high-level character navigation state (IDLE, GOAL_REACHED, FOLLOWING_PATH, or MANUAL).
methods.getVelocity: Queries the current linear velocity vector of the character.
methods.getWaypointDirection: Queries the normalized direction vector towards the currently targeted NavMesh edge or intermediate waypoint.
methods.handleCollision: Detects and reacts to dynamic agent-agent and agent-obstacle collisions, adjusting local trajectory and triggering avoidance maneuvers.
methods.invalidate: Invalidates current path progress if matching an invalidated request ID or region ID, forcing path recalculation.
methods.isOnNavmesh: Determines whether the agent is currently positioned on a valid Havok NavMesh polygon face.
methods.moveAlongPath: Advances the agent along the current polyline path corridor for a given time step, updating current waypoint and triggering portal funneling string-pulling.
methods.moveCollide: Sweeps a character cylinder/sphere proxy from start coordinate along a displacement vector, detecting contact with cached boundary edges.
methods.new: Custom SIMD-aligned heap allocator for `HavokCharacter`. Allocates memory aligned to a 16-byte boundary via `_aligned_malloc` to satisfy Havok AI and SSE/AVX `hkVector4f` vector register alignment constraints.
methods.operator_delete: Frees memory allocated for a HavokCharacter instance using the class deallocator.
methods.operator_new: Allocates raw memory for a HavokCharacter instance using the class allocator.
methods.pullThroughVertex: Applies string-pulling funnel algorithms across shared NavMesh polygon edges, tightening path corners around left or right portal vertices.
methods.requestPath: Dispatches an asynchronous A* pathfinding query request to the Havok navigation generator queue towards a targeted goal coordinate.
methods.resolveProblems: Resolves edge cases such as agent getting stuck outside NavMesh boundaries, off-mesh fall recovery, or trapped inside dynamic obstacles.
methods.setDesiredSpeed: Configures the desired forward travel speed target for the kinematic steering controller.
methods.setHandle: Associates or updates the entity handle (`hand`) referencing the owning character possessing this Havok agent.
methods.setManualMode: Toggles manual navigation steering override mode, bypassing autonomous edge-following path logic for direct manual control.
methods.setPath: Processes a completed `HavokCharacterMessage` containing newly solved A* path corridors and edge sequences, populating `currentPath` and resetting edge indices.
methods.setPosition: Sets the agent's spatial position and updates the current NavMesh polygon face key. Marks `positionChanged = true` to force edge cache and spatial partition updates.
methods.setVelocity: Explicitly assigns the linear kinematic velocity vector of the navigation agent.
methods.setWaterModifier: Applies a speed attenuation multiplier to account for water immersion drag or deep wading resistance.
methods.update: Primary per-frame simulation update step for the Havok character. Advances kinematic movement along path, integrates velocity, executes edge collision queries, and updates steering vectors.
methods.updateEdgeCache: Refreshes local obstacle edge cache (`EdgeCache`) within a spherical search volume around a given center point.
methods.updateNextEdge: Advances the active path traversal index `nextEdge` to the subsequent polygon boundary edge along `currentPath`.
methods.updateVelocity: Integrates kinematic acceleration towards a specified target direction over a simulation delta time interval, clamping output velocity to `desiredSpeed` scaled by environmental water drag modifiers.
methods.~HavokCharacter: Destructor for `HavokCharacter`. Deallocates path nodes in `currentPath`, clears local dynamic edge cache arrays (`edgeCache.edges`), releases boundary buffers via `hkContainerHeapAllocator`, and clears collision state references.

properties.boundary: Cached boundary edge nodes surrounding agent.
properties.boundaryPos: Position of nearest NavMesh boundary edge.
properties.characterState: High-level agent movement state (IDLE, GOAL_REACHED, FOLLOWING_PATH, MANUAL).
properties.collided: Entity handle of colliding obstacle character.

properties.currentPath: Active polyline path corridor edge sequence.
properties.desiredSpeed: Target steering travel speed in m/s.
properties.directionMoved: Actual displacement direction vector traveled during last frame.
properties.edgeCache: Local dynamic obstacle edge cache structure.
properties.lastState: Previous movement state prior to transition.
properties.nextEdge: Index of subsequent target edge portal along path corridor.
properties.positionChanged: Spatial transformation dirty flag forcing cache invalidation.
properties.radius: Agent navigation collision cylinder radius in meters.
properties.resolveFlag: Recovery and problem resolution mode indicator flag.
properties.sensoryData: Pointer to character awareness and perception subsystem.
properties.startingFace: NavMesh face key where path query commenced.
properties.timeOffPath: Accumulated duration spent off valid NavMesh corridors.
properties.waterModifier: Water drag speed attenuation scalar multiplier.
properties.waypointDirection: Direction heading towards immediate portal waypoint.

HealthPartStatus.description: Individual anatomical body part health record tracking flesh health, bandage healing, blunt stun, robotic wear damage, amputation, and bleeding contributions.

methods.applyDamage: Applies cut, blunt, and pierce damage components to this body part, reducing flesh health and adding stun damage.
methods.applyWearDamage: Applies mechanical wear-and-tear damage to a robotic limb or prosthetic body part.
methods.getBloodynessMult: Returns visual bloody texture intensity multiplier for this body part based on cut damage.
methods.getData: Returns the `GameData` body part definition template from FCS.
methods.getExtraBleedingAmount: Returns additional bleed rate caused by open bleeding cuts on this body part.
methods.getRobotLimbEnum: Returns the corresponding `RobotLimbs::Limb` enumeration (`LEFT_ARM`, `RIGHT_ARM`, etc.) for this part.
methods.getRobotLimbState: Returns the current condition (`LIMB_ORIGINAL`, `LIMB_STUMP`, `LIMB_REPLACED`, `LIMB_CRUSHED`) of this limb.
methods.getWorstDamage: Returns the highest severity wound damage value on this body part.
methods.healthAsPercent: Calculates the normalized health percentage (0.0 to 1.0) of this body part for a given raw health value relative to maximum health.
methods.isDead: Returns true if this vital body part (head, chest, stomach) has sustained fatal damage below the mortal threshold.
methods.isRobotic: Returns true if this body part has been replaced with a prosthetic robotic limb or belongs to a skeleton/robot race.
methods.load: Restores body part hitpoints, bandaged health, and wear damage from savegame `GameData`.
methods.maxHealth: Returns the maximum hit points for this body part, adjusted for character age, racial multipliers, and scale.
methods.serialise: Saves body part hitpoints, bandaged health, and wound damage to savegame `GameData`.
methods.setRobotLimbItem: Equips the specified prosthetic `RobotLimbItem` onto this body part.
methods.setup: Initializes anatomical parameters, maximum hitpoints, hit chance weights, and owning character reference.
methods.update: Advances the medical simulation for this body part, processing natural healing, wound degeneration, bandage absorption, and robotic wear.
methods.updateDerivedHealths: Recalculates cached derived health percentage and functional status flags for this body part.

properties.bandageHealth: Temporary bandaged hit points undergoing healing.
properties.bloodLoss: Rate of active haemorrhage from this limb.
properties.data: FCS body part definition record.
properties.fleshHealth: Current structural biological flesh hit points.
properties.maxHealthVal: Maximum anatomical hit points derived from toughness.
properties.stunDamage: Temporary blunt stun damage decaying over time.
properties.wearDamage: Robotic wear damage requiring repair kit.

ImpactPoint.description: Defines strike timing, trajectory direction, target body part, and power for an individual weapon hit within a combat technique animation.

InputHandler.description: Input processing subsystem bridging raw OIS mouse and keyboard hardware events to MyGUI widgets, game world selection boxes, camera controls, and hotkey actions.

methods.addCommand: Registers a named input command with its assigned event code, primary key, alternate key, modifier masks, and game mode.
methods.addKey: Registers a named boolean input state bound to primary and alternate keys for the given game mode.
methods.bind: Binds a named input action or command to the specified keycode.
methods.clearMessages: Clears pending input event messages and transient keypress states.
methods.getBoundCommand: Returns the command name bound to the specified keycode in the given game mode.
