NavMesh.description: Master navigation system integrating Havok AI (hkaiWorld). Manages asynchronous pathfinding queries, outdoor terrain sectors, interior building NavMesh instances, door traversal gates, and origin shifts. Interacts directly with `HavokCharacter` for character agent path following, `ZoneMap` for outdoor terrain tile streaming, `Building` for interior navigational cutouts and door states, and `ThreadClass` for dedicated background multi-threaded path calculation.

methods.NavMesh: Primary constructor initializing the Havok AI navigation subsystem, allocating input/output message queues, and starting the asynchronous background pathfinding worker thread.
methods.areEdgesConnected: Checks whether two navigation mesh edge nodes are directly connected on the specified graph side.
methods.cancelMessage: Cancels a pending asynchronous pathfinding request for the specified character.

methods.checkCollision: Tests for navigation mesh edge collision along a motion vector from the specified nav face.
methods.checkLineOfSight: Performs a raycast line-of-sight test across the navigation mesh between two characters or towards a target point.
methods.countInteriors: Returns the number of building interior navigation instances loaded within the specified zone coordinate.
methods.create: Creates and initializes navigation mesh geometry for the given `ZoneMap` chunk.
methods.createEdgePath: Constructs an ordered list of edge path nodes traversing the specified faces.
methods.createInstance: Instantiates a Havok AI navigation instance for a building interior in the world.
methods.createZone: Builds the navigation mesh sector for a zone chunk using loaded building interior structures.
methods.createZoneInstance: Instantiates a zone navigation sector and connects its building interiors to the global graph.

methods.deleteMesh: Frees memory associated with a loaded `NavMeshSector` or `NavInstance`.
methods.destroy: Removes and unregisters all navigation geometry associated with the specified building entity.
methods.directPath: Fast straight-line raycast verification across the navigation mesh, checking if two spatial points can be connected without obstacle circumvention.
methods.fillEdgeCache: Caches navigable boundary edges surrounding a point on the given face for fast obstacle queries.
methods.findEdges: Finds all navigation edge indices within the given radius around a point on the specified face.
methods.findPath: Executes hierarchical A* path search across terrain sectors and building interiors from start coordinate to goal position, generating smooth edge-path waypoint nodes.
methods.generate: Queues background dynamic navigation mesh generation for a building, bounding box, or zone chunk.
methods.getClearance: Calculates clearance distance to the left and right along an edge node on the specified face.
methods.getClosestBoundary: Finds the closest navigation mesh boundary edge within the given radius of a point.

methods.getClosestPoint: Finds the closest valid navigable ground point on the mesh within the specified search radius.
methods.getEdgesAroundPoint: Retrieves all navigation mesh edge nodes connected around a point for path turning.

methods.getFilename: Constructs the file path to the cached navigation mesh file for the given zone chunk.
methods.getGateCode: Returns the gate code integer associated with a character or position in the navigation graph.

methods.getZoneEdge: Calculates the navigation boundary point where a path crosses between adjacent zone sectors.
methods.hashBuilding: Calculates a content hash for a building entity to determine if its navmesh requires regeneration.
methods.hashInterior: Calculates a content hash for a building interior layout.
methods.hashZone: Calculates a combined content hash for a zone chunk and its contained buildings.
methods.initialise: Initializes the Havok AI world environment, query filters, and threading locks.
methods.isCharacterStuck: Evaluates whether a character is trapped with no valid navigable exits on the mesh.
methods.isGenerating: Returns true if background navigation mesh generation tasks are currently in progress.

methods.isLoaded: Returns true if the navigation mesh sector for the specified zone coordinate is loaded.

NavMeshGenerator.description: Background worker thread generating and carving NavMesh polygon meshes from raw terrain heightfields, static meshes, and dynamic building obstacle hulls. Integrates Havok AI (`hkaiNavMesh`, `hkaiNavMeshGenerationSettings`) with PhysX collision scenes, orchestrating multi-threaded task queues, building doorway connections, dynamic obstacle excision, and seamless adjacent zone edge stitching.

methods.NavMeshGenerator: Primary constructor for `NavMeshGenerator`. Initializes `ThreadClass` worker thread, binds parent `NavMesh` manager, configures Havok AI generation settings (`hkaiNavMeshGenerationSettings`), initializes task queues, and allocates PhysX shape query buffers.
methods.addFoliageCarvers: Extracts solid foliage and large boulder/tree collision volumes in the zone and registers them as Havok obstacle carvers.
methods.addGeometry: Appends triangle mesh collision geometry into a `hkGeometry` buffer, applying transformation matrix and material attributes.
methods.addJob: Dispatches a NavMesh generation job for multiple building structures in a zone. If `splice` is true, performs localized mesh cutting and welding rather than full zone regeneration.
methods.addStitchJob: Enqueues an edge-stitching job between the given NavInstance and all adjacent loaded or cached navmesh boundaries.
methods.addWaterPlane: Adds a horizontal water plane surface to Havok geometry, allowing swimming and deep-water navigation polygon classifications.
methods.carve: Carves out dynamic obstacle volumes from an existing Havok NavMesh, cutting polygon edges and creating walkable boundaries around new building footprints.
methods.createHeightmapMesh: Extracts terrain heightfield geometry from the `ZoneMap` and constructs a Havok triangular geometry representation (`hkGeometry`) offset by world coordinates.
methods.createVolume: Allocates and constructs an `hkaiVolume` obstacle representation from a PhysX collision shape.
methods.generateBuildingMesh: Generates exterior building collision obstacle meshes within the specified bounds, creating solid blocking volumes for building foundations.
methods.generateInteriorMesh: Generates detailed interior collision geometry for a building structure, extracting stairs, multi-floor slabs, interior walls, and doorways.
methods.generateTaskBT: Dispatches high-level generation task logic on the worker thread based on task type: full zone generation, building splicing, or dynamic obstacle carving.
methods.getCollisionShapes: Queries PhysX scene overlap within the specified 3D bounding box to extract physical collision shapes for navmesh generation.
methods.getCompletedTask: Searches the `done` queue for a completed task matching the designated UID, returning its output `NavInstance`.
methods.getDoorPainters: Identifies doorway portals across buildings within the bounds and registers them as door painting volumes in Havok AI settings, enabling doorway connectivity.
methods.getInteriorCavers: Computes interior carving volumes for buildings within the query bounds, carving out exterior ground mesh where buildings stand.
methods.getSeedPointsFromAdjacentZone: Extracts flood-fill seed points from an adjacent zone boundary, ensuring continuous connected traversable surface discovery across zone borders.
methods.getVolumePoints: Extracts convex volume vertices from a PhysX shape under a Havok transform.
methods.hasJob: Checks whether there are any pending or in-progress generation tasks registered for the specified zone.
methods.isGenerating: Queries whether the generator is actively computing a task or has pending jobs remaining in the queue.
methods.lockZone: Acquires exclusive generation lock on the specified zone coordinates, preventing duplicate generation passes across adjacent threads.
methods.newTask: Allocates and initializes a new NavMesh generation `Task` structure for the specified zone, bounding box, and world coordinate offset.
methods.revertSettings: Restores Havok AI generation settings back to global engine defaults after a customized building interior or obstacle carving pass.
methods.setup: Initializes default Havok AI navmesh parameters: character walk slope, step height, agent radius, climbing limits, rasterization cell size, and polygon simplification thresholds.
methods.shiftEdge: Shifts boundary edges of a carved mesh to align seamlessly with the base navmesh border geometry.
methods.shiftHole: Fills and closes degenerate holes or gaps formed along interior carving seams.
methods.splice: Performs localized navmesh splicing, cutting a rectangular sub-region out of an existing navmesh tile and welding a newly generated replacement patch.
methods.stitch: Welds matching boundary edges between two adjacent `NavInstance` meshes, generating cross-instance transition portals (`hkaiDirectedGraphExplicitRigid`) for seamless world navigation.
methods.stitchExterior: Stitches exterior ground navmesh around building perimeters to surrounding outdoor terrain mesh.
methods.stitchInterior: Stitches building interior navmesh floor slabs to exterior ground entrance portals, connecting doorways to the outdoor pathfinding grid.
methods.stitchUnloadedZone: Stitches a newly loaded `NavInstance` against an adjacent zone tile that is cached or un-instantiated, using serialized border edge records.
methods.stitchWithInteriors: Batch stitches an exterior `NavInstance` with a collection of interior building navmesh instances.
methods.threadProc: Primary worker thread procedure. Continuously pops generation tasks from `queue`, executes voxelization, polygon extraction, carving, and stitching, and pushes completed tasks into `done` queue.
methods.unlockTask: Releases the multi-threaded lock on a task after main thread consumption and deallocates task memory.
methods.unlockZone: Releases the exclusive generation lock on the specified zone coordinates.
methods.update: Main thread update tick called from `NavMesh::update`. Retrieves finished tasks from the `done` queue, registers completed `NavInstance` meshes into the world, and initiates adjacent zone border stitching.
methods.updateBT: Worker thread execution tick. Processes the next active task from the queue, invoking `generateTaskBT` within a try-catch block to prevent worker thread aborts.
methods.validateBuildingStates: Validates construction and demolition states for all buildings involved in the generation task, ensuring destroyed or moved structures are properly excised.
methods.~NavMeshGenerator: Virtual destructor terminating background generation worker thread, purging pending and completed task queues, releasing Havok AI generation settings, and deallocating PhysX query buffers.

methods.add: Adds vector b to this vector, or adds vector a and vector b and stores the result in this vector.

methods.magnitudeSquared: Returns the squared scalar length of this vector.
methods.multiplyAdd: Sets this vector to scalar s multiplied by vector a plus vector b.
methods.normalize: Normalizes this vector to unit length in-place and returns its previous magnitude.
methods.operator_add: Returns a new NxVec3 representing the sum of two vectors.
methods.operator_add_assign: Adds another NxVec3 to this vector in-place.
methods.operator_assign: Copies component values from another NxVec3 into this vector.
methods.operator_eq: Returns true if this vector equals another NxVec3.
methods.operator_mul: Returns a new NxVec3 representing the product of this vector and a scalar number.
methods.operator_mul_assign: Multiplies this vector by a scalar number in-place.
methods.operator_ne: Returns true if this vector does not equal another NxVec3.
methods.operator_sub: Returns a new NxVec3 representing the difference of two vectors.

methods.set: Sets the components of this vector from another NxVec3 or from three numeric values (x, y, z).
methods.setMagnitude: Scales this vector to have the specified target magnitude length.
methods.subtract: Subtracts vector b from this vector, or subtracts vector b from vector a and stores the result in this vector.
methods.zero: Resets all components (x, y, z) of this vector to zero.

OrdersReceiver.description: Core task management, order arbitration, and player command dispatch subsystem in Kenshi. Manages player interactive action queues (`ActionDeque orders`), autonomous permanent jobs (`permajobs`), Goal-Oriented Action Planning goal priority tiers (`goals[5]`), squad AI packages (`squadAIPackage[5]`), and subordinate slave job delegations (`slaveJobs`).

methods.OrdersReceiver: Primary constructor for `OrdersReceiver`. Links owner character and AI controller (`AI*`), initializes default combat aggro mode (`AI_AGGRESSIVE`), allocates empty FIFO order deque (`orders`), initializes permajob containers, goal priority queues, and resets GOAP flags.
methods._clearGoals: Internal routine clearing and deallocating all goal descriptors across all 5 priority tiers in `goals`.
methods._forceOrderInsert: Directly forces insertion of a high-priority order task into the front of the player action queue (`orders`), bypassing standard arbitration.
methods.addGoal: Inserts an AI goal task into the appropriate priority tier array in `goals[5]`, triggering GOAP re-evaluation.
methods.addJob: Appends a permanent autonomous job (crafting, farming, guarding, hauling) to the permanent jobs list (`permajobs`).
methods.addOrder: Enqueues an interactive player command (move, attack, interact) into the order deque. If `clearOld` is set, discards existing queued actions; if `shift` is true, queues behind current tasks without preemption.
methods.clearCurrentGoal: Resets and clears the currently executing goal (`currentGoal`), optionally forcing abort even during critical actions.
methods.clearJobs: Clears all temporary dynamic jobs from `jobs` list.
methods.clearOrders: Clears and deallocates all pending interactive orders in the action deque, halting manual player tasks.
methods.clearPermajobs: Purges and deallocates all assigned permanent jobs from `permajobs`.
methods.clearSlaveJobs: Clears and frees all delegated subordinate tasks stored in `slaveJobs`.
methods.getCurrentGoal: Retrieves const reference to the currently selected active goal match descriptor (`currentGoal`).
methods.getFirstOrder: Peeks at the active head order at the front of the action deque (`orders`).
methods.getPermajob: Queries the `TaskType` enumeration of the permajob in a specified priority slot.
methods.getPermajobCount: Returns the total number of configured permanent jobs currently assigned to this character.
methods.getPermajobData: Returns pointer to the underlying `Tasker` data descriptor of the permajob in a specified slot.
methods.getPermajobName: Retrieves the display string name of a permanent job occupying a specified priority slot.
methods.getSlaveJobs: Populates `out` with delegated subordinate jobs (`slaveJobs`) inherited from owner or squad master AI repertoire.
methods.hasGoal: Checks whether an active goal of the specified task type exists in any priority tier.
methods.hasOrders: Evaluates whether any commands (manual orders or hold position) are active on this receiver.
methods.hasPermajob: Checks whether a permajob of the specified task type is currently configured in `permajobs`.
methods.hasPlayerOrder: Checks whether a specific task type is currently pending within the player order deque.
methods.hasPlayerOrders: Checks whether the action deque contains any active, uncompleted manual player orders.
methods.isInChoosingGoalMode: Queries whether the AI is currently in the middle of goal arbitration and candidate evaluation (`choosingGoalMode`).
methods.isJobsEnabled: Queries whether the automated permanent jobs execution toggle (`doJobsEnabled`) is active.
methods.loadFromSerialise: Deserializes orders, permanent jobs, and tactical stances from a `GameData` record during game loading, reconstructing task instances and enqueuing them.
methods.movePermajob: Reorders permanent jobs in the priority list, moving a permajob from `taskIdx` to `targetIdx`.
methods.removeGoal: Removes all AI goals matching specified task type across all priority tiers in `goals[5]`.
methods.removeJob: Removes temporary job instances of a specific task type from the dynamic jobs list (`jobs`).
methods.removePermajob: Removes a permanent job at the specified index from `permajobs`, shifting subsequent job priorities up.
methods.serialise: Serializes active orders, permanent assigned jobs, combat aggro stance, and hold-position tasks into a `GameData` save record.
methods.setHoldPositionOrders: Assigns or clears explicit 'Hold Position' stance orders (`holdPositionOrders`), anchoring character to current coordinate.
methods.setJobsEnabled: Enables or disables autonomous permanent job execution (`doJobsEnabled`). When disabled, character idles rather than working.
methods.setNeedGOAP: Sets the `needGOAP` dirty flag to request a fresh AI task and goal re-evaluation on the next frame.
methods.tryToGetCurrentGoal: Evaluates candidate goals across priority tiers, orders deque, and permajobs, returning the winning `Tasker*` candidate.
methods.updateLastOrder: Updates target coordinate or target entity handle of the most recently enqueued player order.
methods.~OrdersReceiver: Virtual destructor for `OrdersReceiver`. Clears pending action deque, releases dynamically allocated `Tasker*` jobs and permajobs, frees GOAP goal buckets across all 5 priority tiers, and clears subordinate slave jobs.

PhysicsActual.description: Concrete PhysX 2.8 physics implementation managing scene creation, raycasting queries, rigid body dynamics, collision filters, and simulation steps.

methods._createStaticBox: Directly instantiates an immovable PhysX box actor with specified position, dimensions, orientation, and collision group.
methods._createStaticCapsule: Directly instantiates an immovable PhysX capsule actor with specified position, cylinder length, and radius.
methods._createTriggerHull: Directly instantiates an unmoving PhysX box trigger actor configured to report overlap callbacks without rigid collision response.
methods._destroy: Immediately releases and deletes an underlying PhysX actor from the active physics scene.
methods.backThreadUpdate: Executes the background physics simulation tick, advancing the PhysX scene and processing threaded callback buffers.
methods.convertXMLToBin: Converts an XML PhysX collection or mesh file into cooked binary format using the specified coordinate scale.
methods.getActorCollisionGroup: Returns the PhysX collision filtering group mask assigned to the given actor.
methods.loadPhysXFile: Loads and instantiates PhysX rigid bodies and collision meshes from an XML or binary physics file.
methods.loadPhysXFileAsATrigger: Loads physics geometry from file and configures the resulting actors as trigger volumes.
methods.scaleCollection: Applies 3D spatial scaling to all actors, collision shapes, and joints in a PhysX collection descriptor.
methods.scytheGetFirstModelName: Reads a Scythe physics definition file and extracts the filename identifier of its primary collision model.
methods.scytheInsert: Instantiates Scythe physics actors and joint hierarchies directly into the active PhysX simulation world.
methods.setActorCollisionGroup: Sets the PhysX collision filtering group mask for the given actor.
methods.setActorMaterial: Assigns the physical material (friction, restitution) to all shapes on the specified actor.
methods.setup: Initializes the PhysX SDK runtime, physics scenes, materials, and backthread simulation loop.
methods.threadJunkPostBT: Performs post-simulation cleanup and state synchronization on the worker thread following a background physics step.
methods.threadJunkPreBT: Performs pre-simulation setup and lock acquisition on the worker thread prior to advancing the physics simulation.
methods.uncookMesh: Extracts vertex and triangle index buffers from cooked PhysX collision mesh data.
methods.updateUT: Executes the main-thread physics synchronization pass, updating scene node transforms and dispatching trigger events.
methods.~PhysicsActual: Destructs the `PhysicsActual` instance and releases allocated resources.

PhysicsInterface.description: Abstract virtual interface decoupling game logic and character locomotion from concrete PhysX and Havok simulation implementations.

methods.addConstantTracerMT: Enqueues a persistent volume or raycast tracer to be registered on the background physics simulation thread.
methods.addImpulse: Queues a directional linear force impulse applied at a world-space position to a physics hull on the simulation thread.
methods.addNewObject: Queues a threaded physics object interface to be created and registered into the active PhysX simulation.
methods.backThreadUpdate: Executes a background physics simulation step for the given frame time.
methods.changeGroup: Queues a collision group change for the specified physics hull to update its collision filtering mask on the worker thread.
methods.createSimplePhysicsEntityMT: Creates a simple PhysX collision entity from an Ogre visual entity and collision parameters, configuring static or dynamic simulation.
methods.createStaticCapsule: Creates and registers an immovable vertical capsule collision hull at the specified world position with given height and radius.
methods.createTriggerHull: Creates an axis-aligned box trigger collision hull linked to a root object for detecting entry and exit overlap events.
methods.destroy: Queues a threaded physics hull interface for destruction and removal from the active physics scene.
methods.destroyActor: Queues an underlying PhysX actor for destruction and removal on the background simulation thread.
methods.doorWantsSetup: Queues a door physics controller structure for initialization and joint setup in the physics system.
methods.getBackthread: Returns pointer to the concrete `PhysicsActual` engine instance running the asynchronous physics thread.
methods.loadScytheFileMT: Queues thread-safe loading and instantiation of a Scythe physics collision object attached to a scene entity.
methods.loadScytheRagdollFileMT: Queues thread-safe loading and construction of a ragdoll skeletal articulation from a Scythe physics file.
methods.loadTerrain: Queues asynchronous loading of terrain heightfield collision shapes for the specified sector.
methods.queuesAreClearMT: Returns true if all inter-thread physics command and creation message queues have finished processing and are empty.
methods.removeConstantTracerMT: Queues a persistent raycast or volume tracer to be deregistered and removed from the background simulation thread.
methods.scytheCreateAttachmentData: Parses a Scythe physics definition file to extract attachment points and bone socket data into the output list.
methods.scytheInsertPreview: Loads and instantiates collision preview geometry for a building placement hologram from its game data definition.
methods.setQueuesAreClear: Sets the synchronization flag indicating whether multi-threaded physics command queues are currently idle.
methods.updateUT: Runs main-thread synchronization and flushes inter-thread physics message queues.
methods.~PhysicsInterface: Destructs the `PhysicsInterface` instance and releases allocated resources.

properties._queuesClear: Flag indicating whether all inter-thread physics command queues are currently empty.
properties._vftable: Virtual method table pointer for abstract physics interface.
properties.nWorld: Pointer to the active PhysX NxScene physics world.

Platoon.description: Macro military and civilian squad controller governing group formation navigation, roster management, squad AI tasks, patrol waypoints, persistent serialization, and asset ownership. Derived from `RootObjectBase`, `Platoon` bridges active 3D world reality and abstract background simulation. Coordinates directly with `Faction` for political allegiance, `Character` for individual squad members, `ActivePlatoon` for live scene graph entities, `Ownerships` for squad currency and property ledgers, and `TownBase` for municipal settlement assignments.

methods.Platoon: Primary constructor initializing squad identity string, allocating embedded Ownerships ledger, binding parent faction, and configuring squad template rules.

methods.getPatrolInfo: Retrieves pointer to `PatrolInfo` controlling waypoints and wandering intervals.

methods.getRoamingMapArea: Retrieves pointer to geographic biome area partition restricting squad roaming boundaries.
methods.getSquadLeader: Retrieves pointer to the character designated as current squad leader.
methods.getSquadLeader_theRealOne: Retrieves persistent entity handle referencing the true authoritative squad leader.
methods.getSquadType: Retrieves squad operational classification enum (e.g. MILITARY, CARAVAN, PATROL, HOME_DEFENSE).
methods.getStateBroadcast: Retrieves tactical broadcast state sharing crime alerts and target locks across nearby friendly units.
methods.getUnloadedPlatoon: Retrieves pointer to the `UnloadedPlatoon` container holding abstract background character data.
methods.hasCampaign: Checks if the squad is currently dispatched on an active war campaign or raid mission.

methods.iBuyStolenGoods: Checks if merchants or fences in this squad will purchase stolen contraband goods.
methods.isFullyLoaded: Queries whether all characters in the squad have finished streaming and spawning into active reality.
methods.isIntact: Checks if the platoon has at least one conscious, active member capable of movement and combat.
methods.isPersistentSquad: Queries whether this squad is marked as persistent across game saves.
methods.isUnconcious: Evaluates whether every active character in the squad is currently unconscious, in a coma, or dying.
methods.isUnique: Polymorphic RTTI downcast query checking whether this squad is a named `UniquePlatoon`.
methods.loadFromSerialise: Restores platoon state, character rosters, and waypoints from loaded savegame structure.
methods.loadStateData: Restores character state data and attributes from serialized record.
methods.needsNewCharacters: Computes deficit between current population and original spawn quota to determine recruit replenishment needs.
methods.notifyMissionEnded: Notifies squad that an assigned military campaign or mission objective has concluded.
methods.periodicUpdate_active: Periodic low-frequency update for active squads, checking nutrition, medical bleeding, and camp tasks.
methods.periodicUpdate_unloaded: Periodic update for unloaded squads, updating virtual march progress and healing in the background.
methods.reCheckPersistenceOnUnload: Re-evaluates whether the squad must be retained when unloading, checking if unique NPCs or player interactions occurred.
methods.reprocessTask: Re-evaluates and refreshes an assigned character task through the squad task management scheduler.
methods.serialise: Exports complete squad hierarchy, members, inventory, and task queues into savegame state.
methods.serialiseEverything: Serializes all character states, medical statuses, and equipment within the platoon.
methods.setCharacterCount: Sets the internal tracked character count for the squad.
methods.setDataFilename: Assigns custom disk filename for platoon serialization.
methods.setFaction: Transfers ownership of the platoon to a new political faction, re-evaluating diplomatic alignments, enemy lists, and uniform color palettes.
methods.setPersistentSquad: Configures whether this platoon persists permanently in the save file.
methods.setRoamingMapArea: Restricts squad wandering paths to the specified regional biome area.
methods.setSquadType: Assigns squad operational type classification enum.
methods.setupPatrolSettings: Configures territorial patrol radius limits around home settlement or outpost anchor.
methods.showDebugMarker: Toggles rendering of the debug 3D squad locator model in the scene graph.
methods.taskIsComplete: Callback invoked when a squad task finishes execution, selecting the next priority queued order.
methods.undeclareDead: Clears the dead flag, restoring the squad to life upon recruitment or emergency medical revival.
methods.update: Primary frame update tick evaluating member health, checking leader coherence, and triggering task step advances.

properties.matchSlope: True if the building tilts to match the underlying terrain slope.
properties.nodesOk: True if all usage nodes of the preview have valid clearance.
properties.parentNode: Read-only Ogre::SceneNode* pointer (as lightuserdata) for the preview's root scene node.
properties.pos: Current world position of the preview as a Vector3 table {x, y, z}.
properties.positionHitGroup: Physics raycast hit group for the preview's current placement surface.
properties.prospectResource: MiningResource enum type required by this building for ground resource prospecting.
properties.prospectingInformation: DatapanelGUI window displaying ground resource prospecting efficiency during placement.
properties.prospectingOK: True if the local ground resource meets the minimum requirement for this building.
properties.roofOnly: True if this building can only be placed on a building roof.
properties.rot: Current rotation of the preview as a Quaternion table {w, x, y, z}.
properties.slopeOK: True if the terrain slope at the preview location is within acceptable limits.
properties.snappedTo: The existing Building that this preview is currently snapped onto, or nil.

ProductionBuilding.description: `ProductionBuilding` forms the backbone of Kenshi's manufacturing economy, powering ore refineries, grain mills, cooking stoves, biofuel distillers, and automated mining drills.

methods.ProductionBuilding: Constructs a new `ProductionBuilding` machine instance within the game world, linking spatial placement, owner settlement, and layout context, then invokes `setupFromData()` to configure input consumption grids and output product slots.
methods.canHaveSomeOfThese: Determines whether this machine's input sections can accept the proposed item blueprint during hauling deposits.
methods.createInventoryLayout: Constructs a specialized MyGUI inventory layout presenting separate visual containers for raw material inputs and manufactured output products.
methods.getConsumtionItems: Retrieves an input consumption item descriptor by array index.
methods.getDefaultTask: Returns the default `TaskType` assigned to characters interacting with or assigned to work at this production machine.
methods.getGUIData: Renders telemetry data to the HUD Datapanel, displaying operating efficiency, power usage, and ground resource fertility.
methods.getGUIFertility: Renders ground resource fertility ratings to the Datapanel GUI.
methods.getGUIState: Renders current operational state string (e.g. "Operating", "No Resources", "Output Full", "Out of Power") to the HUD.
methods.getGUIToolTipForGroundResourceEfficiency: Generates localized tooltip text describing ground resource extraction efficiency and quality ratings.
methods.getInputValue: Calculates the raw material conversion value provided by a specific input item instance.
methods.getItemsWeWantRidOf: Populates a list of finished manufactured items ready to be hauled away to storage bins or distribution stockpiles.
methods.getMiningResourceLevel: Queries the environmental ground resource rating under this structure (e.g. iron quality, copper quality, stone purity, or water fertility).
methods.getMouseCursor: Determines the contextual mouse cursor icon displayed when hovering over this machine. Returns `CURSOR_OPERATE_MACHINERY`.
methods.getNumConsumtionItems: Returns the number of input ingredient consumption item descriptors defined for this recipe.
methods.getOutput: Queries the accumulated fractional completion progress toward producing the next unit of finished goods.
methods.getOutputBasedRotationSpeedMult: Computes mechanical gear rotation animation speed scaled to actual operating efficiency and power status.
methods.getProductionBuilding: Returns the downcasted polymorphic pointer to this `ProductionBuilding` instance. Overrides `Building::getProductionBuilding()`.
methods.getProductionMult: Calculates the net production rate multiplier factoring in base blueprint output speed, terrain resource fertility rating, and environmental quality.
methods.getProductionMultForGUI: Retrieves the normalized efficiency multiplier formatted for display in the bottom HUD Datapanel inspector window.
methods.getResourcesNeededBecauseEmpty: Gathers input raw materials that are completely exhausted, emitting high-priority hauling jobs for logistics workers.
methods.getResourcesNeededBecauseNotFull: Gathers input raw materials that have available capacity in their respective input inventory sections to maintain continuous operation.
methods.isAnyInputsEmpty: Checks if any required recipe input material is completely absent from the input inventory.
methods.isAnyInputsFull: Checks whether any input ingredient inventory section has reached its designated capacity limit.
methods.isAnyInputsInvalidType: Validates that items deposited in input sections conform to expected blueprint material types.
methods.isProductionEmpty: Checks whether the finished goods output inventory section currently holds zero items.
methods.isProductionFull: Checks whether the output section is completely filled with manufactured products, blocking further machine operation.
methods.limitInputsOutputRate: Restricts operational rate according to the limiting input raw material or available output capacity.
methods.loadFromSerialise: Restores production progress, active operational state, and input buffers from serialized savegame records.
methods.needsUpdate: Queries whether this machine requires per-frame simulation processing.
methods.operate: Drives production advancement during character operation or automatic machine ticks. Clamps rate by inputs and electrical power, consumes raw ingredients, and outputs finished products.
methods.serialise: Serializes machine operational state, output progress fractions, input material buffers, and terrain mining levels into savegame delta records.
methods.setProductionItem: Configures or switches the primary output product generated by this machine, updating recipe parameters and output capacity.
methods.setupFromData: Parses the FCS `BUILDING_FUNCTIONALITY` record, allocating dedicated `InventorySection` grids for raw material inputs and output goods.
methods.setupMiningResourceLevel: Samples the underlying terrain biome map at the machine's world coordinates to determine mining resource quality or agricultural fertility.
methods.update: Main simulation tick. Advances sound loops, verifies active operators, and if configured as an automatic machine, invokes automated production processing.
methods.updateInputs: Consumes raw materials from input inventory sections proportional to manufactured output progress.
methods.updateInventoryWindow: Synchronizes active GUI controls with current progress and resource levels if the container window is open.
methods.updateOutput: Accumulates manufacturing progress and, upon completing a unit (progress $\ge 1.0$), instantiates the new physical item into the output section.
methods.~ProductionBuilding: Destructs the `ProductionBuilding` instance, releasing allocated consumption requirement items, clearing the output section pointer, and unregistering from factory lists.

properties._base: Inherited storage and container base state.
properties._resourceMiningLevel: Underlying terrain resource quality rating sampled from the local resource biome map.
properties.consumptionItems: Input raw material requirements list tracking recipe ingredient consumption rates and capacity.
properties.outSection: Output finished goods inventory grid receiving generated products.

ProductionInventoryLayout.description: Defines the GUI inventory layout and slot arrangement for crafting and production machinery buildings.

ProgressBarWidget.description: Floating progress bar widget with an integrated label, used for overhead character actions, crafting, or medical healing.

methods.setCaption: Sets the descriptive text caption displayed on the progress bar.
methods.setPosition: Sets the screen pixel coordinates (x, y) of the progress bar.
methods.setProgress: Sets the integer percentage progress value of the progress bar.

properties.label: The MyGUI::TextBox widget displaying the progress text caption.

ProspectingWindow.description: GUI window displaying the prospecting map, localized resource fertility, and mineral deposits around the surveyor.

methods._show: Internal method showing and initializing the prospecting window components.
methods.clear: Clears resource line panels and cached survey data.
methods.closeButton: Click event callback for closing the prospecting window.
methods.getSingleton: Static method returning the singleton ProspectingWindow instance.
methods.getVisible: Returns true if the prospecting window is currently open and visible.
methods.refresh: Refreshes all prospecting window overview panels and resource listings.
methods.resourceSelected: Event callback invoked when a specific resource filter button is selected.
methods.showT: Displays the prospecting window centered on world position (Ogre::Vector3) with the surveyor character's skill level and name.
methods.updateCameraMarker: Updates the camera and player position marker on the prospecting map.
methods.updateMap: Updates the prospecting overlay map display for the specified MiningResource type.
methods.worldToMapCoords: Converts a 3D world position (Ogre::Vector3) into 2D prospecting map pixel coordinates.

properties.cameraMarker: MyGUI::ImageBox widget displaying the player camera position marker on the map.
properties.cameraMarkerSkin: Raw pointer (lightuserdata) to the rotating skin used for the camera position marker.
properties.datapanelOverview1: Primary DatapanelGUI widget displaying prospecting region overview and mineral summaries.
properties.datapanelOverview2: Secondary DatapanelGUI widget displaying environmental factors such as water and fertility.
properties.imgMap: MyGUI::ImageBox widget rendering the survey map image.

properties.listResourcesPanel: MyGUI::Widget container hosting the list of detectable resources.
properties.listResourcesSelected: MyGUI::Button widget indicating the currently selected resource filter.
properties.resourceImage: Raw pointer (lightuserdata) to the RealWorldEditableImage texture displaying resource distribution.
properties.window: The root MyGUI::Window widget containing the prospecting interface.

ProsperityManager.description: Tracks a faction's current and maximum prosperity levels and adjusts prosperity when squads or special NPCs are defeated.

methods.getGUIData: Populates `panel` (`DatapanelGUI`) category `cat` with prosperity information.
methods.getProsperityMultiplier: Returns the normalized prosperity multiplier (`actualProsperity` relative to `maxProsperity`).
methods.load: Loads prosperity state from `state` (`GameData`).
methods.notifySpecialNPCDead: Reduces prosperity in response to the death of a special NPC (`npc`, `GameData`).
methods.notifySquadDefeated: Reduces prosperity in response to a squad of template `squadTemplate` (`GameData`) being defeated.
methods.setup: Initializes prosperity values from the given faction `GameData`.
methods.update: Updates faction prosperity recovery over the given `time` delta.

properties.actualProsperity: Current prosperity value of the faction.
properties.maxProsperity: Maximum possible prosperity value for the faction.

RaceData.description: Racial archetype descriptor defining base skeleton assets, body part vital multipliers, prohibited equipment slots, natural resistances, and learning rates.

methods.canEat: Returns true if members of this race are biologically capable of eating the specified food item.
methods.getRaceData: Static lookup retrieving the `RaceData` definition corresponding to an FCS string ID or `GameData` record.
methods.getStatMod: Returns the racial experience/attribute multiplier for the specified stat enumeration.
methods.isImmune: Returns true if this race is immune to the specified environmental weather hazard (e.g. acid, gas, burning).
methods.isRelatedRace: Returns true if this race belongs to the same parent race group or subrace family as the specified race.
methods.isSpecificRace: Returns true if this race matches the exact subrace `GameData` definition provided.

properties.bleedRate: Multiplier for how quickly characters of this race lose blood from cut wounds.
properties.bloodColour: RGBA colour value used for blood effects and decals of this race.
properties.canGoIndoors: Whether characters of this race are permitted to enter building interiors.
properties.carriable: Whether unconscious or dead characters of this race can be picked up and carried.
properties.data: FCS race template record pointer.
properties.extraAttackSlots: Additional simultaneous melee attacker slots supported by characters of this race.
properties.firstAidSkill: Skill enum (StatsEnumerated, such as medic or robotics) required to heal this race.
properties.forbiddenSlots: Equipment slot names prohibited for this race.
properties.gigantic: Whether this race is classified as a gigantic creature for pathfinding and combat.
properties.healRate: Natural passive health regeneration rate multiplier for this race.
properties.hungerRate: Rate at which characters of this race consume nutrition over time.
properties.isAnimal: Creature flag using creature skeleton and attacks.
properties.isRobot: Synthetic race flag exempting hunger and cut bleeding.
properties.meshName: Base 3D mesh model file asset name.
properties.noHats: Whether characters of this race are restricted from equipping headgear.
properties.noShirts: Whether characters of this race are restricted from equipping shirts.
properties.noShoes: Whether characters of this race are restricted from equipping footwear.
properties.originalBloodMax: Maximum starting blood pool capacity for characters of this race.
properties.originalBloodMin: Minimum starting blood pool capacity for characters of this race.
properties.raceGroup: Pointer to the parent RaceGroupData classification for this race.
properties.robot: Whether this race is mechanical (skeleton) rather than organic.
properties.runSpeedMaxSkill: Base maximum running speed at maximum athletics skill for this race.
properties.runSpeedMinSkill: Base minimum running speed at zero athletics skill for this race.
properties.singleGender: Whether this race uses a single gender configuration.
properties.skillMultipliers: Racial learning and proficiency rate bonuses.
properties.specialFoods: Set of additional food GameData items that only this race can consume.
properties.statMods: Map of StatsEnumerated skills to racial experience progression multipliers.
properties.swimOffset: Vertical height offset applied when characters of this race are swimming.
properties.swimSpeed: Base swimming movement speed for this race.
properties.swims: Whether characters of this race swim in deep water rather than walking on the bottom.
properties.vampiric: Whether this race feeds on unconscious or dead characters.
properties.visionMultiplier: Multiplier applied to sensory sight range for characters of this race.
properties.walkSpeed: Base walking movement speed for this race.
properties.waterAvoidance: Pathfinding penalty weight for avoiding water traversal.
properties.weatherImmunities: Set of WeatherAffecting environmental hazards that this race is immune to.

RaceLimiter.description: Equipment restriction manager enforcing race and animal equipment limitations defined in game data.

methods.addLimit: Registers race equipment restriction rules from the specified GameData record.
methods.canEquip: Returns true if the item (GameData) can be equipped by the specified RootObject or RaceData and animal flag.
methods.getSingleton: Static method returning the global singleton RaceLimiter instance.

properties.limits: Map (ogre_unordered_map<GameData*, RaceLimiter::Limiter>) of item game data to race restriction limiter rules.

methods.RagdollAnimation: Constructs a new `RagdollAnimation` instance, associating it with an `AnimationClass`. Initializes timing fields and internal state to zero or default values.
methods.getAnimationTime: Retrieves the currently elapsed time within the ragdoll transition blend. Represents the active progress of the blend transition.
methods.getTargetAnimation: Returns the name of the target animation clip that the ragdoll is blending towards. Used to queue the standard animation state machine upon blend completion.
methods.isAnimating: Checks if the ragdoll recovery blend is actively interpolating. Returns the value of the internal `animating` flag.
methods.setTargetAnimation: Configures the blend sequence by evaluating a target `Ogre::Animation` and matching its track data against the ragdoll bones. It computes the start offsets and target orientations for the transition.
methods.update: Performs the per-frame tick for the ragdoll-to-animation blend. If it's the first update, bones are set to manually controlled. It interpolates bone orientations and positions using `nlerp`, and restores regular animation control once the blend duration completes.
methods.~RagdollAnimation: Destructor for the `RagdollAnimation` object. Releases any dynamically allocated memory, particularly track channels, and cleans up standard string buffers.

properties.animating: Whether ragdoll-to-keyframe blend is actively interpolating.
properties.targetAnimationName: Target recovery animation clip name (e.g. get up from ground).

RainCollectorBuilding.description: Specialized ProductionBuilding that passively collects water from rainfall at a rate determined by local weather conditions.

methods.calculateEfficiencyMult: Calculates and returns the water collection efficiency multiplier based on current rainfall.
methods.getGUIState: Populates the specified DatapanelGUI category with rain collector status and efficiency info.
methods.getGUIToolTipForGroundResourceEfficiency: Populates the provided Lektor<StringPair> container with tooltip lines describing rainfall collection efficiency.
methods.getRainAmount: Returns the current rainfall intensity at the building's location.

RangedCombatClass.description: Ballistic weapon controller governing personal crossbows and mounted defensive turrets. Manages predictive target leading (`getAimPos`), friendly-fire raycast clearances (`takeTheShotCheck`), ammunition consumption and reloading cycles (`reloadCheck`), elevation range multipliers (`getGunRange`), and targeting priority arbitration (`scoreTarget`).

methods.RangedCombatClass: Constructs the `RangedCombatClass` controller, binding owner character reference, initializing state machine variables, and creating the bad-target cache.
methods._getAttackTarget: Returns the persistent handle of the currently engaged opponent.
methods.aimAtTarget: Calculates rotational yaw and pitch angles toward target coordinates, slewing turret swivel joint or rotating character root motion.
methods.animationUpdate: Updates skeletal spine and arm pitch/yaw animation tracks to point weapon muzzle accurately toward target coordinates.
methods.chooseNewTarget: Evaluates available perceived targets, ranking hostile entities by proximity, armor coverage, and friendly fire hazards.
methods.end: Terminates active ranged combat mode, dropping target locks, clearing aiming positions, and resetting combat animation stances to idle.
methods.getAimPos: Calculates predictive aim position leading the moving target based on projectile flight velocity and target movement vector.
methods.getGun: Returns the active `GunClass` projectile weapon controller.
methods.getGunRange: Calculates maximum range taking into account vertical elevation differences between weapon barrel and target.
methods.isInRange: Tests whether the given position falls within maximum weapon range, incorporating height bonus scaling.
methods.isInRangedCombatMode: Returns whether the controller is actively engaged in ranged combat stance.
methods.printGUIState: Outputs current aim percentage, reload progress, and ammunition readout strings into HUD datapanel widgets.
methods.reAssessTargeting: Resolves valid live target character from primary or secondary candidate handles, falling back to cached target if still active.
methods.reloadCheck: Verifies ammunition supply in character inventory, consumes bolts/charges, and initializes reload countdown timer based on weapon reload rate.
methods.resetShotTimer: Resets aim stability timer back to base threshold ($0.4\text{ s}$) following shot discharge.
methods.scoreTarget: Computes aggregate tactical priority score for candidate target, balancing range, health fraction, and ally engagement.
methods.scoreTargetRange: Calculates normalized proximity score ($0.0$ to $1.0$) between weapon and target, returning zero if closer than `minRange`.
methods.setState: Transitions the controller into a new `RangedState` (`SHOOTING`, `MOVING`, `RELOADING`, `WAITING`, `THINKING`), resetting phase timers.
methods.setTarget: Sets `currentTarget` handle and coordinates mutual engagement state.
methods.setup: Configures ranged weapon operation mode, binding stationary turret building or equipping mobile crossbow controller with governing skill enum.
methods.takeTheShotCheck: Performs ballistic raycast from muzzle to target, detecting whether line of fire is obstructed by static terrain, architecture, or friendly squadmates.
methods.traceHitFurtherThanTarget: Verifies whether raycast intersection occurred beyond target point, indicating target is not obstructed.
methods.updateMT: Mobile crossbow frame update tick. Handles reload animations, movement constraints, aim stabilization, and projectile release.
methods.updateT: Turret frame update tick. Re-assesses target locks, rotates turret barrel towards aim coordinates, evaluates line-of-fire clearance, and triggers projectile firing.

properties._isReloading: Flag indicating character is currently engaged in reloading animation.
properties._lastAimAheadAmount: Calculated lead distance offset applied to target coordinates based on linear velocity.
properties.aimTimer: Accumulated aim focus duration in seconds; stabilizes shot accuracy toward 100%.
properties.badTargetRememberer: Memory cache of invalid, obstructed, or out-of-range targets preventing query thrashing.
properties.combatMode: Master toggle indicating active engagement in ranged combat stance.
properties.currentAimPos: Cartesian coordinates in engine world units representing current aiming focal point.
properties.currentTarget: Persistent entity handle referencing targeted opponent.
properties.gun: Pointer to active ballistic firearm controller handling muzzle physics, spread, and bolts.
properties.me: Owning character entity operating the crossbow or turret.
properties.reloadTimer: Current elapsed reload progress countdown in seconds.
properties.reloadTimerMax: Total required duration in seconds for current reload cycle, scaled by skill and weapon tier.
properties.stateTimer: Elapsed simulation duration in seconds within active `RangedState`.
properties.takeAShotMsg: Signal to trigger projectile launch on the next motor or animation tick.
properties.turret: Handle referencing mounted turret building entity when manning stationary defenses.
properties.updateNeededMsg: Dirty flag requesting animation re-evaluation on next frame.

RelationData.description: Stores diplomatic relation state, trust values, perceived strength, and treaty/war flags between two factions (wrapping `FactionRelations::RelationData`).

methods.load: Loads this relation data entry from `gamestate_faction` (`GameData`) under key `ID` for faction `who` (`Faction`).
methods.operator_assign: Copies all fields from another `RelationData` instance into this instance and returns self.
methods.save: Saves this relation data entry into `factionsList` (`GameData`) under key `ID` for faction `who` (`Faction`).

properties.alliance: Whether a formal alliance is active with the target faction.
properties.coexists: Whether this faction peacefully coexists with the target faction.
properties.peaceTreaty: Whether a peace treaty is active with the target faction.
properties.percievedStrength: Perceived military strength rating of the target faction.
properties.relation: Numeric relation score with the target faction (typically -100 to 100).
properties.trustNegatives: Accumulated negative trust score toward the target faction.
properties.trustPositives: Accumulated positive trust score toward the target faction.
properties.war: Whether open war is active with the target faction.

RepetitionCounter.description: Tracks how many times and how recently each `EventTriggerEnum` dialogue event has been triggered for a `Dialogue` instance (wrapping `Dialogue::RepetitionCounter`).

methods.count: Increments the trigger counter for the specified `EventTriggerEnum` (`ev`) and returns true.
methods.getCount: Returns the current trigger count for the specified `EventTriggerEnum` (`ev`), resetting it first if the reset interval has elapsed.
methods.getTimeSinceLastTrigger: Returns the elapsed game time since the specified `EventTriggerEnum` (`ev`) was last triggered.
methods.setup: Initializes the repetition counter's event state map with default reset times.

ResearchBuilding.description: Specialized UseableStuff building representing a research bench where characters conduct technology research and store research artifacts.

methods.createInventoryLayout: Creates and returns the ResearchBuildingInventoryLayout for the bench's inventory window.
methods.dontNeedWorkRightNow: Returns true if no technology is currently queued for research or if required research materials are missing.
methods.getDefaultTask: Returns the default TaskType enum value (researching) for characters assigned to this bench.
methods.getGUIData: Populates the specified DatapanelGUI category with research bench status, tech level, and UI controls.
methods.getTechLevel: Returns the maximum technology level supported by this research bench.

methods.showResearchWindow: Opens the faction research screen in response to a MyGUI.Widget button event.
methods.update: Performs per-frame updates for the research building.

ResearchBuildingInventoryLayout.description: Inventory GUI layout controller for research benches, integrating the research progress button and tech tree access.

methods.getResearchButton: Returns the MyGUI Button widget that opens the research tech tree window.
methods.setupSections: Sets up the inventory UI sections and research button for a research building using an InventoryGUI and Inventory.

methods.destroy: Stops background loading threads and cleans up resource queues.

RobotLimbItem.description: A specialized `Gear` subclass that represents equippable robotic limb replacements. It handles tracking specific limb condition (damage, wear) and computing character stat multipliers (e.g. stealth, athletics, strength) based on the tier and type of the limb.

methods.RobotLimbItem: Constructs a new `RobotLimbItem` instance. Initializes damage properties to zero and calculates limb-specific properties based on base data and material.
methods._loadFromSerialise: Deserializes and loads the item state from a `GameData` structure.
methods._serialise: Serializes the robotic limb item's state to a `GameData` instance.
methods.getCraftTime: Retrieves the base time required to craft this robot limb item.
methods.getStatMult: Retrieves the multiplier for a specific character stat provided by this robotic limb.
methods.getTooltipData1: Populates primary tooltip strings displaying item statistics, effects, and multipliers for robotic limbs.
methods.getTooltipData2: Populates secondary tooltip strings, generally appending flavor text and item descriptions.
methods.~RobotLimbItem: Destroys the `RobotLimbItem` instance. Cleans up any resources and calls the base `Gear` destructor.

properties.maxHP: Maximum structural hit points of the limb.
properties.statMults: Cached map of stat multipliers provided by this limb.
properties.unarmedDamage: Bonus damage applied to unarmed attacks.
properties.wearDamage: Wear and tear degradation over time.

RobotLimbs.description: Prosthetic robotics manager coordinating replacement limb sockets, prosthetic item equipment, health states, and inventory UI bindings.

methods.destroyInventoryInterface: Destroys the robotic limbs inventory interface container.
methods.getInventoryInterface: Retrieves or creates the prosthetic inventory container interface (`RootObject*`) allowing robotic limbs to be equipped.

methods.save: Writes equipped prosthetic items and limb states to savegame `GameData`.
methods.setLimb: Assigns the state and equipped prosthetic item for the specified limb slot.

properties.character: Pointer to the Character who owns this RobotLimbs subsystem.
