RootObject.description: Polymorphic foundation for all physical and interactive world entities (`Character`, `Building`, `Item`). Encapsulates spatial orientation quaternion, interior building containment (`hand`), floor slice indexing, town wall containment checks, spatial partitioning hash keys, and delegation hooks for inventory transactions, sensory awareness, and combat reactions.

methods.ImStealingDoYouNotice: Evaluates sensory awareness to determine if this entity notices a pickpocketing theft attempt in progress.
methods.RootObject: Primary constructor for `RootObject`. Invokes `RootObjectBase` constructor to initialize object handle, template FCS data record (`GameData`), and owner faction. Initializes interior building handle, floor slice level (0), spatial partition key, and identity rotation quaternion.
methods.amInsideTownWalls: Returns the town wall containment status. If `isInsideTownWalls` is negative, queries the containing building structure or settlement territory to determine defensive perimeter status.
methods.createInventoryLayout: Factory method constructing the specialized `InventoryLayout` widget definition used to render this entity's inventory window.
methods.createPhysical: Creates the physical actors and scene representation for this object, returning true on success.
methods.destroyPhysical: Destroys the physical actors and scene representation for this object.
methods.dropItem: Drops an item from the entity's inventory into the world at its current spatial position.
methods.equipItem: Equips an item into the named equipment slot on the entity.
methods.getAABB: Retrieves the world-space axis-aligned bounding box (`Ogre::Aabb`) enclosing the entity's physical geometry.
methods.getFloor: Retrieves the interior floor level currently occupied by the entity (0 = ground floor, 1 = first floor, etc.).
methods.getGUIData: Populates the specified `DatapanelGUI` sidebar with categorized attributes, stats, condition bars, and description text for this entity.
methods.getGUIDataCategories: Fills an output list with available datapanel tab categories supported by this entity.
methods.getInstanceID: Retrieves the persistent instance identifier record (`InstanceID*`) corresponding to this object's world placement.
methods.getIntendedAggression: Queries the current intended combat aggression scalar for this entity.
methods.getInventory: Resolves and returns the primary `Inventory` component instance attached to this entity.
methods.getLayoutInstanceID: Retrieves the layout instance string identifier used for building interior items and modular architectural furniture.
methods.getMoney: Retrieves the amount of currency (Cats) held by this entity or its faction treasury.
methods.getOrders: Retrieves the list of active GOAP tasks and permanent job orders assigned to this entity.
methods.getOrientation: Retrieves the rotational orientation quaternion (`rot`) of the entity in 3D world space.
methods.getPlatoonAI: Retrieves the tactical platoon AI controller (`PlatoonAI*`) governing squad coordination for this entity.
methods.getRace: Retrieves the biological race data record (`RaceData*`) for the entity.
methods.getVisible: Queries whether the entity's visual scene nodes and meshes are currently visible in the rendering pipeline.
methods.getZoneMapLocation: Resolves the geographical `ZoneMap` grid cell containing this entity by querying its parent container or spatial coordinate.
methods.giveItem: Deposits an item into the entity's inventory. If inventory space is exhausted, drops the item onto the ground if `dropOnFail` is true, or deletes it if `destroyOnFail` is true.
methods.hasItem: Checks whether the entity currently possesses an item matching the specified FCS template record in its inventory or equipped slots.
methods.hasRoomForItem: Checks whether the entity's inventory has sufficient vacant grid slots to accommodate an item instantiated from the specified FCS template record.
methods.hitByMeleeAttack: Combat melee impact resolution hook invoked when a melee attack strikes this entity. Determines impact audio material, applies damage calculations, and initiates defensive reactions.
methods.isDisabled: Queries whether the object is in a disabled or dormant state, skipping physics and AI simulation.
methods.isIndoors: Retrieves the handle of the building structure this object currently resides within (`isInsideBuilding`).
methods.isOnARoof: Queries whether the entity is located on an open-air building rooftop rather than an enclosed interior floor.
methods.isPhysical: Returns true if the object currently has active physical representation in the world.
methods.loadUnloadCheck: Zone streaming evaluation method. Checks distance between the entity and active player platoons or loaded zone boundaries, managing transitions between active reality and serialized disk storage.
methods.needsSaving: Queries whether this entity has modified runtime state requiring persistence into the active savegame file or mod layer.
methods.notifyEffect: Dispatches environmental and weather effect notifications (e.g. acid rain, duststorms, burning sunlight, toxic gas) to the entity.
methods.notifyIndoors: Notification handler triggered when the entity crosses from the open world into an interior building space.
methods.notifyOutdoors: Notification handler triggered when the entity exits an interior building space back into the outdoor world.
methods.periodicUpdate: Periodic low-frequency update tick. Invokes `loadUnloadCheck` to evaluate distance to the camera and player platoons for zone streaming management.
methods.say: Spawns a floating speech bubble or dialogue line over the entity in the world view.
methods.select: Invoked when this entity becomes selected by the player in the viewport, enabling HUD selection circles and datapanels.
methods.setFaction: Updates entity faction alignment and re-assigns active platoon membership, synchronizing diplomatic relationship status and ownership tables.
methods.setFloor: Sets the interior floor level currently occupied by the entity.
methods.setInsideTownWalls: Sets the cached town wall containment state identifier.
methods.setIsInsideBuilding: Updates the interior building residence handle (`isInsideBuilding`) and resets the outdoor delay notification timer.
methods.setStandingOrder: Applies a persistent standing combat order (e.g. Hold, Passive, Block, Ranged, Medic, Taunt) to the entity.
methods.setVisible: Sets the rendering visibility state of this object.
methods.stolenGoodsDetectionCheck: Performs a recognition check to determine if this entity identifies a stolen item being sold or transferred.
methods.takeMoney: Deducts a specified amount of currency (Cats) from the entity's funds or faction treasury.
methods.threadedUpdate: Threaded background simulation update hook. Allows physics, sensory perception, and animation evaluation across worker threads.
methods.unequipItem: Unequips an item from the specified equipment slot, moving it back to the main inventory grid.
methods.unselect: Invoked when the player deselects this entity, disabling selection highlights and clearing inspection panels.
methods.update: Standard per-frame logic update tick. RootObject base implementation serves as a polymorphic virtual hook overridden by derived entities (`Character`, `Building`, `Item`).
methods.~RootObject: Virtual destructor unhooking the entity from its parent container (`RootObjectContainer`), releasing interior spatial linkages, clearing spatial hash keys, and destroying base object resources.

properties._base_state: Inherited position vector, persistent handle, faction, and display name fields.
properties.container: Pointer to owning spatial or gameplay container.
properties.floorNum: Zero-indexed interior floor level currently occupied (0 = ground floor).
properties.isInsideBuilding: Entity handle of building structure object currently resides within.
properties.isInsideTownWalls: Cached town wall defensive perimeter flag (-1 = outside, zone ID if inside).
properties.outdoorDelayNotification_timer: Cooldown tick counter preventing rapid jitter when crossing doorway thresholds.
properties.rot: Rotational orientation quaternion in 3D world space (w, x, y, z).
properties.spacialKey: Spatial hashing partition key used for fast proximity and physics grid lookups.

RootObjectBase.description: Abstract base class for all addressable world entities and platoons in Kenshi, storing identity, handle, GameData template, faction owner, and world position.

methods.getCurrentTownLocation: Returns the TownBase that this object is currently located in, or nil if outside any town.
methods.getDataType: Returns the itemType enum identifying the runtime category of this object.
methods.getFaction: Returns the Faction that owns this object.
methods.getFloor: Returns the interior building floor index this object is currently on.
methods.getGameData: Returns the GameData template associated with this object.
methods.getHandle: Returns the unique hand handle identifying this object.
methods.getMovementDirection: Returns the current movement direction vector of this object as a Vector3 table.
methods.getMovementSpeed: Returns the current movement speed of this object.
methods.getName: Returns the display name of this object.
methods.getOwnerships: Returns the Ownerships component associated with this object, or nil if none.
methods.getPosition: Returns the current world position of this object as a Vector3 table {x, y, z}.
methods.getPositionForWaypoint: Returns the target waypoint Vector3 position for approaching this object from the given Vector3 origin.
methods.getSensoryData: Returns the SensoryData component for this object, or nil if not applicable.
methods.getStateBroadcast: Returns a raw pointer (lightuserdata) to this object's StateBroadcastData, or nil if not applicable.
methods.hasFaction: Returns true if this object belongs to a valid Faction.
methods.isUnconcious: Returns true if this object (character or platoon) is currently unconscious.
methods.isValid: Returns true if this object's validKey matches the engine's valid object key.
methods.loadFromSerialise: Restores this object's state from the provided GameSaveState.
methods.serialise: Serializes this object into a new GameSaveState using the given GameDataContainer, reference GameData, and PosRotPair offset (lightuserdata).
methods.setFaction: Assigns this object to the specified Faction and ActivePlatoon.
methods.setHandle: Sets the unique hand handle for this object.
methods.setName: Sets the display name of this object.
methods.typeIsAnItem: Returns true if this object's data type represents an inventory or world item.

properties.data: The GameData template defining this object's base stats and properties.
properties.displayName: The current in-game display name of this object.
properties.handle: The unique hand handle identifying this object across the engine.
properties.owner: The Faction that owns this object.
properties.pos: The world-space position of this object as a Vector3 table {x, y, z}.
properties.validKey: Internal magic integer used to verify that the object pointer is still valid.

RootObjectContainer.description: A DataObjectContainer subclass that manages a collection of active in-world RootObject instances (such as a platoon's members or a zone's active objects).

methods.addActiveObject: Adds an active RootObject to this container and returns true if added.
methods.getNumThings: Returns the number of active RootObject instances currently in this container.
methods.getSelectedObjects: Appends objects from this container matching the given itemType (and optionally only selected ones) into the provided lektor<RootObject*> out-parameter.
methods.getThing: Returns the RootObject at the specified index in the things list.
methods.getThings: Returns a pointer to the internal lektor<RootObject*> holding this container's objects.
methods.loadInstance: Instantiates a single object from a GameSaveState into the world at the specified position and rotation.
methods.loadToReality: Instantiates saved objects from this container into the active world with optional position/rotation offsets, FactoryCallbackInterface, specific SID filter, external GameDataContainer, and SpecificItemLoadFirst filter.
methods.removeObject: Removes the specified RootObject from this container and returns true if removed.
methods.serialiseThings: Serializes either a provided lektor<RootObject*> or all objects in this container into the given instance collection GameData and GameDataContainer, applying an optional PosRotPair offset (lightuserdata) and mod name.
methods.update: Updates the active objects in this container and returns true if active.

properties.things: The lektor<RootObject*> list of active RootObject instances stored in this container.

RootObjectFactory.description: Factory responsible for spawning and constructing world entities (characters, squads, buildings, items, and location nodes) from GameData templates and save states. Accessible via the global GameWorld objectFactory or ou.factory.

methods._chooseClothingItemFromList: Static helper (callable on the class table or an instance) that selects and returns a single clothing GameData for a specific AttachSlot and RaceData.
methods.chooseDataFromList: Randomly selects and returns a weighted GameData entry from a named reference list on dataList matching materialDataType and value index.
methods.chooseDataFromListWithVals: Randomly selects and returns a GameDataReference entry (including its triple integer values) from a named list on dataList.
methods.chooseMyClothing: Static method (callable on the class table or an instance) that populates a lektor<GameData*> with clothing items chosen from a named list on dataList for the given RaceData.
methods.copyItem: Creates and returns a duplicate Item cloned from the specified Item.
methods.create: Queues or creates a RootObjectBase from a GameData template at the given Vector3 position and Quaternion rotation, with optional level-mod flag, Faction owner, FactoryCallbackInterface, RootObjectContainer, GameSaveState, invisibility flag, home Building, and age.
methods.createBuilding: Constructs and returns a new Building from the given GameData template, position, TownBase, Faction owner, rotation, callback, layout/door/indoor parent links, save state, and floor/foliage flags.
methods.createCharacterForBuilding: Spawns the resident character(s) associated with the specified Building.
methods.createItem: Creates and returns an Item either from a single item-state GameData (1 argument) or from a template GameData, optional hand (or nil for a new handle), weapon mesh GameData, material GameData, level override, and uniform Faction (5-6 arguments).
methods.createLocationNode: Creates a LocationNode from a GameData template at the specified position and rotation and returns it as lightuserdata.
methods.createRandomCharacter: Spawns and returns a new Character (as a RootObject) for the given Faction at position, using an optional container, character template GameData, home Building, and age.
methods.createRandomSquad: Creates and returns an active Platoon populated from a squad template GameData at the specified position, town, building, and biome group.
methods.createRandomUnloadedCharacter: Creates a serialized GameSaveState for a random unloaded character in an UnloadedPlatoon (lightuserdata) from a character template GameData.
methods.createRandomUnloadedSquad: Creates and returns an unloaded Platoon from a squad template GameData at the specified position, town, building, and biome group.
methods.getValsFromDataInList: Looks up itemInList within the named reference list on dataList and returns its TripleInt values.
methods.mainThreadUpdate: Processes queued object creation requests on the main thread.
methods.populateBuilding: Populates the specified Building with its interior furniture, items, and occupants.
methods.process: Processes a single queued CreatelistItem and returns the created RootObjectBase.

properties.todoList: Queue (std::deque<CreatelistItem*>) of pending object creation requests awaiting processing.

RotatingEnt.description: Represents a rotating physical component of a building or machine, such as a windmill rotor or aiming turret.

methods.getRotationPower: Returns the current normalized rotation power or output factor.
methods.isRotatingEnt: Returns whether this entity is a rotating entity (always returns true for RotatingEnt).
methods.update: Updates rotation progression and angular position based on production or operation speed.
methods.updateAim: Updates rotational aiming towards the target 3D position at the specified angular speed and returns the remaining aim angle.

properties.isRotating: Boolean flag indicating whether the entity is currently rotating.
properties.rotAxis: 3D axis vector around which the entity rotates.
properties.rotatingTime: Current elapsed time within the active rotation cycle or interpolation.
properties.rotationBase: Base orientation quaternion of the rotating entity.
properties.rotationDst: Target destination orientation quaternion during rotation interpolation.
properties.rotationDuration: Duration of the current rotation interpolation.
properties.rotationPower: Current rotation power multiplier or generated energy ratio.
properties.rotationSpeed: Angular velocity or rotation speed in radians per second.
properties.rotationSrc: Starting source orientation quaternion during rotation interpolation.
properties.windSpeedRotationDanger: Wind speed threshold above which the rotor risks damage or shuts down.
properties.windSpeedRotationMax: Wind speed at which maximum rotational output is achieved.
properties.windSpeedRotationMin: Minimum wind speed required to begin rotor rotation.

SaveFileSystem.description: Low-level filesystem staging engine managing directory layouts, zip archive streaming, atomic file replacement, and slot enumeration.

methods.addMessage: Enqueues an asynchronous file operation message (copy, copy-replace, or delete) between source and destination paths.
methods.analyse: Inspects the active save directory and files to evaluate directory layout and schedule required copy or deletion operations.
methods.busy: Returns true if the background save worker thread is actively writing files or performing disk I/O.
methods.cleanup: Removes temporary files and staged save folders created during saving, optionally purging all working directories if full is true.
methods.createCurrent: Creates and initializes the active working save directory for new game save data.
methods.deleteFile: Marks a file within the save file system as deleted and queues its physical removal from disk.
methods.fileExists: Checks whether the specified save file exists within the active save file system or temporary working directory.
methods.getActiveSave: Returns the name or directory path of the currently loaded savegame folder.
methods.getSingleton: Returns the singleton `SaveFileSystem` instance managing save directories and asynchronous file operations.
methods.isTempFolder: Checks whether the specified directory path is an internal temporary staging folder used during saving.
methods.loadGame: Initiates loading game world data, platoons, and zone state from the specified save directory path.
methods.log: Writes a diagnostic message with the given severity level to the save file system log file.
methods.newGame: Resets save file system paths and active directory state when starting a new game session.
methods.readFile: Resolves the absolute disk path for reading the specified save file from the current save or base directory.
methods.saveGame: Initiates saving current game world state and zone modifications to the specified save directory path.
methods.scanForResidualTempFolders: Scans save directories for leftover temporary folders from interrupted save operations and marks them for cleanup.
methods.setTemporaryPath: Configures the base directory path used for temporary save staging.
methods.sync: Blocks execution until the background save worker thread has finished all queued file operations.
methods.threadProc: Worker thread procedure executing queued asynchronous file copy, replace, and deletion operations on disk.
methods.writeFile: Resolves and prepares the destination file path in the active temporary save directory for writing.
methods.~SaveFileSystem: Destructs the `SaveFileSystem` instance and releases allocated resources.

properties.currentFolder: Filesystem path of the active current-game working directory.
properties.currentMutex: Shared mutex synchronizing access to the active save file table and paths.
properties.currentPathIndex: Alternating index used to select the next temporary current-save directory.
properties.currentSave: Name or path of the currently loaded savegame.
properties.discoveredSaveSlots: List of valid save folder names detected on disk.
properties.failedToCopyError: Error message string recorded if a background file copy operation fails.
properties.fileCrcTable: Checksum validation table for saved chunks.
properties.ioThreadHandle: Thread handle for background file compression and streaming.
properties.ioWorkerActive: Background IO thread running state flag.
properties.lastStagedFile: Path of the most recently written disk asset.
properties.rootSaveDirectory: Base directory path containing all savegame slots.
properties.savingIcon: Pointer to the MyGUI ImageBox widget displayed while saving is in progress.
properties.state: Current background save worker state (SaveFileSystem::State: NORMAL, SAVING, or COMPLETE).
properties.tempFolder: Base directory path used for temporary zone and save files.
properties.tempStagingDirectory: Scratch directory for atomic double-buffered saves.
properties.totalBytesExpected: Target byte count expected for active serialization.
properties.totalBytesWritten: Cumulative byte count transferred during active save.

SaveFileSystem_FileMessage.description: File operation message describing a pending copy, replace, or delete action in the save file system.

methods.operator_assign: Assignment operator copying fields from another FileMessage and returning self.
methods.operator_eq: Equality comparison operator returning true if both file messages have identical mode, source, and destination.

properties.dest: Destination file path string for the file operation.
properties.mode: SaveFileSystem::MessageType integer specifying the action (e.g. copy, replace, or delete).
properties.source: Source file path string for the file operation.

SaveInfo.description: Holds save file header metadata (playthrough name, playtime, money, faction, location, and game rules) displayed in save/load screens.

methods.operator_assign: Copies save metadata fields from another SaveInfo instance.
methods.operator_eq: Compares two SaveInfo structs for equality.

properties.advanced: GameplayOptions struct storing custom difficulty and game rule settings.
properties.area: General world zone or territory name where the game was saved.
properties.days: In-game elapsed day count since the start of the playthrough.
properties.location: Specific town or outpost name where the player was located.
properties.money: Total Cats currency held by the player faction.
properties.name: Save slot or folder name string.
properties.size: Total number of characters belonging to the player faction.
properties.time: Real-world 64-bit integer timestamp when the save file was written.
properties.version: Game version string recorded when saving.

SaveManager.description: Master game state serialization, session persistence, and savegame management singleton in Kenshi. Manages save directories (`localSavePath`, `userSavePath`), active save slot metadata (`currentGame`), save/load/import modal dialog windows (`loadMenu`, `saveMenu`, `importMenu`), automated background save intervals (`autoSaveTimer`), version validation (`checkVersion`, `versionCode`), low-level world state serialization (`saveGame`, `loadGame`), and cross-version asset import filters (`importGame`, `importPlayerBuildings`).

methods.SaveManager: Private constructor for `SaveManager`. Initializes string buffers for save paths and current session, resets state signaling flags (`signal = 0`, `delay = 0`), zeroes the autosave countdown timer (`autoSaveTimer`), and unbinds GUI menu dialog pointers.
methods.checkVersion: Validates version compatibility of savegame `info` against current engine version, detecting whether migration or warnings are required.
methods.execute: Processes queued save, load, new game, or import operations and updates transition timers.
methods.getCurrentGame: Returns the name or folder identifier of the currently loaded active game session (`currentGame`).
methods.getSavePath: Returns the active filesystem directory path currently configured for saving and loading games.
methods.getSingleton: Retrieves the global singleton instance of `SaveManager`. Lazily allocates the instance on first invocation via Ogre general allocator if uninitialized.
methods.hide: Closes and hides all active save, load, and import modal GUI windows, returning focus to the primary game viewport.
methods.import: Enqueues a game import operation from save slot `s` using configuration bitmask `_flags` (`IMPORT_BUILDINGS`, `IMPORT_RESEARCH`, `IMPORT_NPC_STATES`, etc.). Sets pending signal `IMPORTGAME`.
methods.importGame: Low-level core import implementation. Re-initializes a fresh base game world and merges player squads, buildings, research, relations, and NPC death states from source save `location/name` according to filter `flags`.
methods.importOldPlayerBuildings: Legacy import routine migrating player-constructed buildings and outposts from older Kenshi save formats into current structure definitions.
methods.importPlayerBuildings: Imports player-owned buildings, outposts, and interior furniture placements from modern serialized building records (`path/file`).
methods.initialisePaths: Discovers and initializes filesystem directories for local game installation saves (`localSavePath`) and user AppData profile saves (`userSavePath`), establishing directory permissions and fallback paths.
methods.isVisible: Queries whether any save, load, or import modal GUI window is currently open and visible on screen.
methods.load: Enqueues a game load operation from descriptor `s`, with an option to reset all squad member positions to camera focus point. Sets pending signal `LOADGAME`.
methods.loadGame: Low-level core load implementation. Clears existing world state, resets zones and platoons, deserializes game objects, and instantiates character entities from `location/name`.
methods.loadInfo: Reads and parses save header files (`info.dat` / `quick.save`) into `SaveInfo& info`, extracting game time, squad size, money, and mod dependencies.
methods.newGame: Signals the engine to begin a new game session using scenario identifier `startId`. Sets pending signal `NEWGAME` and arms execution delay timer.
methods.save: Enqueues a game save operation targeting slot name `s`. If `autosave` is true, applies rotating autosave slot indexing. Sets pending signal `SAVEGAME`.
methods.saveExists: Checks if a specific savegame slot `name` exists within filesystem path `location`.
methods.saveGame: Low-level core save implementation. Serializes active world data, zone states, platoons, player buildings, research, faction relations, and camera transforms to `location/name`.
methods.savesExist: Fast query checking whether any saved game directories exist in the local or user save directories.
methods.scanGames: Scans the default active save directory, populating `list` with `SaveInfo` descriptors for all discovered save slots.
methods.showImport: Constructs and displays the modal Import Game GUI dialog window (`importMenu`), allowing player selection of import flags and source save files.
methods.showLoad: Constructs and displays the modal Load Game GUI dialog window (`loadMenu`), scanning available saves and rendering save slot cards.
methods.showSave: Constructs (if necessary) and displays the modal Save Game GUI dialog window (`saveMenu`), populating current slot suggestions and screenshot previews.
methods.updateAutoSave: Per-frame tick updating the autosave timer. When the elapsed interval exceeds user configured settings (and autosave is unpaused), automatically triggers a rotating autosave.
methods.versionCode: Parses a semantic version string (e.g. "1.0.65") into a packed 32-bit integer version code suitable for numerical comparison.
methods.~SaveManager: Private destructor for `SaveManager`. Closes and destroys active GUI modal dialog windows (`loadMenu`, `saveMenu`, `importMenu`), flushes path buffers, and deallocates base Ogre memory.

properties.autoSaveTimer: Elapsed time counter tracking autosave trigger intervals.
properties.currentGame: Directory or slot identifier of currently active game session.
properties.delay: Frame delay countdown before scheduled save/load operation executes.
properties.importMenu: Modal GUI dialog for configuring import options and starting game imports.
properties.loadMenu: Modal GUI dialog for browsing and loading saved games.
properties.localSavePath: Base directory path for local saves within application install.
properties.location: Directory path containing target savegame slot.
properties.name: Target save slot filename or new game scenario name.
properties.pauseAutoSaveTimer: Flag suppressing autosave timer countdown during menus or dialogue.
properties.saveMenu: Modal GUI dialog for naming and saving current game state.
properties.saveVersion: Version string token recorded in save file headers.
properties.userSavePath: User profile appdata savegame directory path.

ScreenLabel.description: Floating 2D screen-space text label anchored to a 3D world position or tracked entity, used for overhead damage numbers, speech, and status alerts.

methods.destroy: Destroys the label and cleans up its GUI widgets.
methods.setCaption: Sets the string text caption displayed by this label.
methods.setPosition: Sets the static 3D world position (Vector3) for the label when not tracking an object.
methods.setRisingSpeed: Sets the RisingSpeed rate at which the floating label rises upward.
methods.setTracking: Anchors this label to track the specified hand object handle with a Vector3 3D offset.
methods.update: Updates the screen position projection and vertical rising animation of the label.

properties.caption: The text caption displayed by this label.
properties.destroyed: Whether this label has been marked as destroyed.
properties.risingHeight: Accumulated vertical height offset as the label floats upward.
properties.textWidget: The MyGUI::TextBox widget displaying the text.
properties.trackingHandle: The hand handle of the object being tracked by this label.
properties.trackingOffset: The Vector3 offset applied to the tracked object's position.

ScreenLabelDebug.description: On-screen debug text label floating in world space with an expiration timer.

methods.getCaption: Returns the text caption string displayed by this debug label.
methods.update: Decrements the remaining display timer and updates on-screen label position.

properties.timeLeft: Remaining duration in seconds before this debug label expires and disappears.

ScreenLabelInterface.description: Base interface for 3D world-space anchored GUI labels and overhead indicators.

methods.setPosition: Updates the 3D world-space position (Vector3) of the label anchor.
methods.setVisible: Sets label visibility to the specified boolean state.
methods.update: Updates screen-space projection coordinates and visibility from the 3D world position.

properties.needUpdate: Whether screen-space coordinates must be recomputed on the next update.
properties.position: The 3D world-space anchor position (Vector3) of the screen label.
properties.visible: Whether this screen label is currently visible on screen.

SectionItem.description: Inventory grid cell descriptor associating an Item with its grid coordinate position and slot footprint.

properties.h: Height of the item footprint in inventory grid cells.
properties.item: The Item instance placed at this grid location.
properties.w: Width of the item footprint in inventory grid cells.
properties.x: Horizontal grid column coordinate where the item is placed.
properties.y: Vertical grid row coordinate where the item is placed.

SeenSomeone.description: Per-target sensory record stored in SensoryData describing a perceived character's last known position, timestamp, perceived faction, and classification flags.

methods.getFaction: Returns the character's percievedFaction (taking disguises into account).
methods.getPosition: Returns the character's current position (Vector3 table) if currently visible, or lastPosition if out of sight.
methods.lastSeenInSeconds: Returns the elapsed in-game time in seconds since this character was last seen.

properties.FOVScore: Field-of-view visibility score computed during the last vision check.
properties.alarmState: Alarm/hostility level associated with this perceived character.
properties.canHear: Whether the observer currently hears the target.
properties.canSee: Whether the observer currently has line of sight to the target.
properties.lastPosition: Last known world position (Vector3 table) where the target was seen or heard.
properties.lastSeenTime: In-game TimeOfDay timestamp when the target was last perceived.
properties.percievedFaction: Faction the observer believes the target belongs to (may reflect a disguise).
properties.percievedSlave: SlaveStateEnum status the observer perceives for the target.
properties.type: Bitmask of SenseFlags (ALLY, ENEMY, NEUTRAL, CONSCIOUS, CAGED, etc.) classifying this target.

SelectionBox.description: Manages 2D screen-space drag selection boxes, projecting the selection rectangle into a 3D frustum volume to select world units.

methods.cancel: Cancels the active drag selection box and hides the selection rectangle.
methods.contains: Checks whether a point with radius, bounding box, or line segment lies within the 3D selection frustum volume.
methods.isActive: Returns true if a drag selection box is currently active.
methods.start: Begins a drag selection box starting from the specified 2D screen coordinate vector table.
methods.update: Updates the drag selection box dimensions using the current 2D screen coordinate vector table.

properties.active: Boolean flag indicating whether drag selection is currently active.
properties.startPos: 2D screen coordinate vector table where the selection box drag originated.
properties.volume: 3D plane-bounded volume frustum used for world object intersection queries.
properties.widget: MyGUI widget rendering the visual selection box outline on screen.

SenseItr.description: Filtered iterator over a character's SensoryData contacts matching specified SenseFlags inclusion and exclusion masks.

methods.ended: Returns true if the iterator has reached the end of the sensory map.
methods.getCharacter: Returns the current Character pointed to by the iterator, or nil if invalid.
methods.getData: Returns the SeenSomeone perception record for the current iterator entry.
methods.increment: Advances the iterator to the next perceived character matching flagsAny and flagsNot.
methods.operator_inc: Advances the iterator (++itr) and returns the iterator itself.

properties._end: Internal Boost unordered map end iterator (unsupported in Lua; accessing or setting raises an error).
properties.flagsAny: Bitmask of SenseFlags where at least one bit must match for an entry to be visited.
properties.flagsNot: Bitmask of SenseFlags that must not be present on visited entries.
properties.it: Internal Boost unordered map iterator (unsupported in Lua; accessing or setting raises an error).

SensoryData.description: Per-character perception and threat-assessment system. Tracks visible and audible characters (SeenSomeone), crime/intruder detection, stealth spotting progress, and threat levels.

methods._calculateFOVScore: Computes the field-of-view visibility score for who (Character).
methods._shareSensesCheck: Shares sensory contacts from squad leader (Character) with list (lektor<RootObject*>) over time and returns whether sharing occurred.
methods._traceLineOfSightCheck: Performs a physics raycast line-of-sight check to who (Character) and returns true if unobstructed.
methods.add: Adds or updates a SeenSomeone record for c (Character) with see and hear flags and returns it.
methods.addToThreatsAndFlockingList: Adds perceived character c to the threats and flockingList collections if applicable.
methods.amIAwareOfThisGuy: Returns true if this character is aware of who (Character), optionally requiring active sight or hearing (needToSeeOrHear).
methods.assessCrimes: Checks whether observed character c is committing a crime and updates alarm/bounty state.
methods.assessKidnapping: Checks whether observed character c is kidnapping an ally or citizen.
methods.assessNeutral: Evaluates a neutral character who for potential hostility or dialogue (inDepth enables detailed checks).
methods.buildingSpotterUpdate: Updates intruder detection for characters inside nearby buildings.
methods.canHear: Evaluates whether c (Character) is currently audible and updates see (SeenSomeone).
methods.canIHearThisGuy: Returns true if this character can currently hear who (Character).
methods.canISeeThisGuy: Returns true if this character currently has line of sight to who (Character).
methods.canISeeThisGuyDoinSneakingOrSomething: Evaluates detection progress for a sneaking or suspicious character who using FOVScore, spotting manager memory, and FOV time bounds [spotTimeMinFOV, spotTimeMaxFOV], returning a YesNoMaybe result.
methods.canSee: Evaluates whether c (Character) is currently visible and updates sees (SeenSomeone).
methods.decay: Decays old sensory memory for c (Character) when no longer perceived.
methods.dialogAssessmentUpdate: Updates sensory assessments used for dialogue triggers over frameTime (inDepth enables full scan).
methods.disguiseMods: Applies disguise detection modifiers for c (Character) at visibility score FOV and returns whether a disguise was penetrated.
methods.getCharacter: Returns the Character that owns this SensoryData instance.
methods.getDataFor: Returns the SeenSomeone perception record for who (Character), or nil if unknown.
methods.getFactionRelation: Returns the perceived faction relation toward c (RootObjectBase).
methods.getGUIData: Populates debug sensory information into panel (DatapanelGUI) under category cat.

ShopTrader.description: Merchant trade interface proxy adapter mediating retail transactions between customer characters and vendor NPCs. Wraps a vendor `Character` instance with an isolated `ShopTraderInventory` containing shop stock, synchronizing currency exchanges, vendor list restocking schedules, barter price markups, and delegating spatial queries to the shopkeeper.

methods.ShopTrader: Constructs a `ShopTrader` merchant proxy for the specified character, instantiating an isolated `ShopTraderInventory`, configuring vendor sections, and loading merchandise items from FCS vendor lists.
methods.createPhysical: Physical instantiation stub; returns `false` as proxies are purely logical interfaces.
methods.destroyPhysical: Physical teardown stub; no-op as proxies manage no physics bodies.
methods.equipItem: Equipment interface hook; retail shops do not equip merchandise items, so this is a no-op.
methods.getCurrentTownLocation: Retrieves the settlement or outpost where this merchant operates.
methods.getDataType: Returns the polymorphic data type classification (`SHOP_TRADER_CLASS` = 0x5D).
methods.getFloor: Queries current building floor level of the vendor character.
methods.getGUIData: Populates the barter interface data panel with shopkeeper title, faction affiliation, trade price markup factors, and Cat balances.
methods.getInventory: Returns the dedicated retail merchandise inventory exposed to customers during barter interactions.
methods.getMoney: Queries current money balance available for purchasing goods from the player.
methods.getOrientation: Delegates spatial orientation inquiry to the vendor character entity.
methods.getPosition: Delegates spatial position query to the vendor character entity.
methods.getTrader: Retrieves the underlying vendor `Character` entity associated with this shop.
methods.isIndoors: Queries whether the vendor character is currently located inside a building.
methods.isPhysical: Reports physical simulation status; proxies have no 3D PhysX rigid bodies and return `false`.
methods.loadFromSerialise: Deserialization hook; no-op as proxy state is regenerated from vendor lists.
methods.serialise: Serialization hook; returns an empty `GameSaveState` as merchant inventory restock is dynamically managed via the vendor character.
methods.setVisible: Visibility toggle stub; proxies possess no independent mesh and ignore visibility commands.
methods.takeMoney: Deducts currency from the vendor character's faction or personal funds during purchases.
methods.unequipItem: Unequip interface hook; retail shops do not equip merchandise items, so this is a no-op.
methods.updateInventory: Triggers periodic inventory restock evaluation on the retail inventory according to vendor list timers.
methods.~ShopTrader: Destructs the `ShopTrader` proxy, deleting the retail inventory and invoking base `RootObject` cleanup.

properties._vftable: Virtual method dispatch table pointer inherited from `RootObject`.
properties.data: Base FCS template blueprint of the merchant shopkeeper.
properties.handle: Unique serialized game entity handle assigned to this trader proxy.
properties.inventory: Dedicated retail merchandise inventory populated from vendor restocking lists.
properties.trader: Pointer to the concrete vendor character entity managing this shop.

methods.dropItem: Drops an item from the shop trader inventory into the game world.
methods.initialiseNewSection: Creates and initializes a new InventorySection grid within the shop inventory.
methods.refreshGui: Refreshes the shopkeeper trading user interface.

properties.inventories: Map associating container or character handles (hand) with their corresponding InventorySection pointers.
properties.section: Pointer to the primary ShopTraderInventorySection managing trader items.

StorageBuilding.description: Item and resource storage container managing automatic inventory sorting, hauling jobs, and material supply limits. `StorageBuilding` serves as the foundational container for resource chests, item bins, shop counters, and cross-settlement distribution stockpiles.

methods.StorageBuilding: Constructs a new `StorageBuilding` container entity in the game world, initializing storage filters, registering item type templates for weapons and armour, and establishing inventory capacity limits.
methods.canHaveSomeOfThese: Evaluates whether this container can accept the specified item. Validates structure construction completion, inventory section grid space, designated item category filters, and active capacity limits.
methods.getConsumtionItems: Retrieves a specific `ConsumptionItem` descriptor by index. Index 0 returns the primary `productionItem`, while higher indices access entries in `manyLimitItems`.
methods.getConsumtionItems_inStock: Filters all configured consumption item descriptors, appending only those that currently have physical items stocked in their designated inventory section.
methods.getCurrentProductionQuantity: Queries the number of items currently resting in this container's dedicated production inventory section.
methods.getDefaultTask: Returns the default `TaskType` assigned to characters interacting with this storage container (hauling and item withdrawal).
methods.getFunctionStuff: Returns the downcasted polymorphic pointer to this storage functional component. Overrides `Building::getFunctionStuff()`.
methods.getItemsWeWantRidOf: Populates a list of item blueprint templates currently occupying this storage container that should be evacuated or hauled elsewhere. Excludes shop counters and terminal (`endOfTheLine`) containers unless forced by player looting commands.
methods.getNumConsumtionItems: Returns the total count of distinct item consumption or capacity descriptors configured for this container.
methods.getProductionItem: Returns the primary `ConsumptionItem` tracking descriptor governing production and capacity constraints.
methods.getProductionItemData: Resolves the primary item template associated with this storage container. Returns the specific `productionItem` record if configured, or looks up the default template for categorized containers (e.g. general weapon or armour storage).
methods.getResourcesNeededBecauseEmpty: Identifies items urgently required by this container because its inventory section is currently empty or below required capacity. Emits hauling requests for logistics workers.
methods.getResourcesNeededBecauseNotFull: Identifies items that this container can still accept because it has not yet reached its maximum capacity. Used by AI hauling tasks to keep general supply bins topped off.
methods.getUseableStuff: Returns the downcasted polymorphic pointer to the `UseableStuff` base component. Overrides `Building::getUseableStuff()`.
methods.isAnyInputsEmpty: Evaluates whether any tracked input or production item slots currently contain zero items or retain room for incoming resources.
methods.isAnyInputsFull: Queries whether any tracked item category in this container has reached its maximum defined capacity limit.
methods.isProductionEmpty: Queries whether this container's inventory currently holds zero physical items.
methods.isProductionFull: Queries whether output production is stalled due to container saturation. Always returns `false` for dedicated storage containers since they do not produce output commodities.
methods.limitedByType: Queries whether this container enforces item category filtering restrictions (e.g. accepting only weapons, armour, or food rather than general items).
methods.update: Executes regular simulation update tick for this storage structure. Advances base building state and updates inventory UI capacity displays if currently open.
methods.updateInventoryWindow: Synchronizes the player's MyGUI container window with current stock levels, updating capacity text readouts and visual full indicators.
methods.~StorageBuilding: Destructs the `StorageBuilding` container, cleaning up allocated `manyLimitItems` consumption tracking records and releasing base `UseableStuff` resources.

properties._base: Inherited interactive furniture and building state.
properties.endOfTheLine: Terminal storage flag preventing automated worker retrieval during hauling passes.
properties.manyLimitItems: Multi-item capacity limit configurations for containers accepting multiple designated items.
properties.productionItem: Primary storage target descriptor tracking accepted item template, capacity, and section.
properties.specialItemTypesOnly: Filter mask restricting acceptable stored items (e.g. `ITEM`, `WEAPON`, `ARMOUR`).

Sword.description: The `Sword` class represents all melee weapons in the game, inheriting from the base `Weapon` class. It manages weapon-specific stats such as cut and blunt damage, skill modifiers, and handles tooltip generation for weapon inspection.

methods.Sword: Constructs a new `Sword` instance. Initializes the base `Weapon` class, sets up the vtable, and calls `setupStats` to calculate the final weapon damage and modifiers based on its grade and manufacturer.
methods.getClassType: Runtime type identification method returning the specific `itemType` enum for this class.
methods.getSkillModIndoors: Retrieves the indoor combat penalty or bonus for this specific weapon. Long weapons typically return a negative modifier here.
methods.getTooltipData1: Appends the primary functional stats of the weapon to the UI tooltip. This includes the weapon class, cutting and blunt damage values, armour penetration, and combat bonuses.
methods.getTooltipData2: Appends the secondary lore and flavor text to the UI tooltip. This includes the item description, the manufacturer name, and potentially the specific smith who crafted it.
methods.isSword: Runtime type identification method returning the `this` pointer cast to a `Sword` pointer.
methods.setupStats: Calculates the final damage and statistical modifiers for the weapon. It aggregates multipliers from the base item definition, the manufacturer data, and the material data, scaling them according to the weapon's grade level.
methods.~Sword: Destroys the `Sword` instance. Calls the base `Weapon` destructor and frees any allocated resources.

methods.TaskPathfinder: Constructs a new `TaskPathfinder` instance tied to a specific AI controller. Initializes all internal priority queues, lists, and node memory pools to their default empty states.
methods.addToClosed: Archives an evaluated search node into the 'closed' set, indicating its state has been fully resolved and expanded to prevent repetitive cyclical graph traversals.
methods.addToOpen: Inserts a generated search node into the priority-sorted 'open' set, staging it for future A* heuristic evaluation.
methods.cleanup: Resets the entire pathfinder state by emptying the open set, closed set, duplicates list, and deallocating all nodes in the internal memory pool. Prepares the instance for a completely fresh search run.
methods.clearSatisfiedSuccessors: Traverses backwards from a completed search branch to prune or optimize parent states whose dependency requirements are strictly satisfied by the sequence.
methods.createDeadEndNode: Generates an explicit failure boundary node to cap a search branch, signifying that no further resolution can proceed along the given path.
methods.createNode: Allocates and initializes a new search node into the pathfinder's memory pool, populated with the specific task state, target entity, and physical location requirements.
methods.duplicateNodeWasCompleted: Validates if an alternate equivalent sequence branching off a duplicate node state completed a successful search, providing plan fallback recovery.
methods.getDuplicateCount: Counts the number of equivalent states currently existing in the pathfinder's tracked memory pools to prevent cyclic infinite loops.
methods.getLowestScore: Iterates through a list of search nodes to locate and return the node with the absolute lowest heuristic cost score. Used to find the cheapest path frontier.
methods.getNextBranch: Queries the prerequisites and sub-goals of a search node to generate its child nodes, expanding the search tree backwards towards the initial world state.
methods.isAllowedDuplicates: Checks if a specific task type is explicitly permitted to exist multiple times within a single generated plan sequence (e.g. chaining multiple movement steps).
methods.meIsPlayer: Helper utility to determine if the AI agent currently executing the goal search belongs to the player's faction or is directly controlled by the player.
methods.nodeIsInList: Performs a linear scan to check if a specific node state exists within an evaluated set, primarily used for loop detection and closed set evaluation.
methods.removeFromList: Removes a specific search node pointer from the given tracked node container queue.
methods.solve: Performs an A* heuristic search backwards from a desired task to the current world state to generate a viable sequence of action nodes. Prunes dead ends, duplicates, and invalid states while maintaining priority bounds.
methods.successCheck: Evaluates a frontier node to verify if all required conditions of its state are satisfied by the current physical world state, marking the termination of a successful path search.
methods.takeBestNode: Extracts and removes the search node with the optimal heuristic score from a given list (usually the open queue) for processing.

methods.TaskRepertoire: Constructs a new `TaskRepertoire` instance. Initializes the GOAP task manager base and sets up the internal containers.

methods.isInfiniteGoal: Determines if the task is meant to loop indefinitely (e.g., patrolling, idle).

methods.isResultsComplete: Evaluates whether the intended outcomes of the task have been fully achieved. Signals the task is complete.

methods.runAction: Executes one simulation tick of this task's active motor action on the given CharBody.

methods.setLocation: Updates the target location for the task. Used to dynamically adjust destinations.
methods.startAction: Initiates the execution of the task's primary action for the given character.
methods.taskSaysItsFinished: Checks if the task itself evaluates that it has completed its objectives for the character.

Town.description: Specialized municipal settlement controller governing electrical power grids, generator output, battery storage reserves, defensive perimeter gates, public commerce policies, commodity trade price modifiers, and outpost progression tiers. Derived from `TownBase`, `Town` interacts directly with `GameData` for FCS settlement and resident records, `UseableStuff` for electrical machinery and generators, `GatewayBuilding` for perimeter access gates, `AlarmManager` for emergency alert states, `DatapanelGUI` for inspector telemetry, and `Faction` for municipal diplomatic relationships.

methods.drainBattery: Draws electrical wattage from battery storage units to cover generation deficits for an unpowered consumer building.
methods.facilitesWeHaveHere: Aggregates bitmask tags representing all functional facility types present in this settlement (e.g., weapon shop, armor shop, bakery, bar, police station).
methods.gatesAllClosed: Evaluates whether every registered gateway guarding the town perimeter is currently in a locked or shut state.

methods.getBatteryCharge: Retrieves the current aggregate stored energy accumulated across all connected battery installations.
methods.getBatteryCharge01: Computes normalized aggregate battery charge ratio from 0.0 (completely exhausted) to 1.0 (fully charged).
methods.getBatteryChargeMax: Retrieves the combined maximum energy storage capacity of all operational battery units in the town.
methods.getBatteryChargingUpAmount: Retrieves the instantaneous rate at which surplus generator wattage is charging connected battery units.
methods.getBatteryDrain: Retrieves the rate at which stored battery reserves are being drained by electrical consumers.
methods.getBatteryPowerTotal: Retrieves the total instantaneous electrical wattage supplied to the power network by discharging battery arrays.

methods.getGUIData: Populates the UI DataPanel inspector window with town telemetry, including power generation vs consumption, battery reserves, population counts, and faction control.

methods.getLocalTradePriceMult: Calculates local commodity price multiplier for a specified item record, combining base item value, local market adjustments, and cultural trade modifiers.
methods.getMapMarker: Returns the visual map marker icon asset name displayed on the world map for this settlement.
methods.getMapMarkerZoomLevel: Returns the minimum map camera zoom level threshold at which this settlement's icon becomes visible on the navigation map.
methods.getNearestGate: Searches registered gateway structures and returns the gateway building closest to the specified 3D world coordinates.
methods.getOriginalGameData: Retrieves the base immutable FCS template data record originally assigned to this town prior to any dynamic world state overrides.
methods.getPlayerTownTypeEnum: Determines the appropriate settlement type classification enum based on calculated player town level and installed municipal facilities.
methods.getPositionOutsideTownGates: Calculates an exterior Cartesian position vector situated at a specified radial distance outside the closest entrance gate.

methods.getTotalPower: Retrieves the instantaneous total electrical power generation (kW) produced by all active power generators connected to the town grid.

UseableStuff.description: Interactive furniture, production machinery, medical recovery beds, prisoner cages, training dummies, and shop trade counters. Extends the base `Building` class with operator assignment slots, electrical power grid consumption and battery storage, door locks, training XP acceleration, and interactive MyGUI layouts.

methods.UseableStuff: Constructs a new `UseableStuff` interactive furniture or machine instance within the game world, linking spatial placement, owner settlement, and layout context.
methods.calculateEfficiencyMult: Calculates overall machine operating efficiency multiplier based on electrical satisfaction and structural condition.
methods.canHaveSomeOfThese: Validates whether the specified item type is legally permitted to be stored inside this furniture's inventory.
methods.couldIOperate: Queries whether a character can potentially operate this station without mutating operator assignment sets.
methods.createInventoryLayout: Instantiates the MyGUI widget pane layout binding the internal storage grid to the user interface.
methods.dontNeedWorkRightNow: Evaluates whether the station is currently in a state where operating tasks should be suspended (e.g. broken, unpowered, or full).

methods.getCostToUse: Calculates the rental fee in Cats required for a character to rest in this bed or utilize this facility.

methods.getGUIEfficiency: Renders operating efficiency percentage meters and tooltip explanations.
methods.getGUIPower: Appends electrical grid statistics, generation/consumption wattages, and battery charge bars to the datapanel.
methods.getGUIPowerEfficiencyToolTipString: Formats a comprehensive diagnostic tooltip explaining why current efficiency is restricted (e.g. lack of power, worker skill, or damage).
methods.getGUIToolTipForGroundResourceEfficiency: Generates contextual tooltips describing ground water, stone, or iron resource fertility underneath this resource extractor.
methods.getGUIWorkers: Lists active workers operating this station and displays occupant portraits.
methods.getInventory: Retrieves the internal item inventory container attached to this furniture or workstation.
methods.getMaxPower: Returns the maximum potential electrical wattage output for generators.
methods.getMoney: Queries current monetary currency stored in the merchant's till or settlement treasury.
methods.getMouseCursor: Selects the active mouse cursor icon displayed when hovering over this interactive station.
methods.getOccupant: Retrieves the primary character entity resting or imprisoned inside this furniture (e.g. in a hospital bed or cage).
methods.getOutputBasedRotationSpeedMult: Calculates rotation animation speed for turbine blades, fans, or gears proportional to active power generation.
methods.getPowerOutput: Calculates current active power output factoring fuel availability, weather wind speeds, and mechanical health.
methods.getReachRange: Returns the physical proximity radius required for a character to begin interaction.
methods.getStatUsed: Returns the specific skill or attribute trained or utilized by this station.
methods.getUseableStuff: Polymorphic type cast helper returning this instance as a `UseableStuff*`.
methods.givePower: Injects electrical power into the machine or battery from the settlement power distribution grid.
methods.hasDoorLock: Queries whether this furniture possesses an active security lock.
methods.hasPower: Checks whether the station is currently supplied with sufficient electrical wattage to function.
methods.hitByMeleeAttack: Defines physical material collision response when struck by weapons or martial arts attacks.
methods.howMuchPowerDoYouWantForSortingFunction: Priority sorting key used by the settlement grid solver to distribute limited electricity to critical infrastructure first.
methods.howMuchPowerDoYouWantMax: Calculates the theoretical peak power demand factoring research upgrades and maximum battery charging limits.
methods.howMuchPowerDoYouWantNow: Calculates the instantaneous unsatisfied electrical deficit required to meet demand this simulation frame.
methods.isAnyInputsEmpty: Virtual hook querying whether raw ingredient input hoppers are starved of supplies.
methods.isBattery: Determines whether this object operates as an electrical battery energy accumulator.
methods.isBroken: Queries whether this machinery has suffered mechanical failure requiring repair.
methods.isDisabled: Evaluates whether the station is currently unavailable for interaction due to breakdown, unpowered status, or building deconstruction.
methods.isForSale: Queries whether this individual piece of furniture can be bought independently of its parent building.
methods.isFreeSlot: Checks whether there is an unoccupied operator slot available for character assignment.
methods.isGenerator: Determines whether this object functions as an electrical power generator.
methods.isOutOfPower: Returns a normalized penalty factor ($0.0$ to $1.0$) indicating the severity of electrical power deficit.
methods.isPowerOn: Queries whether the station's electrical circuit breaker switch is currently turned on.
methods.isRecievesBatteryPower: Queries whether battery power consumption is currently permitted by user configuration.
methods.loadFromSerialise: Restores active machine state, battery charge, door locks, and inventory items from save data.
methods.needPowerRightNow: Queries whether this station is actively demanding electricity from the power grid in the current frame.
methods.needsUpdate: Checks whether this station has dirty state requiring an immediate rendering or simulation update step.
methods.occupantHandleChangedEvent: Handles occupant handle reassignment events (e.g. when an occupant is kidnapped, dies, or is transferred).

WallBuilding.description: Defensive wall fortification piece governing perimeter segment connections, rampart walkway placement, shared construction scaffolds, and structural upgrades. Derived from `Building`, `WallBuilding` coordinates directly with `ZoneMapContent` for neighboring structural discovery, `TurretBuilding` for mounted rampart defenses, and `DatapanelGUI` for fortification upgrade and demolition controls.

methods.WallBuilding: Primary constructor configuring wall segment geometry, orientation, defensive faction ownership, municipal settlement handle, and initializing scaffold-sharing containers.
methods.addConstructionProgress: Advances engineering construction progress, propagating completed progress to all child segments sharing this segment's build state.
methods.addDismantleProgress: Applies dismantling progress to demolish the wall segment, recovering recyclable construction materials.
methods.canUpgrade: Queries available structural upgrade templates for this wall segment, validating technology research prerequisites.
methods.createPhysical: Instantiates PhysX static rigid bodies and terrain collision obstacles bounding the wall rampart and parapets.
methods.dismantleButton_all: Demolishes the entire continuous connected wall line sharing this construction scaffold.
methods.getBuildState: Retrieves the active `ConstructionState` structure controlling material delivery and engineer tasks, following shared parent links if joined.
methods.getGUIDestroyButton: Renders the dismantle/destroy button widget in the settlement management UI for player-owned walls.
methods.getGUIUpgrade: Populates the UI DataPanel inspector with upgrade button controls, displaying material costs and research status.
methods.getOutsideGateCode: Returns navigation side classification code (inside vs outside municipal wall perimeter).
methods.getPositionForWaypoint_outside: Calculates an exterior Cartesian waypoint coordinate located outside the defensive perimeter facing away from the settlement center.
methods.getReachRange: Returns maximum interaction distance for engineers repairing, upgrading, or dismantling this wall segment.
methods.getUseableStuff: Returns associated `UseableStuff` pointer if wall includes operable rampart machinery (nullptr for passive wall sections).
methods.hitByMeleeAttack: Processes incoming melee attacks against the wall structure, reducing structural hit points and emitting stone/metal impact debris.
methods.isALittleWallPartLikeACornerOrSomething: Queries whether this segment is a minor transitional piece such as a corner connector, bevel wedge, or joint transition.
methods.isAShortWallPart: Queries whether this segment is classified as a short wall piece bridging small spans between towers or gates.

methods.isDamaged: Queries whether the wall segment has sustained structural damage below its maximum health pool.
methods.isForSale: Queries whether the wall structure can be purchased by the player faction (walls are municipal fortifications and cannot be bought).
methods.letsShare: Evaluates proximity and orientation compatibility with an adjacent wall piece, pooling construction material requirements under a unified scaffold.
methods.notifyConstructionComplete: Triggered when construction reaches 100%, finalizing NavMesh obstacles, enabling rampart walkway navigation, and unhiding fortified parapets.
methods.notifyConstructionDismantling: Triggered when wall demolition begins, severing shared scaffolding links and alerting defending garrison units.
methods.runLinkingCheck: Analyzes adjacent wall segments within the active zone chunk to determine link typology (NORMAL, CONNECTOR, LOWER_WEDGE, SINGLE, SHORT) and share construction scaffolds.
methods.setConstructionProgress: Sets absolute construction completion percentage, updating visual scaffold meshes and material appearance.
methods.upgrade: Initiates a fortification upgrade operation (e.g. Tier 1 Makeshift Wall to Tier 2 Defensive Wall) from a UI button click event.

Weapon.description: Weapon represents an equippable weapon item in the game. It extends `Gear` with weapon-specific properties such as attack modifiers, bleed damage, and weapon skill categories.

methods.Weapon: Constructor for the `Weapon` class. Initializes base properties from `Gear` and parses weapon-specific stats from the provided `GameData` definition blocks, including calculating base value, bleed values, and attack modifiers.
methods.getCategory: Gets the primary weapon category this weapon belongs to (e.g., Heavy, Hackers, Katanas). This maps to which skill determines the effectiveness of the weapon.
methods.getCategory_animationOverride: Gets the weapon category used specifically for determining which combat animations to play. Generally mirrors the primary category.
methods.getCombatWeight: Retrieves the combat weight of the weapon. This weight affects character encumbrance and animation speeds while the weapon is drawn.
methods.getCraftMaterialMult: Fetches the material cost multiplier defined by the underlying item `GameData`.
methods.getCraftTime: Calculates the number of game hours required to craft this weapon. Bases its formula on weapon level and base defined item value.
methods.getItemWeight: Retrieves the weight of the weapon when stored in an inventory. This is calculated using the inventory multiplier during construction.
methods.getSkillModIndoors: Fetches the indoor combat penalty or bonus specific to this weapon type. Base weapon implementation simply returns 0.
methods.getTooltipData1: Populates the given Ogre::vector<StringPair> with primary weapon stat lines for UI tooltips.
methods.getValueSingle: Calculates the actual value of a single instance of this weapon based on whether it is owned by a player and whether it was crafted by a player.
methods.is2HandedOnly: Determines if the weapon requires both hands to wield based on its skill category. Heavy weapons, Bows/Crossbows, and Polearms are always two-handed.
methods.isCrossbow: Runtime type identification method returning `this` pointer cast to Crossbow. Overridden by the `Crossbow` subclass.
methods.isSword: Runtime type identification method used to check if the weapon is a melee sword. Overridden by subclasses.
methods.isWeapon: Runtime type identification method returning `this` pointer cast to Weapon. Used safely downcast from `Gear`.
methods.~Weapon: Destructor for the `Weapon` class. Cleans up internal structures before falling back to `Gear` destruction.

properties.combatWeight: Effective weapon weight in kilograms used for attack speed and strength requirement calculations.
properties.modAttack: Flat modifier applied to the wielder's melee attack skill.

ZoneManager.description: Master spatial streaming manager governing the 64x64 continuous world zone grid (4,096 ZoneMap chunks). Coordinates background zone loading threads, distance activation, spatial grids, island topologies, biomes, and terrain splatmaps. Interacts directly with `ZoneMap` for individual sector terrain chunks and foliage, `BiomeMap` for regional environmental palettes, `Building` and `BuildingFinderClass` for structural spatial queries, and `Town` for settlement chunk registration.

methods.setSqrtInverse: Sets this vector to the component-wise inverse square root (1.0 / sqrt(a)) of vector a.
methods.setSub: Sets this vector to the component-wise difference of vector arg1 minus vector arg2.
methods.setSubMul: Sets this vector to vector arg1 minus the product of vector arg2 and vector arg3.
methods.setW: Sets the W component of this vector from the W component of vector arg1.
methods.setXYZ: Sets the 3D xyz components from an hkVector4f or sets all three to a numeric value while preserving W.
methods.setXYZ_0: Sets the 3D xyz components from vector xyz and sets the W component to 0.0.
methods.setXYZ_W: Sets the 3D xyz components from vector arg1 and the W component from vector arg2.
methods.setZero: Sets all four components (x, y, z, w) of this vector to 0.0.
methods.setZero4: Sets all four components (x, y, z, w) of this vector to 0.0.
methods.sub: Subtracts vector a from this vector in-place.
methods.subMul: Subtracts the component-wise product of vector arg1 and vector arg2 from this vector.
methods.zeroComponent: Sets the component at the specified 0-based index to 0.0.
methods.zeroIfFalse: Sets components of this vector to 0.0 where the comparison mask comp is false.
methods.zeroIfTrue: Sets components of this vector to 0.0 where the comparison mask comp is true.

hkVector4fComparison.description: Represents a 4-component SIMD boolean mask resulting from vector comparisons in Havok physics math.

methods.allAreSet: Returns non-zero (true) if all 4 comparison components are set.
methods.anyIsSet: Returns non-zero (true) if any comparison component is set, optionally matching against a specified mask.
methods.getIndexOfFirstComponentSet: Returns the zero-based index of the first (lowest) SIMD vector component that is set.
methods.getIndexOfLastComponentSet: Returns the zero-based index of the last (highest) SIMD vector component that is set.
methods.getMask: Returns the component bitmask representing which vector lanes evaluated to true.
methods.getMaskForComponent: Static method returning the bitmask corresponding to a single component index (0..3).
methods.set: Sets the comparison mask directly from a Mask enum integer.
methods.setAnd: Computes the bitwise AND of two hkVector4fComparison masks and stores the result in this instance.
methods.setAndNot: Computes the bitwise AND-NOT of two hkVector4fComparison masks and stores the result in this instance.
methods.setNot: Inverts the comparison mask of another hkVector4fComparison and stores the result in this instance.
methods.setOr: Computes the bitwise OR of two hkVector4fComparison masks and stores the result in this instance.
methods.setSelect: Selects components between trueVal and falseVal based on the boolean mask in comp.
methods.setXor: Computes the bitwise XOR of two hkVector4fComparison masks and stores the result in this instance.

iVector2.description: Two-dimensional integer vector representing 2D grid coordinates, tile offsets, or cell sizes.

methods.getAsString: Returns the formatted string representation of the vector.
methods.getLinearValue: Returns the linearized 1D index representation of this 2D coordinate.
methods.operator_add: Adds two iVector2 vectors component-wise and returns the resulting iVector2 value.
methods.operator_eq: Returns true if both x and y coordinates are equal.
methods.operator_lt: Returns true if this coordinate is ordered before the other in standard coordinate ordering.
methods.operator_ne: Returns true if either x or y coordinates differ.

physHit.description: Result structure returned from physics raycasts, line checks, and swept collision queries in Kenshi's PhysX system.

methods.getBuilding: Returns the Building object if the impacted entity is a building or building component.
methods.group: Returns the physics collision group identifier of the impacted shape.
methods.hitObjectUnsafePtr: Returns the raw pointer to the impacted RootObject entity wrapped as a Lua object.
methods.operator_assign: Copies collision hit attributes from another physHit instance.
methods.operator_bool: Returns true if a collision impact occurred.
methods.reset: Resets hit state, hit object references, and distance metrics to defaults.
methods.traceWasAborted: Returns true if the physics raycast query was aborted before completion.

properties._defaultAltitudeFallback: Default ground altitude fallback used if a terrain trace aborts.
properties._doNotAbort: Flag preventing raycast termination upon encountering early hits.
properties._group: Collision group ID of the hit object or surface.
properties._hitObjectUnsafePtr: Direct pointer to the impacted RootObject entity.
properties._needsGroup: Whether collision filtering by group is required.
properties._traceWasAborted: Internal flag indicating whether the raycast trace was aborted.
properties.distance: Distance from the raycast origin to the intersection point.
properties.hit: Whether a valid collision intersection was detected.
properties.hitObject: The hand handle referencing the impacted RootObject.
properties.normal: Surface normal Vector3 at the impact point.
properties.position: World coordinates Vector3 of the collision impact point.
properties.shape: Raw pointer (lightuserdata) to the impacted PhysX NxShape.

rendHit.description: Raycast collision result storing an intersected object identifier and the 3D world hit point.

properties.data: Integer identifier or material/face index returned by the raycast intersection.
properties.hit: The 3D world intersection point (Ogre::Vector3) of the raycast hit.
